The org edition of this scratch org. Possible values are
												Group,
												Developer,
												Enterprise, and
												Professional. This field is
											read only.

fields.name: ExpirationDate
fields.description:
Date when the scratch org expires. This field is read
											only.

fields.name: Features
fields.description:
The features enabled in this scratch org, such as
												MultiCurrency. See the
												Salesforce DX Developer Guide for the
											full list of valid features. This field is read
											only.

fields.name: HasSampleData
fields.description:
Specifies whether the scratch org contains sample data.
											If set to true, the
											sample data is similar to the data in a Salesforce free
											trial org.

fields.name: LastLoginDate
fields.description:
The date of the last user login to the scratch org. This
											field is read only.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this
											record indirectly, for example, through a list view or
											related record. This field is read only.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this
											record or list view. If this value is null, and
												LastReferenceDate isn’t null,
											the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.
											This field is read only.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The auto-generated ID of this scratch org. This field is
											read only.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.description:
The namespace associated with this scratch org. This
											field is read only.

fields.name: OrgName
fields.description:
The name of the scratch org. This field is read
											only.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
The ID of the user who owns this scratch org. This field
											is read only.

fields.name: ScratchOrg
fields.description:
The org ID of the scratch org. This field is read
											only.

fields.name: ScratchOrgInfoId
fields.description:
The id of the associated
												ScratchOrgInfo object. This
											field is read only.

fields.name: SignupEmail
fields.description:
The email address of the Administration user. This field
											is read only.

fields.name: SignupInstance
fields.description:
The Salesforce instance on which this scratch org
											resides. This field is read only.

fields.name: SignupTrialDays
fields.description:
The number of days between the scratch org's creation
											and expiration. This field is read only.

fields.name: SignupUsername
fields.description:
The username of the Administration user of the scratch
											org. This field is read only.

fields.name: Snapshot
fields.description:
If this scratch org was created from a scratch org
											snapshot, then this field contains either the name or ID
											of the snapshot. Specifically, the name corresponds to
											the Name field of the snapshot’s
											record in the OrgSnapshot standard object; the ID
											corresponds to the record ID. If this scratch org wasn’t created from a snapshot, this
											field is empty. This field is read only. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

fields.name: ActivityId
fields.description: The ID of the task or event that changed. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: ChangedById
fields.description: The ID of the user who made the change. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ChangedDate
fields.description: The date the field value changed.

fields.name: DataType
fields.description:
The type of the field with the changed value. Possible values are: 
                                    Address

                                    AnyType

                                    AutoNumber

                                    Base64

                                    BitVector

                                    Boolean

                                    Content

                                    Currency

                                    DataCategoryGroupReference

                                    DateOnly

                                    DateTime

                                    Division

                                    Double

                                    DynamicEnum

                                    Email

                                    EncryptedBase64

                                    EncryptedText

                                    EntityId

                                    EnumOrId

                                    ExternalId

                                    Fax

                                    File

                                    HtmlMultiLineText

                                    HtmlStringPlusClob

                                    InetAddress

                                    Json

                                    Location

                                    MultiEnum

                                    MultiLineText

                                    Namespace

                                    Percent

                                    PersonName

                                    Phone

                                    Raw

                                    RecordType

                                    SfdcEncryptedText

                                    SimpleNamespace

                                    StringPlusClob

                                    Switchable_PersonName

                                    Text

                                    TimeOnly

                                    Url

                                    YearQuarter

fields.name: FieldName
fields.description: The name of the field changed.

fields.name: IsDataAvailable
fields.description:
Indicates whether valid data is available in the old and new value
                                 fields. This field is false
                                 if, for example, the fields are encrypted or the changed values are
                                 too large, such as for Description field types. The default value is false.

fields.name: NewValueDateTime
fields.description: The new value for date type fields.

fields.name: NewValueNumber
fields.description: The new value for number type fields.

fields.name: NewValueText
fields.description:
The new value for all other field types that are not a date or
                                 number type.

fields.name: OldValueDateTime
fields.description: Old value for date type fields.

fields.name: OldValueNumber
fields.description: Old value for number type fields.

fields.name: OldValueText
fields.description:
The old value for all other field types that are not a date or
                                 number type.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description:
The operation of the field value change. Possible values are: 
                                    delete

                                    update

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description:
Indicates the ID of the related account, which is determined as follows:
            The account associated with the WhatId, if it exists; or

            The account associated with the WhoId, if it exists;
             otherwise

            null

           
For information on IDs, see ID Field
             Type. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActivityDate
fields.description:
Indicates one of the following:
            The due date of a task

            The due date of an event if IsAllDayEvent is set to true This field has a time stamp that is always set to midnight in the Universal Time
           Coordinated (UTC) time zone. The time stamp doesn’t represent the time of the activity;
           don’t
           attempt to alter it to accommodate time zone differences. Label is
            Date.

fields.name: ActivityDateTime
fields.description:
Contains the event’s due date if the IsAllDayEvent flag is set to
            false.  The time
            portion of this field is always transferred in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time
            zone. Translate the time portion to or from a local time zone for the user or the
            application, as appropriate. Label is Due Date Time.The
            value for this field and StartDateTime must match, or one of them
            must be null.

fields.name: ActivitySubtype
fields.description:
Provides standard subtypes to facilitate creating and
            searching for specific activity subtypes. This field isn’t updateable.Possible
            values are:
             Task

             Email

             Call

             Event

             
             LinkedIn —Available in API version 56.0 and later.

             
             List Email

fields.name: ActivityType
fields.description:
Represents one of the following values: Call,
             Email, Meeting, or Other. Label is
             Type. These are default values, and can be changed.

fields.name: AlternateDetailId
fields.description:
The ID of a record the activity is related to which contains more details about the
           activity. For example, an activity can be related to an EmailMessage record. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CallDisposition
fields.description:
Represents the result of a given call, for example, “we'll call back,”
            or “call unsuccessful.” Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: CallDurationInSeconds
fields.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

fields.name: CallObject
fields.description: Name of a call center. Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: CallType
fields.description: The type of call being answered: Inbound, Internal, or Outbound.

fields.name: CompletedDateTime
fields.description:
The date and time the task was saved with a Closed status. 
            For insert, if the task is saved with a Closed status the field is set. If the task
             is saved with an Open status the field is set to NULL.

            For update, if the task is saved with a new Closed status, the field is reset. If
              the task is saved with a new non-closed status, the field is reset to NULL. 
If
              the task is saved with the same closed status (that is, unchanged) there is no change
              to the field. 


           


Note
The status is a dynamic enum. If the Closed mapping is changed it won’t cause
            an update of existing tasks. Only new insert/update operations are affected.

fields.name: ConnectionReceivedId
fields.description:
Indicates the ID of the PartnerNetworkConnection that shared this record with your
            organization. This field is available only if your organization has enabled Salesforce
            to Salesforce and only in API versions 28.0 and later.

fields.name: ConnectionSentId
fields.description:
Indicates the ID of the PartnerNetworkConnection that your organization shared this
           record with. This field is available only if your organization has enabled Salesforce to
           Salesforce, and only in API versions 28.0 and later. The value is always null. You can use the PartnerNetworkRecordConnection object
           to forward records to connections.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Contains a description of the event or task. Limit is 32 KB.

fields.name: Division
fields.description:
A logical segment of your organization's data. For example, if your company is
           organized into different business units, you could create a division for each business
           unit, such as “North America,” “Healthcare,” or
           “Consulting.” Available only if the organization has the Division
           permission enabled.

fields.name: DurationInMinutes
fields.description: Indicates the duration of the event or task.

fields.name: EndDateTime
fields.description:
Indicates the end date and time of the event or task. Available in versions 27.0 and
           later. This field is optional, depending on the following:
            If IsAllDayEvent is true, you can supply a value for either
              DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying
             values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time. If
             both fields are null, the duration defaults to one
             day.

            If IsAllDayEvent is false, a value must be supplied for either
              DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying
             values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time.

fields.name: IsAllDayEvent
fields.description:
If the value of this field is set to true, then
           the activity is an event spanning a full day, and the ActivityDate
           defines the date of the event. If the value of this field is set to false, then the activity may be an event spanning less than
           a full day, or it may be a task.
           The default value
           of this field is false. Label is
            All-Day Event.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description:
Indicates whether a task is closed
           (true) or
           not closed (false).
           The default value
           of this field is false. This field
           is set indirectly by setting the Status field on the
           task—each picklist value has a corresponding IsClosed value.
           Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the activity has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false).
            Label is Deleted.

fields.name: IsHighPriority
fields.description:
Indicates a high-priority task. This field is derived from the
            Priority
           field. The default
           value of this field is false.

fields.name: IsOnlineMeeting
fields.description:
Indicates whether the activity represents an online meeting (true) or not (false).

Note
This field is not available in API version 16.0 or
            later.

fields.name: IsReminderSet
fields.description:
Indicates whether a reminder is set for an activity (true) or not (false).The
           default value of this field is false.

fields.name: IsTask
fields.description:
If the value of this field is set to true, then
            the activity is a task. If the value is set to false, then the activity is an event.
            The default value
            of this field is false. Label is
             Task.

fields.name: IsVisibleInSelfService
fields.description:
If the value of this field is set to true, then
            the activity can be viewed in the self-service portal.
            The default value
            of this field is false. Label is
             Visible in Self-Service.

fields.name: Location
fields.description:
If the activity is an event, then this field contains the location of the event. If
            the activity is a task, then the value is null.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the user or group who owns the activity. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: PrimaryAccountId
fields.description:
Contains the AccountId value from the activity record. Available
           in API versions 30.0 and later to organizations that use Shared Activities.

fields.name: PrimaryWhoId
fields.description:
Contains the WhoId value from the activity record. Available in
           API versions 30.0 and later to organizations that have enabled Shared Activities.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description:
Indicates the priority of a task, such as high, normal, or
           low. The default
           value of this field is Normal.

fields.name: ReminderDateTime
fields.description:
Represents the time when the reminder is scheduled to fire, if
            IsReminderSet is set to true.
           If IsReminderSet is set to false, then the user may have deselected the reminder checkbox in the
           Salesforce user interface, or the reminder has already fired at the time indicated by the
           value.

fields.name: StartDateTime
fields.description:
Indicates the start date and time of the event. 

           Available in versions 29.0 and later. 

           If the event’s IsAllDayEvent flag is set to true (indicating an
            all-day event), then the time stamp in StartDateTime is always set
            to midnight in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. 

Note
Don’t attempt to
             alter the time stamp to account for any time zone differences. 


If the event’s
             IsAllDayEvent flag is set to false, then you must translate the
            time portion of the time stamp in StartDateTime to or from a local
            time zone for the user or the application, as appropriate. The translation must be in
            the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. 

           If this field has a value, then ActivityDate and
             ActivityDateTime either must be null or must match the value of
            this field. 

           If the activity is a task, StartDateTime is null

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Indicates the current status of a
            task,.
            The default value
            of this field is Not Started.
            Each predefined status field sets a value for
             IsClosed. To obtain picklist values, query TaskStatus.

           
           Possible values are:
             Completed

             Deferred

             In Progress

             Not Started

             Waiting on someone else

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Contains the subject of the task or event.

fields.name: WhatId
fields.description:
The WhatId represents nonhuman
             objects such as accounts, opportunities, campaigns, cases, or custom objects.
              WhatIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a
              WhatId is equivalent to the ID of a related object. The label is
              Related To ID. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: WhoId
fields.description:
The WhoId represents a human such as a lead
             or a contact. WhoIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhoId is equivalent to a
             contact’s ID or a lead’s ID. The label is Name ID.

           If Shared Activities is enabled, the
             value of this field is the ID of the related lead or primary contact. If you add,
             update, or remove the WhoId field, you might encounter problems with triggers,
             workflows, and data validation rules that are associated with the record. The label is
              Name ID.

           If your organization uses Shared Activities, when you query activities in API version
            30.0 or later, the returned value of the WhoId field matches the
            value in the queried object, not necessarily in the activity record itself. 

           If Shared Activities is enabled, the value of this field is not populated and the
            field PrimaryWhoId should be queried instead. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: BaseId
fields.description: The ID of the record that the activities apply to.

fields.name: BaseType
fields.description: The entity that corresponds to the BaseId

fields.name: FirstCallDateTime
fields.description:
Indicates the date when the first call was made. This field is available only to Sales Engagement users. Einstein Activity Capture and Activity Metrics
											aren’t required.

fields.name: FirstEmailDateTime
fields.description:
Indicates the date when the first email was sent. This field is available only to Sales Engagement users. Einstein Activity Capture and Activity Metrics
											aren’t required.

fields.name: InactiveDays
fields.description: Indicates the number of days since the most recent activity was completed. This field is derived from the Last Activity Date field.

fields.name: LastActivityDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the LastActivityDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: LastActivityDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent activity was completed.

fields.name: LastCallDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the LastCallDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: LastCallDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent call was made through Sales Dialer or Inbox.

fields.name: LastEmailDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the LastEmailDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: LastEmailDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent email was sent or received.

fields.name: LastEmailReceivedDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent email was received.Available in API version 54.0 and later.

fields.name: LastEmailSentDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent email was sent.Available in API version 54.0 and later.

fields.name: LastEventDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the LastEventDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: LastEventDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the most recent event was completed.

fields.name: LastTaskDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the LastTaskDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: LastTaskDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date when the last task was completed.

fields.name: NextActivityDateLastModDate
fields.description: Indicates when the NextActivityDateTime field was last modified.

fields.name: NextActivityDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the date of the next scheduled task or event. Only open tasks in the future are included.

fields.name: ConfigurationName
fields.description:
The name of the Einstein Activity Capture configuration that the
                                 user is assigned to.

fields.name: ConnectivityStatus
fields.description:
The status of the user’s email connection. Possible values are: 
                                    ACTIVE

                                    DISABLED

                                    
                                    INITIALIZING

                                    NEEDSATTENTION

                                    
NEEDSATTENTIONGLOBAL
                                       (used when an org-level connection isn’t working)

                                    
NEEDSATTENTIONHYBRID
                                       (used when both org-level and user-level connections aren’t
                                       working)

                                    PENDING

                                    PROCESSING

fields.name: ContactsSynced
fields.description:
The number of contacts synced after midnight between Salesforce
                                 and the user’s Microsoft or Google email account. This field is
                                 available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: EmailAddress
fields.description:
The email address that’s used to capture and sync data between
                                 Salesforce and the user’s Microsoft or Google account.

fields.name: EventsSynced
fields.description:
The number of events synced after midnight between Salesforce and
                                 the user’s Microsoft or Google email account. This field is
                                 available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description: This field is reserved for future use.

fields.name: GlobalOauthTermsState
fields.description:
Indicates the user’s terms of service status. When emails are
                                 enabled for Einstein Activity Capture, each user must accept the
                                 terms of service. Possible values are: 
                                    ACCEPTED

                                    DECLINED

                                    PENDING

                                 
This field is available only if you use an org-level OAuth
                                    2.0 or a service account authentication method. In connection
                                    report CSV files downloaded from Einstein Activity Capture
                                    Status & Metrics, this field is labeled Global Auth User
                                    Email Consent Status.

fields.name: IsTermsOfServiceAccepted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the user has accepted the Einstein Activity
                                 Capture terms of service or not. When emails are enabled for
                                 Einstein Activity Capture, each user must accept the terms of
                                 service. The default value is false. This field is available only if you use a user-level
                                 authentication method. In connection report CSV files downloaded
                                 from Einstein Activity Capture Status & Metrics, this field is
                                 labeled User Auth Terms of Service Accepted.

fields.name: RecommendedActionDescription
fields.description:
Recommended action to take when the user’s
                                    ConnectivityStatus is NEEDSATTENTION. Available in API
                                 version 58.0 and later.

fields.name: RecommendedActionTitle
fields.description:
Reason for the user's ConnectivityStatus when
                                 the status is NEEDSATTENTION.
                                 Available in API version 58.0 and later.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user.

fields.name: UserName
fields.description: The username of the Einstein Activity Capture user.

fields.name: UserOnboardingStatus
fields.description:
The initial sync status when the user connects Salesforce with
                                 their external email account and syncs data for the first time.
                                 This field is available in API version 59.0 and later. Possible values are:
                                    NOT_STARTED

                                    IN_PROGRESS

                                    NOT_CONFIGURED

                                    COMPLETE

                                    FAILED

fields.name: CallCenterId
fields.description:
System field that contains the ID of the user who created the call center
                      associated with this additional number. If value is null, this additional
                      number is displayed in every call center's phone directory.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Description of the additional number, such as Conference Room B.Limit:
                        255 characters.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the additional number.Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: The phone number that corresponds to this additional number.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The full address.

fields.name: AddressType
fields.description:
Picklist of address types. The values are:
												Mailing

												Shipping

												Billing

												Home

fields.name: City
fields.description: The address city.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The address country.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A brief description of the address.

fields.name: DrivingDirections
fields.description: Directions to the address.

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical
											coordinates compared with its physical address. A
											geocoding service typically provides this value based on
											the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The most recent date on which a user referenced this
											record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The most recent date on which a user viewed this
											record.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description:
Used with Longitude to specify the
											precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values
											are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal
											places.

fields.name: LocationType
fields.description:
Picklist of location types. The available values are:
												Warehouse (default)

												Site

												Van

												Plant

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description:
Used with Latitude to specify the
											precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values
											are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal
											places.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the address.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: A lookup field to the parent location. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The address postal code.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The address state.

fields.name: Street
fields.description: The address street.

fields.name: TimeZone
fields.description: Picklist of available time zones.

fields.name: AcceptDateTime
fields.description: Indicates when the work item was accepted.

fields.name: ActiveTime
fields.description:
The amount of time an agent is actively working on a
											work item in their console. Active time is tracked only
											for tasks routed using the tab-based capacity model.
											It's tracked only when the work tab is open and in focus
											in the console. If the agent switches console tabs, the
											time spent on the other tabs isn't counted. Active time
											continues to count if you switch to a new browser tab or
											window. Active time stops when the agent closes the work
											item or the after conversation work time ends, whichever
											happens first.

fields.name: AcwExtensionCount
fields.description:
The number of times that an agent extended the After
											Conversation Work (ACW) timer. This field is available
											in API version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: AcwExtensionDuration
fields.description:
The length of time (in seconds) that the After
											Conversation Work (ACW) timer was extended each time
											that the agent extended the timer. This field is
											available in API version 55.0 and later.To find the
												total extension duration, multiply this field by
												AcwExtensionCount or use
												AfterConversationActualTime.

fields.name: AfterConversationActualTime
fields.description:
The number of seconds an agent spent on After
											Conversation Work (ACW) after customer contact ended.
											This field is available in API version 52.0 and
											later.

fields.name: AgentCapacityWhenDeclined
fields.description:
The agent’s capacity when declining work, either
											explicitly or through push timeout.

fields.name: AssignedDateTime
fields.description: Indicates when the work item was assigned to an agent

fields.name: BotId
fields.description:
The ID of the Enhanced Einstein Bot or AI agent that
											performed the work. This is a relationship field. This
											field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: BotType
fields.description:
Indicates the type of bot. Valid values are:
												Bot. Refers to an Einstein bot. 

												ExternalCopilot. Refers to an AI agent with whom
												your customers can interact. The default value is Bot. This field is available in API
											version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: CancelDateTime
fields.description: Indicates when the work item was canceled.

fields.name: CapacityModel
fields.description:
Indicates the capacity model used to determine agent
											capacity. Valid values are StatusBased and TabBased. This field is
											available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: CapacityPercentage
fields.description:
The percentage of an agent’s capacity that’s consumed
											when this work item is in progress. Valid values are
											from 0 to 100. The agent can receive a new work item only if they have
											enough available capacity for the item. Voice calls must
											have a capacity percentage of 100, so
											an agent on a call doesn’t receive new work items until
											the call ends.

fields.name: CapacityWeight
fields.description:
The amount of an agent’s capacity that’s consumed when
											this work item is in progress. For example, if cases are assigned a capacity weight of
												2, an agent with a capacity of
												6 can accept up to 3 cases before
											the agent is at capacity and can’t receive new work
											items. Voice calls must use the entire capacity weight.

fields.name: CloseDateTime
fields.description: Indicates when the work item was closed.

fields.name: DeclineDateTime
fields.description: Date and time when the agent declined this record.

fields.name: DeclineReason
fields.description:
The provided reason for why an agent declined the work
											request.

fields.name: ExternalBotId
fields.description:
The ID of the third-party bot that handles the work
											item. This is a relationship field. This field is
											available in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: HandleTime
fields.description:
The amount of time an agent had the work item open,
											calculated by CloseDateTime – AcceptedDateTime.
											Handle time stops when the agent closes the work item or
											the after conversation work time ends, whichever happens
											first.

fields.name: IsConference
fields.description:
Indicates whether the agent was conferenced on the work
											item by another agent (true) or not (false ). The default value is false. Available in API
											version 44.0 and later. This field is accessible in
											Reports, but not via the API.

fields.name: IsInterruptible
fields.description:
Indicates whether a work item consumes interruptible or
											primary capacity. The default value is false. Available
											in API version 57.0 and later when the Interruptible
											Capacity feature is enabled.

fields.name: IsOwnerChangeInitiated
fields.description:

											direct assignment of the work item to the agent. The
											default value is false. Status-Based Capacity Model has to
											be turned on to use this field. This field is available
											in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: IsPreferredUserRequired
fields.description:
Indicates whether a work item stays with the preferred
											user even when the user isn’t available. The default
											value is false. This field is available in API version
											50.0 and later.

fields.name: IsStatusChangeInitiated
fields.description:
Indicates whether a work item status change triggered
											the direct assignment of the work item to the agent. The
											default value is false. Status-Based Capacity Model has
											to be turned on to use this field. This field is
											available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: IsTransfer
fields.description:
Indicates whether the agent received the work item
											through transfer from another agent (true) or not (false). The default
											value is false.
											Available in API version 38.0 and later. This field is
											accesible in Reports, but not via the API.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
An automatically generated ID number that identifies the
											record.

fields.name: OriginalGroupId
fields.description:
The ID of the queue that the work assignment was
											originally routed to. This field is a relationship
											field.

fields.name: OriginalQueueId
fields.description:
The ID of the queue that the work assignment was
											originally routed to. Due to API changes, OriginalQueueId is no
											longer recommended. Use OriginalGroupId instead.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
The ID of the owner of the AgentWork. This field is a
											polymorphic relationship field. This field is available
											in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: PausedCapacityPercentage
fields.description:
The percentage of an agent’s capacity that’s consumed
											when this work item is paused. The paused capacity
											feature is available with status-based capacity and
											Enhanced Omni-Channel only. This field is available in
											API version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: PausedCapacityWeight
fields.description:
The amount of an agent’s capacity that’s consumed when
											this work item is paused. The paused capacity feature is
											available with status-based capacity and Enhanced
											Omni-Channel only. This field is available in API
											version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: PendingServiceRoutingId
fields.description:
The ID of the PendingServiceRouting from which the
											AgentWork was created. This field is a relationship
											field. This field is available in API version 50.0 and
											later.

fields.name: PreferredUserId
fields.description:
The ID of the preferred user to
											handle the work. This field is a relationship field.
											This field is available in API v46.0 and later.

fields.name: PushTimeout
fields.description:
The time limit set for an agent to respond to an item
											before it’s pushed to another agent. The time limit is
											measured in seconds. This field is available in API
											version 36.0 and later. Effective API version 57.0, for inbound Voice calls,
											this field represents the time limit set for an agent to
											respond to a call before it’s declined. The value must
											be between 0 and 20. The value is capped at 20, so any
											number greater than that is treated as 20 seconds. This
											applies to the following telephony models:
												Salesforce Voice with Amazon Connect

												Salesforce Voice with Partner Telephony from Amazon Connect

fields.name: PushTimeoutDateTime
fields.description:
The date and time (in UTC) when the push timeout event
											occurred. This field is available in API version 36.0
											and later.

fields.name: RequestDateTime
fields.description: Indicates when the work was requested.

fields.name: RoutingModel
fields.description:
Determines how incoming work items are routed to agents
											assigned to a service channel. Possible values are: 
												ExternalRouting

												LeastActive

												MostAvailable

fields.name: RoutingPriority
fields.description:
The order in which work items from the queue that are
											associated with the routing configuration are routed to
											agents.

fields.name: RoutingType
fields.description:
The type of Omni-Channel routing. Possible values are: 
												QueueBased

												SkillsBased

fields.name: SecondaryRoutingPriority
fields.description: Indicates the secondary routing priority.

fields.name: ServiceChannelId
fields.description:
The ID of the service channel that’s associated with the
											work assignment. This field is a relationship
											field.

fields.name: ShouldSkipCapacityCheck
fields.description:
Indicates whether to skip checking an agent’s available
											capacity (true) or
											not (false) when an
											externally routed work item is created. This field is
											used when agents can simultaneously handle work from
											both Omni-Channel queues and queues using external
											routing. When true, the
											receiving agent can exceed their set capacity to accept
											the item, but they don’t receive more Omni-Channel
											routed work. When false, the receiving agent can’t exceed
											their set capacity and must have enough open capacity to
											accept the item. The default value is false.

fields.name: SpeedToAnswer
fields.description:
The amount of time between when the work was requested
											and when an agent accepted it.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The working status of the work item. Valid values are:
												
Assigned
												– The item is assigned to the agent but
												hasn’t been opened.

												
Canceled
												– The item no longer needs to be routed.
												For example: a chat visitor cancels their
												Omni-Channel routed chat request before it reaches
												an agent.

												
Closed
												– The item is closed.

												
Declined
												– The item was assigned to the agent but
												the agent explicitly declined it.

												
DeclinedOnPushTimeout – The item
												was declined because push time-out is enabled and
												the item request timed out with the agent.

												
Opened
												– The agent opened the item.

												
Transferred–The item was
												transferred from an agent to another agent, queue,
												or skill.

												
Unavailable
												– The item was assigned to the agent but
												the agent became unavailable (went offline or lost
												connection).

fields.name: TargetAcceptDateTime
fields.description:
The date and time by when a rep must accept a work item.
											Influences backlog ordering by prioritizing work items
											with earlier target acceptance deadlines. The field can
											be dynamically set using Flow for each work item during
											the routing process. This allows for flexible
											prioritization based on case urgency, customer tier, or
											other business rules. Available in API version 65.0 and
											later.

fields.name: TransferRequesterId
fields.description:
The user ID of the rep who reassigned the work using the
											Reassign action. This field is populated in reassigned
											AgentWork records only, not the original AgentWork
											record. This is a relationship field. This field is
											available in API version 63.0 and later.

fields.description:
The ID of the user that the work item was assigned to.

fields.name: WorkItemId
fields.description:
The ID of the object that’s routed to the agent through

fields.name: IsAdditionalSkill
fields.description:
After a designated timeout period, a skill marked as
											additional is dropped from Omni-Channel routing. The
											case is then routed to the best-matched agent, even if
											the agent doesn’t have all the skills. The default value
											is false. Available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.description: The skill that is required or additional.

											levels can range from 1 to 10. Depending on your
											business needs, you might want the skill level to
											reflect years of experience, certification levels, or
											license classes.

											agent with that skill is available. Higher
											priority-value skills are dropped first. Lower
											priority-value skills, for example 0, are dropped last.

											group. You can set skill priority using attribute setup

											with this skill was not available. The default value is
											false. Available in API version 48.0 and later.

                                 server layer.

                                       whose access to the application is limited to Chatter. This
                                       user type includes Chatter Free and Chatter moderator
                                       users.

                                       whose access is limited because they’re organization

                                       customers and access the application through a customer
                                       portal.

fields.name: ApexClassId
fields.description: The Apex class whose tests are to be executed. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ExtendedStatus
fields.description:
The pass rate of the test run.

                                            For example: “(4/6)”. This means that
                                                four out of a total of six tests passed.

                                            If the class fails to execute, this field contains
                                                the cause of the failure.

fields.name: ParentJobId
fields.description:
Points to the
                                                AsyncApexJob that represents the entire test
                                                run.

                                            If you insert multiple
                                                  Apex test queue items in a single bulk operation,
                                                  the queue items share the same parent job. This
                                                  means that a test run can consist of the execution
                                                  of the tests of several classes if all the test
                                                  queue items are inserted in the same bulk
                                                  operation.

fields.name: ShouldSkipCodeCoverage
fields.description:
Indicates whether to opt out of collecting code
                                                coverage information during Apex test runs.
                                                Available in API version 43.0 and later.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of the job. Valid values are:
                                                
Holding1


                                                Queued

                                                Preparing

                                                Processing

                                                Aborted

                                                Completed

                                                Failed

                                            
1 This status applies to batch jobs in
                                            the Apex flex queue.

fields.name: TestRunResultId

fields.name: ApexClassId
fields.description: The Apex class whose test methods were executed. This is a relationship field.

fields.description:

                                                if debug logging is enabled; otherwise, null. This is a relationship field.

                                                represents the entire test run. This is a relationship field.

fields.description:

                                                test run.

                                            This field points to the same object as ApexTestQueueItem.ParentJobId. This is a relationship field.

                                                The default is false.

fields.name: Message
fields.description:
The exception error message if a test failure occurs;
                                                otherwise, null.

fields.name: MethodName
fields.description: The test method name.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.description:
The result of the test method execution. Can be one
                                                of these values:

                                            
                                                Pass

                                                Fail

                                                CompileFail

                                                Skip

fields.name: QueueItemId
fields.description:

fields.name: RunTime

Apex—run
                                                  Apex tests.

                                                
Flow—run
                                                  flow tests.

                                                  Developer Guide.

                                                Apex tests is null.

                                                namespace. If a flow test is in a namespaced package

fields.name: Name

fields.name: ProgressIcon

fields.description: The API name of the Salesforce object that was archived, purged, or processed. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

fields.name: SkippedRootRecordsCount

The number of root records skipped due to validation
                                            errors, exclusion filters, or data protection

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: The date and time that the action started.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Status of the current activity.Valid values are:

                                    
Aborted—Process
                                        manually aborted during policy run.

                                    
Aborting—The Aborted process started.

                                    
API limit reached—Process
                                        stopped because it exceeded API rate limits or usage thresholds. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

                                    
Archive Timeout—Process
                                        automatically stopped because it took too long to execute a
                                        specific task, or the entire run.

                                    
Completed—Process
                                        completed successfully, and all records were processed.

                                    
Ended—Process
                                        finished execution. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

                                    
Ended with Delete
                                        Failures—Process completed, but failed to
                                        delete one or more items.

                                    
Ended with
                                        Errors—Process finished, but some records weren't
                                        processed. A CSV of the failed records can be downloaded
                                        from the Execution Details‌ page.

                                    
Failed—Process failed, 
                                        and no records were archived. A CSV of the failed records is 
                                        available on the Activities tab.

                                    
No Records—Process
                                        found no records matching the policy criteria.

                                    
Pending—Process is queued and waiting for execution.

                                    
Process Exceeds 23h—Activity 
                                        started and ran successfully until it reached a time limit. When a 
                                        policy is set to run daily, this status indicates partial success 
                                        before exceeding the time limit.

                                    
Process Exceeds 120h—Activity 
                                        started and ran successfully until it reached a time limit. When 
                                        a policy is set to run one time in a five-day period, this status 
                                        indicates partial success before exceeding the time limit.

                                    
Process Exceeds 168h—Activity 
                                        started and ran successfully until it reached a time limit. When a 
                                        policy is set to run weekly, this status indicates partial success 
                                        before exceeding the time limit.

                                    
Query Timeout—Process stopped
                                        because the database query took too long.

                                    
Running—Process is actively
                                        executing its tasks.

                                    
Skipped—Process was
                                        bypassed and did not execute. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

                                    
Started—Process is running.

                                    
Too Many Failures—Process was
                                        abandoned after too many records failed to read or delete.
