The namespace prefix that is associated with this
											object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a
											managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15
											characters. You can refer to a component in a managed
											package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
											notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the
												following values.

												In Developer Edition orgs,
												NamespacePrefix is set to the
												namespace prefix of the org for all objects that
												support it, unless an object is in an installed
												managed package. In that case, the object has the
												namespace prefix of the installed managed package.
												This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the
												Developer Edition org of the package
												developer.

												In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs,
												NamespacePrefix is set only
												for objects that are part of an installed managed
												package. All other objects have no namespace
												prefix.

fields.name: RecordPreference
fields.description:
The value of this field determines when to create
											campaign influence records.
												AllRecords: Creates records regardless of the
												revenue attribution percentage.

												RecordsWithAttribution: Creates records only
												when the revenue attribution is greater than
												0%.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description:
ID of the account related to the campaign. This field is available only if the
           Accounts as Campaign Members setting is enabled in the org. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CampaignId
fields.description: Required. The ID of the campaign related to the lead or contact. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: City
fields.description:
The city for the address of the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign
           Members setting enabled, this field can be the city for the account.

fields.name: CompanyOrAccount
fields.description: The company or account of the lead or contact.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: Required. The ID of a contact that's related to the campaign. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
Available only for organizations with the
            multicurrency feature enabled. This field contains the ISO code for any currency allowed
            by the organization.

fields.name: Country
fields.description:
The country for the address of the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as
           Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can be the country for the account.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
The description of the associated lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as
           Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can be the description of the account.

fields.name: DoNotCall
fields.description:
Indicates that the lead or contact doesn’t want to be called. In orgs with the
           Accounts as Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can indicate the account doesn’t
           want to be called.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address for the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members
           setting enabled, this field can be the email address for the account.

fields.name: Fax
fields.description:
Fax number for the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members
           setting enabled, this field can be the fax number for the account.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: The first name of the lead or contact.

fields.name: FirstRespondedDate
fields.description:
This field indicates the date that the campaign member received a status of
           Responded.

fields.name: HasOptedOutOfEmail
fields.description:
This field indicates the email opt-out preference for the lead or contact. A value of
            false indicates that the lead or contact is opted
           in to emails. A value of true indicates that they’re
           opted out. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can
           be the opt-out preference for the account email address.

fields.name: HasOptedOutOfFax
fields.description:
This field indicates the fax opt-out preferences for the lead or contact. A value of
           false indicates that the lead or contact is opted in to receiving faxes. A value of true
           indicates that they’re opted out. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members setting
           enabled, this field can indicate the account has opted out of faxes.

fields.name: HasResponded
fields.description:
This field indicates whether the campaign member has responded to the campaign
            (true) or not (false). Label is Responded.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: The last name of the lead or contact. The limit is 80 characters.

fields.name: LeadId
fields.description: Required. The ID of a lead that's related to the campaign. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: LeadOrContactId
fields.description:
The ID of a lead or contact that's related to the campaign. In orgs with the Accounts
            as Campaign Members setting enabled, this field also accepts an account ID.

fields.name: LeadOrContactOwnerId
fields.description:
The ID of the owner of the associated lead or contact owner. In orgs with the Accounts
           as Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can be the owner of the account. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: LeadSource
fields.description: The source where the lead was obtained.

fields.name: MobilePhone
fields.description:
The mobile phone number of the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign
           Members setting enabled, this field can be the mobile phone number for the account.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The first and last name of the lead or contact that's related to the campaign
           member.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description:
The phone number of the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members
           setting enabled, this field can be the phone number for the account.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description:
The postal code for the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as Campaign Members
           setting enabled, this field can be the postal code for the account.

fields.name: RecordTypeId
fields.description:
ID of the record type assigned to this object. To change the record type, modify the
            CampaignMemberRecordTypeId field on the associated Campaign.

fields.name: Salutation
fields.description: Salutation for the lead or contact.

fields.name: State
fields.description:
The state for the address of the lead or contact. The limit is 80 characters. In orgs
           with the Accounts as Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can be the state of the
           account address.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Controls the HasResponded flag on this object. You can't directly
           set the HasResponded flag, as it’s read-only. You can set it
           indirectly by setting this field in a create or update call. Each predefined value
           implies a HasResponded flag value. Each time you update this field,
           you implicitly update the HasResponded flag. In the Salesforce user
           interface, Marketing users can define valid status values for the
            Status picklist. They can choose one status as the default status.
           For each Status field value, they can also select which values to
           count as “Responded,” meaning that the HasResponded
           flag is set to true for those values. The limit is
           40 characters.When you create or update campaign members, use the text value for
             Status instead of the ID from the CampaignMemberStatus
           object.

fields.name: Street
fields.description:
The street for the address of the lead or contact. In orgs with the Accounts as
           Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can be the street of the account
           address.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Title for the lead or contact.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Indicates if the campaign member is a lead or a contact. In orgs with the Accounts as
           Campaign Members setting enabled, this field can indicate an account.

fields.name: CampaignId
fields.description: ID of the campaign associated with this member status.

fields.name: HasResponded
fields.description:
Indicates whether this status is equivalent to “Responded” (true) or not (false).
           Beginning with API version 39.0, at least one CampaignMemberStatus on each campaign must have a
            hasResponded value of true.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description:
Indicates whether this status is the default status (true) or not (false). Beginning with API
           version 39.0, there must be a default CampaignMemberStatus defined for every
           campaign.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false).
           Label is Deleted.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: Label for the status in the picklist. Limited to 765 characters.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Unique number order where this campaign member status appears in the picklist.

fields.name: CampaignAccessLevel
fields.description:
A value that represents the type of access
                        granted to the target Group, or UserRole. The possible values are:
                        Read

                        Edit

                        All

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
A description of the sharing rule. Maximum size is 1000 characters. This
                      field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only
                      underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It
                      must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and
                      not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field
                      prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a
                      developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes
                      are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. Corresponds to Rule
                        Name in the user interface. This field is available in API
                        version 24.0 and later.


Note
When creating large sets of data, always
                        specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no
                          DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow
                        while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: GroupId
fields.description:
The ID representing the source group. A Campaign owned by a User in the
                      source Group triggers the rule to give access.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Label of the sharing rule as it appears in the user interface. Limited to 80
                      characters. Corresponds to Label on the user
                      interface.

fields.name: UserOrGroupId
fields.description: The ID representing the User or Group being granted access.

fields.name: CampaignId
fields.description:
ID of the Campaign associated with this sharing entry. This field can't be
           updated. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CampaignAccessLevel
fields.description:
Level of access that the User or Group has to the Campaign. The possible values are:
            Read

            Edit

            
All (This value is not valid for creating or updating
             records.)

           
 This field must be set to an access level that is higher than the
           organization’s default access level for Campaign.

fields.name: RowCause
fields.description:
Reason that this sharing entry exists. If you’re creating a sharing entry, the only
           permitted value is Manual. If no value is specified,
           the field defaults to Manual. All other
            RowCause values are read-only. After the sharing entry is created,
           this field can’t be edited. Valid values: 
            
Rule—The User or Group has access via a
             Campaign sharing rule.

            
GuestRule—The User or Group has access via a
             Campaign guest user sharing rule.

            
Manual—The User or Group has access
             because a User with “All” access manually shared the
             Campaign with them.

            
Owner—The User is
             the owner of the Campaign.

            
LpuImplicit—The User has access to
             records owned by high-volume Experience Cloud site users via a share group.

            
ARImplicit—The User, who belongs to a
             partner or customer account, has access to the Campaign via an account relationship
             data sharing rule.

fields.name: UserOrGroupId
fields.description:
ID of the User or Group that has been given access to the Campaign. This field can't
           be updated. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.description: ID of the tagged item.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Name of the tag. If this value does not already exist, a new TagDefinition
                      is created and becomes the parent of this Tag object. Otherwise, a
                      TagDefinition with the same name becomes the parent of this Tag object. Parent
                      relationships are created automatically.

fields.name: TagDefinitionId
fields.description: ID of the parent TagDefinition object that owns the tag.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Defines the visibility of a tag. Valid values:
                        
Public—The tag can be viewed
                          and manipulated by all users in an organization.

                        
Personal—The tag can be
                          viewed or manipulated only by a user with a matching
                            OwnerId.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: Customer account for the payment method. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AuditEmail
fields.description:
Email address of the card owner where audit information
											about payments gets sent. This field is available in API v49.0 and later. It
											doesn’t appear in the UI by default for orgs that
											upgraded from v48.0. Users must add it to the
											CardPaymentMethod page layout on their own.

fields.name: AutoCardType
fields.description: Card network type, derived from the card number.

fields.name: CardBin
fields.description: First six digits of the card number.

fields.name: CardCategory
fields.description:
Defines whether the card is a credit card or debit
											card. Possible values are: 
												CreditCard

												DebitCard

fields.name: CardHolderFirstName
fields.description: First name of the cardholder.

fields.name: CardHolderLastName
fields.description: Last name of the cardholder.

fields.name: CardHolderName
fields.description: Full name of the cardholder.

fields.name: CardLastFour
fields.description: Last four digits of the credit card or debit card.

fields.name: CardPaymentMethodNumber
fields.description: System-defined unique ID for the card payment method.

fields.name: CardType
fields.description:
Identifies  the credit card type. Possible values are: 
												American
												Express

												Diners
												Club

												JCB

												Maestro

												Master
												Card

												Visa

fields.name: CardTypeCategory
fields.description:
Further identifies the credit card. Used for internal reference. Possible values are: 
												AmericanExpress

												DinersClub

												Discover

												Jcb

												Maestro

												MasterCard

												UnionPay

												Visa

fields.name: Comments
fields.description:
Payment admin can add comments to provide additional details about a record. Maximum
											of 1000 characters.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description: Company of the cardholder.

fields.name: DisplayCardNumber
fields.description: Masked digits for the full credit card number except the last four digits.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Email address of the payer.

fields.name: ExpiryMonth
fields.description: The card’s expiration month.

fields.name: ExpiryYear
fields.description: The card’s expiration year.

fields.name: GatewayDate
fields.description: The date that the payment gateway logs a card activity.

fields.name: GatewayResultCode
fields.description:
The result of the card payment method’s interaction with the payment gateway during a
											transaction request.

fields.name: GatewayResultCodeDescription
fields.description:
Additional information about the gateway result code. Descriptions vary between
											payment gateway providers.

fields.name: GatewayToken
fields.description:
Unencrypted unique token ID generated by the payment gateway to represent the card
											payment method during transactions.
												GatewayToken is for use with
											APIs earlier than version 52.0. For version 53.0 and
											latter, use the GatewayTokenEncrypted field. To secure
											the token, use the
												GatewayTokenEncrypted
											field. An error message appears if you try to record a GatewayToken for
											a card payment method that already has a
												GatewayToken or
												GatewayTokenEncrypted
											value.

fields.name: GatewayTokenDetails
fields.description: Additional information about the gateway token.

fields.name: GatewayTokenEncrypted
fields.description:
Encrypted unique token ID generated by the payment gateway to represent the card
											payment method during transactions. Encrypted using
											Salesforce Classic Encryption. Available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: InputCardNumber
fields.description:
Used by a payer to enter a credit card number when storing an external-type card
											payment method. After entry, the credit card number
											isn’t saved, so the InputCardNumber
											value always appears blank. The credit card number
											appears as a masked value in
												DisplayCardNumber, which shows
											only the last four digits.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description:
IP address of the card payment method holder. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later. It doesn’t appear in the UI by
											default for Salesforce orgs that upgraded from version
											48.0. Users must add it to the CardPaymentMethod page
											layout on their own.

fields.name: IsAutoPayEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether the payment method can be used for recurring payments (True) or not (False). The default
											value is False. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. For orgs that upgraded from
											version 54.0, you must add this field to the Card
											Payment Method page layout in the UI. It isn't
											automatically added.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record or list view related to
											this record, but didn’t access it directly.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is
											null, it's possible the user referenced this record but
											didn’t view it directly.

fields.name: MacAddress
fields.description:
MAC address of the card payment method holder. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later. It doesn’t appear in the UI by
											default for Salesforce orgs that upgraded from version
											48.0. Users must add it to the CardPaymentMethod page
											layout on their own.

fields.name: NickName
fields.description: Payer-defined nickname for the card payment method.

fields.name: PaymentGatewayId
fields.description:
The payment gateway used to create a gateway token. For transactions with a saved
											payment method in Salesforce, this field stores the
											payment gateway ID used in the transaction. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentMethodAddress
fields.description: Full address associated with the card payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodCity
fields.description: City of the address for the payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodCountry
fields.description: Country of the address for the payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodDetails
fields.description:
Optional information about the payment method type. This field is available in API
											version 57.0 and later.

fields.name: PaymentMethodGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
Accuracy level of the geocode for the payment method address. An accuracy level
											contains information about the location of a latitude
											and longitude. For more information about geolocation
											fields, see Geolocation Compound
												Field. Possible values are: 
												Address

												Block

												City

												County

												ExtendedZip

												NearAddress

												Neighborhood

												State

												Street

												Unknown

												Zip

fields.name: PaymentMethodLatitude
fields.description:
Latitude of the payment method address. Used with the PaymentMethodLongitude to
											specify the precise geolocation of the address. For
											details on geolocation compound fields, see Compound Field Considerations
												and Limitations.

fields.name: PaymentMethodLongitude
fields.description:
Latitude of the payment method address. Used with the PaymentMethodLatitude to specify
											the precise geolocation of the address. For details on
											geolocation compound fields, see Compound Field Considerations
												and Limitations.

fields.name: PaymentMethodPostalCode
fields.description: Postal Code of the address for the payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodState
fields.description: State of the address for the payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodStreet
fields.description: Street of the address for the payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodSubType
fields.description:
A payment method that exists as a subtype of a payment
											method type. For example, Visa, Mastercard, and American
											Express exist as subtypes of payment method types such
											as Apple Pay and Google Pay. This field is available in
											API version 57.0 and later.

fields.name: PaymentMethodType
fields.description:
Payment method used for the transaction. This field is
											available in API version 57.0 and later. Possible values are: 
												AfterpayClearpay

												AmericanExpress

												ApplePay

												BanContact

												DinersClub

												Discover

												EPS

												GooglePay

												Jcb

												Klarna

												Maestro

												MasterCard

												Other

												PayPal

												SepaDebit

												UnionPay

												Venmo

												Visa

												iDeal

fields.name: Phone
fields.description:
Phone number of the payer. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later. It doesn’t appear in the UI by
											default for Salesforce orgs that upgraded from version
											48.0. Users must add it to the CardPaymentMethod page
											layout on their own.

fields.name: ProcessingMode
fields.description:
Defines whether the card payment method is used for
											transactions made by Salesforce Payments or by an
											external third-party  payment provider. Possible values are: 
												
External—Transactions happened
												outside of the Salesforce payments platform.

												
Salesforce—Salesforce made and
												recorded an external call to the payment
												platform. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later.
											It doesn’t appear in the UI by default for Salesforce
											orgs that upgraded from version 48.0. Users must add it
											to the CardPaymentMethod page layout on their own. You must enter a value for this field.

fields.name: SavedPaymentMethodId
fields.description:
The ID of the saved payment method record. This field is
											available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: SfResultCode
fields.description:
The results of the card payment method’s interaction with the payment gateway. Possible values are: 
												Decline

												Indeterminate

												PermanentFail

												RequiresReview

												Success

												SystemError

												ValidationError

fields.name: StartMonth
fields.description: The month is activated.

fields.name: StartYear
fields.description: The year the card is activated.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of the payment method. Possible values are: 
												Active

												Canceled

												InActive

fields.name: BackgroundOperationId
fields.description: The ID of the in progress background operation.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The currency used for the checkout session. Default value is USD. Possible values are:
                      
                        
USD—U.S. Dollar

fields.name: IsArchived
fields.description:
Indicates whether checkout processing is archived (true) or not (false). After a session is archived, it can’t be unarchived.
                      Default value is false.

fields.name: IsError
fields.description: Indicates whether the session is in error state (true) or not (false). Default value is false.

fields.name: IsProcessing
fields.description: Determines whether checkout processing is in progress (true) or not (false). Default value is false.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the checkout session.

fields.name: NextState
fields.description: The next state of the checkout session.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description:
The ID of a created order after the checkout session has gone from cart to
                      order.

fields.name: OrderReferenceNumber
fields.description:
Unique reference number the shopper can use to refer to the order. In API
                      version 63.0 and later, LWR stores don't populate this field upon checkout.
                      Instead, the InitialOrderReferenceNumber
                      field on the WebCart object is populated.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The current state of the checkout session.

fields.name: WebCartId
fields.description: The ID of the cart that is used to create the checkout session.

fields.name: CartId
fields.description:
The ID the WebCart that’s associated with
											this delivery group. This field is a relationship field.

												
												
												Relationship Name

												Cart

												
												
												Relationship Type

												Lookup

												
												
												Refers To

												WebCart This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description:
Company name associated with a delivery. This field is
											available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the
											buyer’s account. Default value is USD. Possible values
											are: USD—U.S. Dollar

fields.name: DeliverToAddress
fields.description: The address to which a buyer order is delivered.

fields.name: DeliverToCity
fields.description: The city to which a buyer order is delivered.

fields.name: DeliverToCountry
fields.description: The country to which a buyer order is delivered.

fields.name: DeliverToFirstName
fields.description:
The first name of the person set to receive an order.
											This field is available in API version 57.0 and
											later.

fields.name: DeliverToGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
The geocode location to which a buyer order is
											delivered. Possible values are:
												
												Address

												Block

												City

												County

												ExtendedZip

												NearAddress

												Neighborhood

												State

												Street

												Unknown

												Zip

fields.name: DeliverToLastName
fields.description:
The last name of the person to whom a buyer order is
											delivered. This field is available in API version 57.0
											and later.

fields.name: DeliverToLatitude
fields.description: The latitude of a buyer delivery location.

fields.name: DeliverToLongitude
fields.description: The longitude of a buyer delivery location.

fields.name: DeliverToName
fields.description:
The name of the person to deliver a buyer order to. This field is set based on the
												Name field of the ContactPointAddress
											associated with this delivery group. ContactPointAddress.Name is generated by
											the system using the first and last names entered by a
											buyer during checkout.

fields.name: DeliverToPostalCode
fields.description: The postal code to which to deliver a buyer order.

fields.name: DeliverToState
fields.description: The state to which to deliver a buyer order.

fields.name: DeliverToStreet
fields.description: The street to which to deliver a buyer order.

fields.name: DeliveryMethodId
fields.description:
The ID for the delivery method to use to deliver a buyer
											order. Populated if the selected CartDeliveryGroupMethod
											only has the ShippingFee populated, but it has
											reference to an existing DeliveryMethodId which contains the fields
												Carrier,
												ClassOfService,
											and ReferenceNumber. If not, the SelectedDeliveryMethod
											field is used. This field is a relationship field. This field is deprecated in API version 64.0 and will be
											removed in API version 66.0. Instead, use the
												DeliveryMethodId field on the
												CartDeliveryGroupMethod object.

fields.name: DesiredDeliveryDate
fields.description:
The date that a buyer requests to have an order
											delivered.

fields.name: GiftMessage
fields.description:
Personalized gift message for the order. This field is
											available in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: GiftToName
fields.description:
The name of the recipient for a gift order. This field
											is available in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: GrandTotalAmount
fields.description:
Sum of all cart items’ TotalAmount,
											or CartDeliveryGroup
											TotalAmount plus
												CartDeliveryGroup
											TotalTaxAmount.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description:
Indicates if the delivery group is the default. This
											field is available in API version 59.0 and later. The default value is false. B2B and D2C stores create a default delivery group,
											along with a WebCart, when a customer adds an item to
											cart and doesn't have an existing cart. The default cart
											delivery group is needed to complete the checkout flow,
											and can't be replaced by a non-default cart delivery
											group. If you customize the standard checkout flow, make
											sure that you don't delete the default cart delivery
											group.

fields.name: IsGift
fields.description:
Indicates if the delivery group is a gift. This field is
											available in API version 64.0 and later. The default value is false.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The name of this CartDeliveryGroup
											record. Name can be up to 255
											characters. In API version 62.0 and later, if
												IsDefault is true, the
												Name is Shipment1, a localized
											string. In prior API versions, the
												Name for a default delivery
											group was Cart Delivery
												Group. Due to this change, any queries
											intended to identify default delivery groups should use
											the IsDefault rather than
												Name field.

fields.name: SelectedDeliveryMethodId
fields.description:
ID of the selected cart delivery group method. Populated
											if the selected CartDeliveryGroupMethod has the fields
												Carrier,
												ClassOfService,
												ReferenceNumber, and ShippingFee, but the
												DeliveryMethodId is null. If not, the
												DeliveryMethodId field is used. This field
											is available in API version 59.0 or later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ShipToPhoneNumber
fields.description:
Phone number associated with a delivery. This field is
											available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: ShippingInstructions
fields.description: Instructions for delivering an order.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentAmount
fields.description:
The total amount of all promotional adjustments on the cart delivery group. This field
											is available in API version 54.0 and later. For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate
												adjustments of all child components.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentTaxAmount
fields.description:
The total tax amount for all promotional adjustments on the cart delivery group. This
											field is available in API version 54.0 and later. For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate of the
												tax amounts for all child components’
												adjustments.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items TotalPrice, or
												TotalProductAmount plus
												TotalChargeAmount. For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate of all
												child component prices.

fields.name: TotalCartItemCount
fields.description:
The number of cart items, including their quantities, of the type PRODUCT in the delivery
											group. For product bundles, this count includes only
												the parent component. If the total quantity of cart items of type PRODUCT in the delivery group exceeds the
											system-defined maximum (INT_MAX), this field is set to
											INT_MAX.

fields.name: TotalChargeAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items
												TotalPrice for all cart items
											of type CHARGE.
											Cart items can be of type Product or Charge.For
												product bundles, if a child component includes a
												cart item of type CHARGE, its amount is aggregated with
												the parent’s cart item's total charge
											amount.

fields.name: TotalChargeTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items TotalTaxAmount for all cart items
											of type CHARGE.
											Cart items can be of type Product or Charge.For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate of all
												tax amounts associated with bundle-level charges,
												including the taxes of individual child
												products.

fields.name: TotalProductAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items TotalPrice for all cart items of
											type PRODUCT. Cart
											items can be of type Product or Charge. For product
												bundles, this includes the aggregate of all child
												component prices.

fields.name: TotalProductTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items TotalTaxAmount for all cart items
											of type PRODUCT.
											Cart items can be of type Product or Charge. For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate of all
												child component taxes based on their individual
												prices.

fields.name: TotalTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items TotalTaxAmount, or the combined value
											of TotalProductTaxAmount plus
												TotalChargeTaxAmount. For
												product bundles, this includes the aggregate of all
												child component taxes based on their individual
												prices.

fields.name: AdjustedShippingFee
fields.description:
Shipping fee, including TotalAdjustmentAmount, for the
                      delivery method.

fields.name: Carrier
fields.description:
The carrier that the buyer chose for their delivery method. Values are
                      defined based on the user’s shipping service. This field is available in API
                      version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: CartCheckoutSessionId
fields.description: The unique ID used to identify your cart checkout session.

fields.name: CartDeliveryGroupId
fields.description: The ID of the cart delivery group associated with the checkout session.

fields.name: ClassOfService
fields.description:
The carrier class of service that the buyer chose for their delivery method.
                      Values are defined based on the user’s shipping service. This field is
                      available in API version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The currency used for your shipping fee. Default value is USD. Possible values are: 
                        
USD—U.S. Dollar

fields.name: DeliveryMethodId
fields.description: The ID of the selected order delivery method.

fields.name: ExternalProvider
fields.description: The ID of the external shipping method provider. Optional field.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description:
Assign new delivery groups to active delivery methods. The default value is
                        False. This field is available in API
                      version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the delivery method.

fields.name: ProcessTime
fields.description:
Merchant-specified process time for the delivery method. Process time
                      includes the time between when an order is placed and when the shipment is
                      given to the shipping carrier.

fields.name: ProcessTimeUnit
fields.description:
Unit of time used to define ProcessTime. Possible values are: 
                        Days

                        Hours

                        Weeks

fields.name: ProductId
fields.description:
Optional. This product represents a delivery charge order product for a
                      delivery using this delivery method. For example, you could create a product
                      that represents an overnight express charge and assign it to an overnight
                      express delivery method. If your store uses Salesforce Native Shipping, the
                        ProductId is selected from a non-variation product with
                        Shipping in its
                      name. The term Shipping in a product name isn’t localized. If no matching product
                      is found, a random non-variation product is used. This field is available in
                      API version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: ReferenceNumber
fields.description:
Reference number for an external delivery method. This field is available in
                      API version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: ShippingFee
fields.description: Shipping fee associated with the delivery method. Required field.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentAmount
fields.description: The adjustment amount of a promotion applicable to the delivery method.

fields.name: TransitTimeMax
fields.description:
Maximum estimate of transit time for the delivery method. Transit time
                      includes the time between when a shipping carrier receives a shipment and when
                      the shipment arrives at the delivery address.

fields.name: TransitTimeMin
fields.description:
Minimum estimate of transit time for the delivery method. Transit time
                      includes the time between when a shipping carrier receives a shipment and when
                      the shipment arrives at the delivery address.

fields.name: TransitTimeUnit
fields.description:
Unit of time used to define TransitTimeMax and
                        TransitTimeMin. Possible values are: 
                        Days

                        Hours

                        Weeks

fields.name: WebCartId
fields.description:
The ID of the WebCart associated with the cart delivery group method.
                      Required field.

fields.name: AdjustmentAmount
fields.description:
Amount subtracted from the price by the shipping promotion
                                 discount.

fields.name: AdjustmentBasisReferenceId
fields.description:
ID of the adjustment basis reference. This is the coupon that
                                 causes the adjustment. This field is a relationship field. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: AdjustmentType
fields.description:
Type of shipping promotion discount. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    AdjustmentAmount

                                    AdjustmentPercentage

                                    OverrideAmount

fields.name: AdjustmentValue
fields.description:
Number representing the value of the price adjustment. For
                                 example, if the AdjustmentType is AdjustmentPercentage, a -10
                                    AdjustmentValue means 10 percent off. If
                                 the AdjustmentType is AdjustmentAmount, a -10
                                    AdjustmentValue means 10 dollars off.

fields.name: CartDeliveryGroupMethodId
fields.description: ID of the cart delivery group method. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
Currency ISO code of the cart. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the cart delivery group method adjustment.

fields.name: PriceAdjustmentCauseId
fields.description: ID of the price adjustment cause. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description:
If there are multiple promotional adjustments, the order in which
                                 the shipping promotion is applied.

fields.name: AdjustmentAmount
fields.description: Non-itemized adjustments for this cart item.

fields.name: AdjustmentTax​Amount
fields.description:
The tax that’s calculated on the
												AdjustmentAmount.

fields.name: AssociatedItem​Pricing
fields.description:
Specifies how a child cart item is priced relative to
											its parent cart item within a product bundle. This field
											is null for
											standalone products that aren't part of a bundle.
											Available in API version 65.0 and later.Possible
												values are:

												
IncludedInBundlePrice—Indicates
												that the parent product’s price includes the
												aggregated prices of its child components.

												
NotIncludedInBundlePrice—Indicates
												that the parent product’s price doesn’t include
												the aggregated prices of its child
												components.

fields.name: BillingFrequency
fields.description:
Specifies how often a subscription is billed. Available
											in API version 59.0 and later.Possible values
												are:

												Annual

												MilestonePlan

												Monthly

												Quarterly

												Semi-Annual

fields.name: CartDelivery​GroupId
fields.description:
The ID of the CartDeliveryGroup
											that’s associated with a cart item. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CartId
fields.description:
The ID of the WebCart that’s
											associated with a cart item. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ChildProduct​Count
fields.description:
The total number of child products associated with this
											cart item. If a child product is a bundle, its own
												ChildProductCount is included
											in this total. For simple products that don’t have any
											child products, the
												ChildProductCount value is
											zero.

fields.name: Configure​DuringSale
fields.description:
Specify whether a product bundle is configurable.
											Available in API version 65.0 and later. Possible
												values are:

												Allowed

												NotAllowed

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the
											buyer’s account. Default value is USD. Possible values
											are: AED—UAE Dirham

												
AUD—Australian Dollar

												
BRL—Brazilian Real

												
CAD—Canadian Dollar

												
EUR—Euro

												
GBP—British Pound

												
INR—Indian Rupee

												
JPY—Japanese Yen

												
SEK—Swedish Krona

												
USD—U.S. Dollar

fields.name: DistributedAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
A calculated field that determines the amount of a
											cart-wide promotional adjustment when distributed across
											all items in the cart. This field is for display
											purposes only and is valid only during checkout. This
											field is available in API version 52.0 and later. You receive $10 off, and there are 5 items in the cart.
											The distributed adjustment is (-$2).

fields.name: DistributedAdjustment​TaxAmount
fields.description:
A calculated field that determines the amount of a
											cart-wide tax adjustment due to promotions when
											distributed across all items in the cart. This field is
											available in API version 52.0 and later. EXAMPLE: Your discount causes a cart-wide tax reduction
											of (-$10), and there are 5 items in the cart. The
											distributed tax adjustment is (-$2).

fields.name: EndQuantity
fields.description:
Indicates the final asset quantity when the subscription is modified or when it
											ends.

fields.name: FirstPymtPriceAferAdjustments
fields.description:
The first term price for term-based subscription
											products, after price adjustments are applied. The total
											amount for a non-subscription product or a non-term
											based subscription product, after price adjustments are
											applied. This is available in API version 60.0 and
											later.

fields.name: FirstPymtTax
fields.description:
The tax for the first term price for term-based
											subscription products. The tax amount for a
											non-subscription product or a non-term subscription
											product. This field is available in API version 60.0 and
											later.

fields.name: GrossAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
The gross amount of the price adjustment on the cart
											item (tax inclusive). This is available in API version
											55.0 and later.

fields.name: GrossUnitPrice
fields.description:
The gross amount of the unit price for a cart item (tax
											inclusive). This is available in API version 55.0 and
											later.

fields.name: IsShippingChargeNot​Applicable
fields.description:
Indicates whether shipping charges are applicable
												(true) or not
												(false) to the
											cart item. The default value is false. This field is available in API version 64.0 and
											later.

fields.name: ItemizedAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
A calculated field that determines the total amount of
											promotional adjustments that are specific to an item.
											This field is available in API version 52.0 and
											later. EXAMPLE: One cart item has one discount code for $10
											off. Your itemized adjustment amount is (-$10) for that
											item.

fields.name: ItemizedAdjustment​TaxAmount
fields.description:
A calculated field that determines the total amount of
											promotion-related tax adjustments that are specific to
											an item. This field is available in API version 52.0 and
											later. EXAMPLE: One cart item has one discount code for $10
											off. This reduces the tax on that item by (-$2). Your
											itemized adjustment tax amount is (-$2) for that
											item.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description:
The original price of the cart item. Typically shown
											with a line through it. List price is shown only when
											it’s higher than the negotiated price. If the list price
											is the same or lower, it isn’t shown to the buyer. This
											field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The name of this CartItem record.
												Name can be up to 255
											characters.

fields.name: NetAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
The net amount of the price adjustment made on the cart
											item (tax exclusive). This is available in API version
											55.0 and later.

fields.name: NetUnitPrice
fields.description:
The net amount of the unit price for the cart item (tax
											exclusive). This is available in API version 55.0 and
											later.

fields.name: NetUnitPriceAfterAdjustments
fields.description:
The net unit price for a cart item, after all tier and
											promotional price adjustments are applied. This field is
											available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: ParentCart​ItemId
fields.description:
The ID of the cart item's parent CartItem. The value is
											empty if the item is a top-level cart item. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PerUnitWeight
fields.description:
Weight per unit of this cart item, in the unit specified
											by WeightUnit. This field is
											available in API version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: PeriodBoundary
fields.description:
The. Default value is .
											Possible values are:
												AlignToCalendar

												Anniversary

												DayOfPeriod

												LastDayOfPeriod

fields.name: PeriodBoundaryDay
fields.description: The .

fields.name: PeriodBoundaryStartMonth
fields.description:
The. Default value is .
											Possible values are:
												
1—January

												
10—October

												
11—November

												
12—December

												
2—February

												
3—March

												
4—April

												
5—May

												
6—June

												
7—July

												
8—August

												
9—September

fields.name: PriceBookEntryId
fields.description:
The ID of the price book entry for the product. This
											field is available in API version 60.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PricingTermCount
fields.description:
A calculated field that indicates the number of pricing
											terms in the subscription. This field is available in
											API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description:
The ID of a product type cart item. Cart items can be of
											type PRODUCT or
												CHARGE. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ProductClass
fields.description:
The product class of the cart item. Default value is
												Simple.
											Possible values are:
												Bundle

												Set

												Simple

												Variation

												VariationParent

fields.name: ProductRelated​ComponentId
fields.description:
The ID of the cart item's ProductRelatedComponent. The ProductRelatedComponent
											represents a product that is included in a product
											bundle, a set, or a product and an add-on. The ProductRelatedComponent
											is empty if the item is a top-level cart item. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ProductSellingModelId
fields.description:
The ID of the model used to sell a product. This field is available in API version
											59.0 or later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ProductValidation​Key
fields.description: The product validation key of the cart item.

fields.name: ProductRelationshipTypeId
fields.description:
The ID of the product relationship type that defines the
											relationship between a product bundle and its child
											product. Available in API version 65.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ProrationPolicyId
fields.description:
The ID of the proration policy, which defines how prices
											are calculated for each time period within a
											subscription term. This field is available in API
											version 60.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: StartQuantity
fields.description: Indicates the initial asset quantity when the subscription starts.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The number of a given cart item in a cart.

fields.name: QuoteLineItemId
fields.description:
ID of the associated quote line item. Applicable only if the cart is created from a
											quote.

fields.name: QuantityScaleMethod
fields.description:
Determines how a child product's quantity scales when
											added to a cart or configured within a product bundle.
											Available in API version 65.0 and later. Possible values are:
												
Constant—Represents a value that
												remains fixed relative to the parent bundle.

												
Proportional—Represents a value
												that varies in proportion to the parent bundle’s
												price or quantity.

fields.name: SalesPrice
fields.description: The discounted price of a cart item.

fields.name: SellingModelType
fields.description:
The type of the product selling model associated with a term-based subscription
											product. This field is available in API version 60.0 and
											later. Possible values are:
												Evergreen

												OneTime

												TermDefined

											
The default value is OneTime.

fields.name: Sku
fields.description: The Shelf-Keeping Unit ID of a cart item.

fields.name: StockCheck​Method
fields.description:
Determines how inventory is assessed for a cart item
											that’s part of a bundle or set. Possible values are:
												
ChildProducts—Inventory is
												assessed based on the child product or
												products.

												
ParentProduct—Inventory is
												assessed based on the parent product.

fields.name: SubType
fields.description:
Specifies the subtype of the product. Possible values are:
												
Bonus—Bonus product.

												
GiftWrap—Gift wrapped
												product. This field is available in API version 64.0 and
											later.

fields.name: SubscriptionTerm
fields.description:
The number of terms (years or months, for example) in the subscription. This field is
											available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: TaxTreatment​Id
fields.description:
The ID of the related tax treatment for the cart item.
												This field is available in API version 63.0 and
												later. This field is available with Subscription
												Management. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: TotalAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
The total amount of all promotional adjustments on the
											item, both distributed and itemized. This field is
											available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description:
The total cost of this cart item, including taxes and
											adjustments.

fields.name: TotalFirstPymtAdjAmount
fields.description:
The total adjustment amount for the first payment of a
											term-based susbcription product. The
											TotalAdjustmentAmount for non-subscription products and
											non-term based subscription products. This field is
											available in API version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalFirstPymtListPrice
fields.description:
The first-payment amount for a term-based subscription
											product, based on the product's ListPrice. This is the
											same value as TotalListPrice for non-subscription
											products or non-term based subscription products. This
											price is only for comparison, and not the price at which
											the buyer purchases a product. This field is available
											in API version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalFirstPymtPrice
fields.description:
The first term price for term-based subscription
											products. The price of a line item for non-subscription
											products and non-term based subscription products. This
											price includes price adjustments and excludes taxes.
											This field is available in API version 63.0 and
											later.

fields.name: TotalLine​Amount
fields.description:
Total amount for this cart item, based on sales price
											and quantity.

fields.name: TotalLineFirstPymtAmount
fields.description:
The first term price for term-based subscripiton
											products, calculated based on the sales price and
											quantity, before any price adjustments are made. This is
											the same value as TotalLineAmount for non-subscription
											products and non-term based subscription products. This
											field is available in API version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalLineFirstPymtTaxAmount
fields.description:
The tax on the first payment amount, after price
											adjustments, for term-based subscription products. The
											tax on the price of the product for non-subscription
											products and non-term based subscription products. Taxes
											are also calculated on the delivery charge items. This
											field is a calculated field. This field is available in
											API version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalLineGross​Amount
fields.description:
The total gross amount of the line item (tax inclusive).
											This is available in API version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalLineNet​Amount
fields.description:
The total net amount of the line item (tax exclusive).
											This is available in API version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalLineTax​Amount
fields.description:
Total tax amount for
												TotalLineAmount.

fields.name: TotalListPrice
fields.description:
Total amount for this cart item, based on
												ListPrice. We provide this
											value for comparison. It's not the price that the buyer
											is paying.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description:
Total amount for this cart item, including adjustments
											but excluding taxes. Note
Although this field is Nillable, if you want to
												use Commerce Webstore
												Cart Promotions, this field is
												required.

fields.name: TotalPriceAfterAll​Adjustments
fields.description:
Total price after all price adjustments are applied.
											This field is available in API version 52.0 and
											later. Note
Although this field is Nillable, if you want to
												use Commerce Webstore
												Cart Promotions, this field is
												required.

fields.name: TotalPrice​TaxAmount
fields.description:
Total tax amount for a cart item before promotional
											adjustments, including quantity-based adjustments. This
											field is available in API version 56.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalPromo​AdjustmentAmount
fields.description:
Total itemized and distributed adjustment amount in cart
											(only for promotions). This field is available in API
											version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalPromoAdjustment​TaxAmount
fields.description:
Total itemized and distributed adjustment tax amount in
											cart (only for promotions). This field is available in
											API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalTaxAmount
fields.description:
Total tax amount for this cart item. This value includes
											taxes for both TotalLineAmount and
												AdjustmentAmount.

fields.name: TotalWeight
fields.description:
Total weight of this cart item, in the unit specified by
												WeightUnit. This field is
											available in API version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The CartItem type. Possible values are:
												
												Product

												Charge

fields.name: UnitAdjusted​Price
fields.description:
Price per quantity unit after a tier discount or
											surcharge is applied. This field is available in API
											version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: UnitAdjustedPrice​WithItemAdj
fields.description:
Unit price, including both tier and item level
											discounts, for the item.

fields.name: UnitAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
Tier discount or surcharge to apply to a quantity unit.
											This amount is added to the
												SalesPrice to get the
												UnitAdjustedPrice. This field
											is available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: UnitItemAdjustment​Amount
fields.description:
Item level adjustments made to the unit price for the
											item.

fields.name: UnitPriceAfterAdjustments
fields.description:
The unit price for a cart item, after tier and
											promotional price adjustments are applied. This field is
											available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: WeightUnit
fields.description:
Unit of measurement for the weight of the cart item.
											This field is available in API version 62.0 and
											later. Possible values are: 
												Grams

												Kilograms

												Ounces

												Pounds

fields.name: AttributeDefinitionId
fields.description:
The ID of the attribute definition associated with the cart item
                                 attribute. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AttributeName
fields.description: The name of the cart item attribute.

fields.name: AttributePicklistValueId
fields.description:
The ID of the picklist value associated with the cart item
                                 attribute. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AttributeValue
fields.description: The value of the cart item attribute, such as Blue or Large.

fields.name: CartItemId
fields.description: The ID of the cart item to which this attribute is assigned. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description:
An auto-generated ID for the attribute record that's stored in an
                                 external system, such as the HBase database.

fields.name: IsPriceImpacting
fields.description:
Indicates whether the attribute affects cart pricing (true) or not (false). This field determines
                                 whether the Commerce Pricing API calls must be triggered to update
                                 the price.

fields.name: UnitOfMeasure
fields.description:
The ID of the unit of measure associated with the cart item
                                 attribute. This field is available only if the AttributeUomPilot Org perm is
                                 enabled. Contact Salesforce support for assistance. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AdjustmentAmountScope
fields.description:
Scope of the adjustment amount for a promotion. Possible values are: 
            
Total—The amount off the total
             price. This field is available in API version 54.0 and later.

fields.name: AdjustmentBasisReferenceId
fields.description:
Coupon code of the coupon associated with a promotion. This field is available in API
           version 54.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: AdjustmentSource
fields.description:

fields.name: IsCallback
fields.description:
Determines how a voice call callback is handled after an
											agent accepts the callback work item. If set to true, when an agent accepts the work
											item, the Omni-Channel utility doesn’t immediately dial
											the callback phone number. Instead, the agent can
											determine how to handle the call. For example, after the
											agent accepts the work item, they can view the callback
											details, transfer the call, or contact the end user at
											another phone number. If the agent makes a call by using
											click-to-dial, the call appears as a Callback call in
											the Omni-Channel utility. If set to false,
											when the agent accepts the work item in the Omni-Channel
											utility, the contact request is opened. The agent can
											review callback details. If they call with
											click-to-dial, the call appears as an Outbound call in
											the Omni-Channel utility. The default value is false. Available in API version 60.0 and
											later.

fields.description:
Required. The permission granted to the user of the shared file in a
                      library. This is determined by the permission the user already has in the
                      library. This field is available in API version 25.0 and later.
                        
                          V

                          Viewer permission. The user can explicitly view but not edit the

                          Collaborator permission. The user can explicitly view and edit the
                            shared file. You can retrieve the ShareType for ContentDocumentLink, but

                              ShareType of C from an Apex trigger. 

                        
                        
                          I

                            related record. For shares with a library, this is defined by the
                            permissions the user has in that library. Inferred permission on
                              shares with libraries and file owners is available in API versions

Specifies whether this file is available to all users, internal users, or
                      shared users. This field is available in API version 26.0 and later.Valid
                        values are:

                        
AllUsers—The file is
                          available to all users who have permission to see the file. 

                        
InternalUsers—The file is
                          available only to internal users who have permission to see the file.

                        
SharedUsers—The file is
                          available to all users who can see the feed to which the file is posted.
                          SharedUsers is used only for files shared with users, and is available
                          only when an org has private org-wide sharing on by default. The SharedUsers value is available in API
                          version 32.0 and later.

                      
Note the following exceptions for Visibility.

                        
AllUsers & InternalUsers values apply to files posted
                          on standard and custom object records, but not to users, groups, or
                          content libraries.

                        For posts to a record feed, Visibility is set to
                            InternalUsers for all internal
                          users by default. 

                        External users can set Visibility only to AllUsers.

                        On user and group posts, only internal users can set
                            Visibility to InternalUsers.

                        For posts to a user feed, if the organization-wide default for user
                          sharing is set to private, Visibility is set to
                            SharedUsers.

                        Only internal users can update Visibility.

                        Visibility can be updated on links to files posted on standard and
                          custom object records, but not to users, groups, or content
                          libraries.

                        Visibility is updatable in API version 43.0 and later.

fields.name: ContentItemSize
fields.description:
The size of the file or folder. Available in API version
											65.0 and later.

fields.name: ContentModifiedDate
fields.description: Date the file or folder content last changed.

fields.name: ContentSize
fields.description:
The size of the file or folder that's less than 2
											GB.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Explanation of item in external data source.

fields.name: ExternalContentUrl
fields.description:
The URL of the document content in the external data
											source.

fields.name: ExternalDocumentUrl
fields.description:
The URL of the detail page in the external data
											source.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description:
ID for the file or folder in the external data
											source.

fields.name: FileExtension
fields.description: File format extension, such as .doc or .pdf

fields.name: FileType
fields.description:
Complete file type, such as “Microsoft Word
											Document.”

fields.name: IsFolder
fields.description: Indicates whether item is a folder or file.

fields.name: MimeType
fields.description: MIME type of the content.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Name of the file or folder in the external data
											source.

fields.name: Owner
fields.description:
Username of the content owner in the external data
											source.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description:
The ID of the parent folder for the record.This field
												isn’t returned in queries or searches of the
												ContentHubItem object. It supports only WHERE
												clauses, such as the following:
WHERE ContentHubRepositoryId =
												<ID of external source> and ParentId = <ID
												of parent folder or record>. 
Or
												specify WHERE ParentId =
												<name of root folder> to return the
												children of the root folder.


Tip
The
												ParentId field supports both Salesforce IDs (in the
												format “0CHxxx”) and external IDs.

fields.name: Title
fields.description:
The title that appears in the content, which often
											differs from the Name of the
											containing file or folder.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Username for the person who last updated the file.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the record in the API. This name can
											contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters,
											and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a
											letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore,
											and not contain two consecutive underscores. This field
											is automatically generated but you can supply your own
											value if you create the record using the API.

Note
When
												creating large sets of data, always specify a unique
												DeveloperName for each
												record. If no DeveloperName is
												specified, performance may slow while Salesforce
												generates one for each record.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description:
Master label for the external data source. This display
											value is the internal label and does not get
											translated.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The data source type. Possible values are:
												contenthubGoogleDrive

												contenthubOffice365

												contenthubOneDrive

												contenthubSharepoint

												contenthubBox

												contenthubQuip

fields.name: Content
fields.description:
The content or body of the note, which can include properly formatted HTML or plain
           text. When a document is uploaded or downloaded via the API, it must be base64 encoded
           (for upload) or decoded (for download). Any special characters within plain text in the
            Content field must be escaped. You can escape special characters by
           calling content.escapeHtml4(). If the input contains unsafe HTML
           characters or new lines, we automatically strip them out before saving the content.

fields.name: ContentModifiedDate
fields.description:
The date the document was modified. ContentModifiedDate updates when, for example, the
           document is renamed or a new document version is uploaded. This field is available in
            API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: ContentSize
fields.description:
The size of the note in bytes for notes smaller than 2 GB. In API version 66.0 and
           later, use the ContentSizeLong field.

fields.name: ContentSizeLong
fields.description:
The size of the note in bytes, up to 10 GB.

           This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

fields.name: FileExtension
fields.description: File extension of the note.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description:
Type of file for the note. All notes have a file type of
           SNOTE.

fields.name: IsReadOnly
fields.description: Indicates whether the note is read only.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The date the note was last viewed. This field is available in API version 35.0 and
           later.

fields.name: LatestContentId
fields.description:
Lookup to the note's ContentBody. This field is available in API version 52.0 and
           later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: LatestPublishedVersionId
fields.description: ID of the ContentVersion for the latest published version of the note.

fields.name: OwnerId
properties: Create (for users assigned the Set Audit Fields Upon Creation permission)

Update (for users assigned the Set Audit Fields Upon
           Creation permission)
fields.description: ID of the owner of the note.

fields.name: SharingPrivacy
fields.description:
Controls sharing privacy for a file. Only Salesforce admins and file owners with
           Collaborator access to the file can modify this field. Default is Visible to
            Anyone With Record Access. When set to Private on
            Records, the file is private on records but can be shared selectively with
            others.This field is available in API versions 41.0 and later.

fields.name: TextPreview
fields.description:
A preview of the note’s content. This field is available in API version 35.0 and
           later.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Title of the note.

fields.name: EntityIdentifierId
fields.description: ID of the object with the notification.

fields.name: EntityType
fields.description:
Type of object with the notification. One of the following.
                        ContentDocument

                        ContentTagName

                        ContentVersion

                        ContentWorkspace

                        ContentWorkspacePermission

                        User

fields.name: Nature
fields.description: Type of notification.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Subject of the notification.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Text of the notification.

fields.name: UsersId
fields.description: ID of the user who received the notification. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user following the tag on the file. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Description of the content taxonomy. This description appears in
                                 the API and in the Content Taxonomy tab in the Digital Experiences
                                 App. The maximum length is 255 characters.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The combined language and locale ISO code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Name of the content
                                 taxonomy.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyId
fields.description: The ID of the content taxonomy to which the term belongs. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyTermId
fields.description: The ID of the term that belongs to the content taxonomy. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Description of the content taxonomy term. This description appears
                                 in the API and in the Content Taxonomy tab in the Digital
                                 Experiences App. The maximum length is 255 characters.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the content taxonomy term in the API. This
                                 field is unique within your organization. The name:
                                    must be 80 characters or fewer

                                    must begin with a letter

                                    can contain only underscores and alphanumeric
                                       characters

                                    can't include spaces

                                    can't end with an underscore

                                    can't contain 2 consecutive underscores

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description: The external ID of the content taxonomy term.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Name of the content taxonomy term. The name must be between 2 and
                                 255 characters long.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyId
fields.description: The ID of the content taxonomy to which the term belongs. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyTermId
fields.description:
The ID of the primary term that has a relationship with another
                                 term. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyTrmRelaTypeId
fields.description:
The ID of the type of relationship between the two taxonomy
                                 terms. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RelatedContentTaxonomyTermId
fields.description: The ID of the term that is related to the primary term. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentTaxonomyTrmRelaCatg
fields.description:
Category of the relationship type. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    HasBroader

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the relationship type.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the relationship type.

fields.name: DocumentIdentifier
fields.description: The 15-character ID of the document that’s being shared.

fields.name: FilePreviewType
fields.description: The content type of the file preview.

fields.name: FileSize
fields.description: The size of rendition being added (bytes).

fields.name: FileType
fields.description: The content type of the file version.

fields.name: OperationType
fields.description: The operation that’s being performed.

fields.name: RequestIdentifier
fields.description:
The unique ID of a single transaction. A
                                    transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a
                                    given transaction has the same
                                    REQUEST_ID. For example: 3nWgxWbDKWWDIk0FKfF5DV.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT. For example: 20130715233322.670.

fields.name: UserIdentifier
fields.description:
The 18-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services
                                 through the UI or the API. For example: 00530000009M943YAS

fields.name: VersionIdentifier
fields.description: The 15-character ID of the content version.

fields.name: SubscribedToUserId
fields.description: ID of the user who is followed by another user. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: SubscriberUserId
fields.description: ID of the user who follows another user. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Checksum
fields.description: MD5 checksum for the file.

fields.name: ContentBodyId
fields.description:
Allows inserting a file version independently of the
											file blob being uploaded. This field is available for
											query and insert only. It can only point to a
											ContentBody record. This field is available in API
											version 40.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentDocumentId
