fields.description: ID of the document. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentLocation
fields.description:
Origin of the document. Valid values are:
												
S—Document is located within
												Salesforce. Label is Salesforce.

												
E—Document is located outside of
												Salesforce. Label is External.

												
L—Document is located on a social
												network and accessed via Social Customer Service.
												Label is Social Customer
												Service.

												
SfDrive—For internal use
												only.

												
SCS—For internal use only.

fields.name: ContentModifiedById
fields.description: ID of the user who modified the document. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentModifiedDate
fields.description:
Date the document was modified. 

											ContentModifiedDate updates
												when, for example, the document is renamed or a new
												document version is uploaded. When uploading the
												first version of a document,
												ContentModifiedDate can be
												set to the current time or any time in the past.

fields.name: ContentSize
fields.description:
The size of the document in bytes for documents smaller
											than 2 GB. The value is  zero for links.In API
												version 66.0 and later, we recommend that you use
												the ContentSizeLong field even
												for documents smaller than 2 GB.

fields.name: ContentSizeLong
fields.description:
The size of the document in bytes up to 10 GB. The
												value is zero for links.

											This field is available in API version 66.0 and
												later.

fields.name: ContentUrl
fields.description:
URL for links. This is only set for links. One of the
											fields that determines the
											FileType. The character limit in
											API versions 33.0 and later is 1,300. The character
											limit in API versions 32.0 and earlier was 255.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the content version.

fields.name: Division
fields.description:
A logical segment of your organization's data. For
											example, if your company is organized into different
											business units, you could create a division for each
											business unit, such as “North America,”
											“Healthcare,” or
											“Consulting.” Available only if the org
											has the Division permission enabled.

fields.name: ExternalDataSourceId
fields.description:
ID of the external document referenced in the
												ExternalDataSource object. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ExternalDocumentInfo1
fields.description:
Stores the URL of the file in the external content
											repository. The integration from the external source
											determines the content for this string. After the
											reference or copy is created, the URL of the external
											file is updated when you:
												Republish a file reference in Lightning
												Experience

												Open the document

												Create a file reference in the Connect REST API
												with reuseReference set to
												true.

											
When the file is updated, the shared link is
											updated to the most current version.

fields.name: ExternalDocumentInfo2
fields.description:
Contains the external file ID. Salesforce determines the
											content for this string, which is private. The content
											can change without notice, depending on the external
											system. After the file reference is created, this field
											isn’t updated, even if the file path changes.

fields.name: FeaturedContentBoost
fields.description: Read only. Designates a document as featured.

fields.name: FeaturedContentDate
fields.description: Date the document was featured.

fields.name: FileExtension
fields.description:
File extension of the document.

											This field is available in API version 31.0 and
												later.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description:
Type of content determined by
												ContentUrl for links or
												PathOnClient for
											documents.

fields.name: FirstPublishLocationId
fields.description:
ID of the location where the version was first
												published. If the version is first published into a
												user's personal library or My Files, the field will
												contain the ID of the user who owns the personal
												library or My Files. In Lightning Experience, if the
												first version is published into a public library,
												the field will contain the ID of that library.

											Accepts all record IDs supported by
												ContentDocumentLink (anything a file can be attached
												to, like records and groups).

											Setting FirstPublishLocationId
												allows you to create a file and share it with an
												initial record/group in a single transaction, and
												have the option to create more links to share the
												file with other records or groups later. When a file
												is created, it’s automatically linked to the record,
												and PublishStatus will change to Public from
												Pending/Personal.

											This field is only set the first time a version is
												published via the API.
												FirstPublishLocationId can’t
												be set to another ID when a new content version is
												inserted.

											

Note
Salesforce updates the
												FirstPublishLocationId
												updates automatically when a new
												OwnerId is added to the
												ContentVersion. For example,
												when you publish a new version with a different
												OwnerId than the current
												OwnerId, the
												FirstPublishLocationId of all
												previous versions updates to the previous
												OwnerId. The new published
												version sets the
												FirstPublishLocationId to the
												new OwnerId. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: IsAssetEnabled
fields.description:
Can be specified on insert of ContentVersion to
											automatically convert a ContentDocument file into a
											ContentAsset. This field can be SOQL queried, but it
											can’t be edited. This field is available in API version
											38.0 and later.

fields.name: IsLatest
fields.description:
Indicates whether this is the latest version of the
											document (true) or
											not (false).

fields.name: IsMajorVersion
fields.description:
true if the
											document is a major version; false if the document is a minor version.
											Major versions can’t be replaced.

fields.name: Language
fields.description:
The language for this document. This
												field defaults to the org’s default language unless
												the multi language setting is enabled.
											Specifies the language of the labels returned. The
												value must be a valid user locale (language and
												country), such as de_DE or en_GB. For more information on locales,
												see the Language field on the
												CategoryNodeLocalization object.

fields.name: MalwareScanDate
fields.description:
The date the document was scanned for malware. This
											field is available as a beta feature in API version 66.0
											and later. 

Note

												The MalwareScanDate field is
												a pilot or beta service that is subject to the
												Beta Services Terms at Agreements -
												Salesforce.com or a written Unified Pilot
												Agreement if executed by Customer, and applicable
												terms in the Product Terms Directory.
												Use of this pilot or beta service is at the
												Customer's sole discretion.

fields.name: MalwareScanStatus
fields.description:
Indicates whether the document was scanned for malware
											and whether it’s safe or malicious. This field is
											available in API version 66.0 and later.Valid values
												are:

												
NotScanned—The file hasn’t yet been
												scanned for malware. This is the default
												value.

												
Scheduled—The file scan is in
												progress.

												
Clean—The
												file was scanned and doesn’t contain malware.

												
Malicious—The file was scanned and it
												contains malware.

												
Skipped—The
												file can’t be scanned because it’s either larger
												than 100 MB or it’s a Salesforce-generated file,
												such as a Content Note.

												
Failed—The
												file wasn’t scanned because of an error. Note

												The MalwareScanStatus field
												is a pilot or beta service that is subject to the
												Beta Services Terms at Agreements -
												Salesforce.com or a written Unified Pilot
												Agreement if executed by Customer, and applicable
												terms in the Product Terms Directory.
												Use of this pilot or beta service is at the
												Customer's sole discretion.

fields.name: NegativeRatingCount
fields.description:
Read only. The number of times different users have
											given the document a thumbs down.Rating counts for
												the latest version are not version-specific. If
												Version 1 receives 10 thumbs-down votes, and Version
												2 receives 2 thumbs-down votes, the
												NegativeRatingCount on
												Version 2 is 12. However, rating counts are not
												retroactive for prior versions. The
												NegativeRatingCount on
												Version 1 is 10.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
ID of the Experience Cloud site that this file
											originated from. This field is available in API version
											26.0 and later, if digital experiences is enabled for
											your org.You can add a NetworkId
												only when creating a file. You can’t change
												or add a NetworkId for an
												existing file.

fields.name: Origin
fields.description:
The source of the content version. Valid values are:
												
C—Content document from the user's
												personal library. Label is Content. The
												FirstPublishLocationId must
												be the user's ID. If
												FirstPublishLocationId is
												left blank, it defaults to the user's
												ID.

												
H—Salesforce file from the user's
												My Files. Label is Chatter. The
												FirstPublishLocationId must
												be the user's ID. If
												FirstPublishLocationId is
												left blank, it defaults to the user's ID. Origin
												can only be set to H if Chatter is enabled
												for your organization.

											
This field defaults to C. Label is Content
												Origin.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the owner of this document. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PathOnClient
fields.description:
The complete path of the document. One of the fields
											that determines the
												FileType.

Note
Specify a
												complete path including the file extension in order
												for the document to be visible in the Preview
												tab.

fields.name: PositiveRatingCount
fields.description:
Read only. The number of times different users have
											given the document a thumbs up.Rating counts for the latest version are not
												version-specific. If Version 1 receives 10 thumbs-up
												votes, and Version 2 receives 2 thumbs-up votes, the
												PositiveRatingCount on
												Version 2 is 12. However, rating counts are not
												retroactive for prior versions. The
												PositiveRatingCount on
												Version 1 is 10.

fields.name: PublishStatus
fields.description:
Indicates if and how the document is published. Valid
											values are:
												
P—The document is published to a
												public library and is visible to other users.
												Label is Public.

												
R—The document is published to a
												personal library and is not visible to other
												users. Label is Personal Library.

												
U—The document is not published
												because publishing was interrupted. Label is
												Upload
												Interrupted.

fields.name: RatingCount
fields.description:
Read only. Total number of positive and negative
											ratings.

fields.name: ReasonForChange
fields.description:
The reason why the document was changed. This field can
											only be set when inserting a new version (revising) a
											document.

fields.name: RecordTypeId
fields.description:
ID of the record type of the version.Custom fields
												are restricted in RecordTypeId.
												When an administrator creates a custom field via the
												API it must be added to at least one page
												layout:

												If the custom field is added to the page layout
												associated with the General record type, the
												RecordTypeId that corresponds
												to that record type does not have to be set on the
												version record.

												If the custom field is added to the page layout
												associated with a custom record type, the
												RecordTypeId that corresponds
												to that record type must be set on the version
												record.

fields.name: SharingOption
fields.description:
Controls whether sharing is frozen for a file. Only
											administrators and file owners with Collaborator access
											to the file can modify this field. Default is
												Allowed, which means that new
											shares are allowed. When set to
												Restricted, new shares are
											prevented without affecting existing shares.This
												field is available in API versions 35.0 and
												later.

fields.name: SharingPrivacy
fields.description:
Controls sharing privacy for a file. Only administrators
											and file owners with Collaborator access to the file can
											modify this field. Default is Visible to
												Anyone With Record Access. When set to
												Private on Records, the file is
											private on records but can be shared selectively with
												others.This field is available in API versions
												41.0 and later.

fields.name: TagCsv
fields.description:
Text used to apply tags to a content version via the
											API.

fields.name: TextPreview
fields.description:
A preview of a document. Available in API version 35.0
											and later.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The title of a document.

fields.name: VersionData
fields.description:
The content or body of the note, which can include
											properly formatted HTML or plain text. When a document
											is uploaded or downloaded via the API, it should be
											base64 encoded (for upload) or decoded (for download).
											Any special characters within plain text in the
												Content field must be escaped.
											You can escape special characters by calling content.escapeHtml4(). This field can't be set for links.The maximum file
												size you can upload via the SOAP API is 50 MB. When
												a document is uploaded or downloaded via the API, it
												is converted to base64 and stored in VersionData. This
												conversion increases the document size by
												approximately 37%. Account for the base64 conversion
												increase so that the file you plan to upload is less
												than 50 MB after conversion.
If a custom Apex
											download handler is active, this field is accessed from
											the API, and the download is not allowed, Salesforce
											will return a CONTENT_CUSTOMIZED_DOWNLOAD_EXCEPTION
											error.

fields.name: VersionDataURL
fields.description:
The URL used to fetch a file from the binary data
											endpoint. This field is only populated on direct queries
											to ContentVersion, and not when queried through a
											related entity’s foreign key to ContentVersion. If available, access preview images of a file by
											appending a thumb
											query parameter to this URL. For
											example:myContentVersion.VersionDataUrl + '?thumb=THUMB240BY180'
Available
												thumb parameter
											values are:
												
THUMB720BY480 — corresponds to the
												big-thumbnail
												preview format

												
THUMB240BY180 — corresponds to the
												thumbnail
												preview format

												
THUMB120BY90 — corresponds to the
												tiny-thumbnail preview format

											
See File Preview in the
												Connect REST API Developer Guide for
											additional details about file previews. This field can't be set for links. This field is available in API versions 55.0 and
											later.

fields.name: VersionNumber
fields.description:
The version number. The number increments with each
											version of the document, for example, 1, 2, 3.

fields.name: ContentDocumentId
fields.description: ID of the file. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentVersionId
fields.description: ID of the version of the file. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: UserComment
fields.description: ID of the user who commented on the file.

fields.name: ContentVersionId
fields.description: ID of the version. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: DataType
fields.description: Data type of the field that was changed.

fields.name: Division
fields.description:
A logical segment of your organization's data. For example, if your company
                      is organized into different business units, you could create a division for
                      each business unit, such as “North America,”
                      “Healthcare,” or “Consulting.” Available only if
                      the organization has the Division permission enabled.

fields.name: Field
fields.description:
The name of the field that was changed. Possible values include:
                        
contentVersionCreated—A new
                          version is created.

                        
contentVersionUpdated—The
                          title, description, or any custom field on the version is changed.

                        
contentVersionDownloaded—A
                          version is downloaded.

                        
contentVersionViewed—The
                          version details are viewed.

                        
contentVersionRated—The
                          version is rated.

                        
contentVersionCommented—The
                          version receives a comment.

                        
contentVersionDataReplaced—The new version replaces the
                          previous version, which can happen only when the new version is uploaded
                          immediately after the previous version.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: ContentVersionId
fields.description: ID of the version of the file. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Rating
fields.description: Rating of the file.

fields.name: UserComment
fields.description: Comment made by the user who rated the file.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user who rated the file. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: DefaultRecordTypeId
fields.description:
ID of the default content type for the library. Content types are the
                      containers for custom fields in Salesforce CRM Content.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the content library.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the library in the API. Allows a link to the library to
                      be packaged when an asset file is added to a package. Although libraries
                      aren’t  a packageable entity, references to libraries with a developer name
                      will be included in the package when asset files are packaged. These links can
                      then be restored in the target org. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must
                      be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not
                      end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. Label is
                      Unique Name. This field is available in API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: IsRestrictContentTypes
fields.description: Read only. Indicates whether content types have been restricted (true) or not (false).

fields.name: IsRestrictLinkedContentTypes
fields.description:
Read only. Indicates whether linked content types have been restricted
                        (true) or not (false).

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the library.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The unique name of the library in the API. Allows a link to the library to
                      be packaged when an asset file is added to a package. Limit: 15 characters.
                      This field is available in API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: RootContentFolderId
fields.description:
ID of root folder of the library. This field is available in API version
                      39.0 and later.

fields.name: ShouldAddCreatorMembership
fields.description:
Automatically create a library membership for the user creating the library.
                      Note this field isn’t meant for query and always returns false in query. This
                      field is available in API version 40.0 and later.

fields.name: TagModel
fields.description:
The type of tagging assigned to a library. Valid values are: 
                        
U — Unrestricted. No
                          restrictions on tagging. Users can enter any tag when publishing or
                          editing content.

                        
G — Guided. Users can enter
                          any tag when publishing or editing content, but they’re also offered a
                          list of suggested tags.

                        
R — Restricted. Users must
                          choose from a list of suggested tags.

fields.name: WorkspaceImageId
fields.description:
ID of a library image. Image files can be assigned to libraries for branding and easy
                      identification. Library image is visible to all users, even if they aren’t
                      library members. This field is available in API version 43.0 and later.

fields.name: WorkspaceType
fields.description:
Differentiates between different types of libraries. Valid values are:
                        
R — Regular library

                        
B — Org asset library

                      
This field is available in API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: ContentDocumentId
fields.description: Read only. ID of the library document. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentWorkspaceId
fields.description: Read only. ID of the library. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: IsOwner
fields.description:
Read only. Indicates whether the library owns the document and determines
                      permissions for that document (true) or
                      not (false). Documents can belong to more
                      than one library, but only one library owns the document and determines its
                      permissions.

fields.name: ContentWorkspaceId
fields.description: ID of the library. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContentWorkspacePermissionId
fields.description: The id of the library permission or role. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.description:
ID of the library member (the member is either a user or a
                                 group). This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: MemberType
fields.description:
The type of library member. Valid values are:
                                    G - Group

                                    U - User

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the library.

fields.name: PermissionsAddComment
fields.description:
Permission for user to post comments to any content in the library
                                 and view all comments in the library. Users can edit or delete
                                 their own comments.

fields.name: PermissionsAddContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to publish new content to the library, upload
                                 new content versions, or restore archived (deleted) content.
                                 Content authors can also change any tags associated with their
                                 content and archive or delete their own content.

fields.name: PermissionsAddContentOBO
fields.description:
Permission for user to choose an author when publishing content in
                                 the library.

fields.name: PermissionsArchiveContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to archive and restore any content in the
                                 library.

fields.name: PermissionsChatterSharing
fields.description:
Permission for user to make content from this library accessible
                                 outside of the library, sharing with a record or in Chatter. From a
                                 record or from Chatter, select a file from the library and attach
                                 it to a record or a post.

fields.name: PermissionsDeleteContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to delete any content in the library. Authors
                                 can undelete their own content from the Recycle Bin.

fields.name: PermissionsDeliverContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to share content outside the org via a content
                                 delivery or public link.

fields.name: PermissionsFeatureContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to identify any content in the library as
                                 “featured.”

fields.name: PermissionsManageWorkspace
fields.description:
Permission for user to perform any action in the library. This
                                 privilege is required to edit a library’s name and description, add
                                 or remove library members, or delete a library. Manage Library is a
                                 super permission which provides all other permission options listed
                                 except Deliver Content. Creating a library requires the Manage
                                 Salesforce CRM Content app permission or Create Libraries system
                                 permission.

fields.name: PermissionsModifyComments
fields.description:
Permission for user to edit or delete comments made to any content
                                 in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsOrganizeFileAndFolder
fields.description:
Permission for user to create, rename, and delete folders in
                                 libraries.

fields.name: PermissionsTagContent
fields.description:
Permission for user to add tags when publishing content or editing
                                 content details in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsViewComments
fields.description: Permission for user to view comments.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Provides the type of access a user has to a library. Valid values are:
                                    Library Administrator

                                    Author

                                    Viewer

                                    Custom

fields.name: ContentWorkspaceId
fields.description: ID of the library. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user following the library. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContextEntityId
fields.description: The ID of the Conversation or ConversationParticipant record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: MapKey
fields.description: The key for the context data.

fields.name: MapValue
fields.description: The value for the context data.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description:
Required. ID of the Account associated with this
											contract. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActivatedById
fields.description: ID of the User who activated this contract. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActivatedDate
fields.description: Date and time when this contract was activated.

fields.name: ActivityMetricId
fields.description:
When Einstein Activity Capture with Activity Metrics is
											enabled, the ID of the related activity metric. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActivityMetricRollupId
fields.description:
When Einstein Activity Capture with Activity Metrics is
											enabled, the ID of the related activity metric
											rollup. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AggregationStrategy
fields.description:
The aggregation strategy when creating a pricing
											contract. Valid value is Cumulative. This field is available with
											Revenue Cloud in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: BillingAddress
fields.description:
The compound form of the billing address. Read-only. See
												Address Compound
												Fields for details on compound address
											fields.

fields.name: BillingCity
fields.description:
Details for the billing address. The maximum size is 40
											characters.

fields.name: BillingCountry
fields.description:
Details for the billing address of this account. The
											maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: BillingCountryCode
fields.description:
The ISO country code for the contract's billing
											address.

fields.name: BillingGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
The accuracy of the geocode for the billing
											address. Possible values are: 
												Address

												Block

												City

												County

												ExtendedZip

												NearAddress

												Neighborhood

												State

												Street

												Unknown

												Zip

fields.name: BillingLatitude
fields.description:
Used with BillingLongitude to
											specify the precise geolocation of a billing address.
											Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90
											with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: BillingLongitude
fields.description:
Used with BillingLatitude to
											specify the precise geolocation of a billing address.
											Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and
											180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: BillingPostalCode
fields.description:
Details for the billing address of this account. The
											maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: BillingState
fields.description:
Details for the billing address. The maximum size is 80
											characters.

fields.name: BillingStateCode
fields.description:
The ISO state code for the contract's billing
											address.

fields.name: BillingStreet
fields.description: Street address for the billing address.

fields.name: CompanySignedDate
fields.description: The date your organization signed the contract.

fields.name: CompanySignedId
fields.description: ID of the user who signed the contract. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContractNumber
fields.description: Number of the contract.

fields.name: ContractTerm
fields.description: Number of months that the contract is valid.

fields.name: CustomerSignedDate
fields.description: The date when the customer signed the contract.

fields.name: CustomerSignedId
fields.description: ID of the Contact who signed this contract. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CustomerSignedTitle
fields.description: Title of the customer who signed the contract.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the contract.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description:
Read-only. Calculated end date of the contract. This
											value is calculated by adding the
												ContractTerm to the
												StartDate. If the
												Auto-calculate Contract End
												Date setting is disabled, the contract
											end date is editable.

fields.name: HasContractCotermination
fields.description:
Indicates whether the contract can be coterminated
												(true) or not
												(false). The default value is false. This field is available with
											Revenue Cloud in API version 65.0 and later.

fields.name: IsPricingContract
fields.description:
Indicates whether the contract has related contract item
											prices (true) or if
											there are no contract item prices for the contract
												(false). This
											field is available with Revenue Cloud in API version
											63.0 and later.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the object has been moved to the
											Recycle Bin (true)
											or not (false). The
											label is Deleted.

fields.name: LastActivityDate
fields.description:
Value is the most recent:
												The due date of the most recent event is logged
												against the record. 

												The due date of the most recently closed task
												associated with the record.

fields.name: LastApprovedDate
fields.description: Last date the contract was approved.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this
											record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this
											record or list view. If this value is null, it’s
											possible that the user only accessed this record or list
											view (LastReferencedDate) but
											didn’t view it.

fields.name: OwnerExpirationNotice
fields.description:
Number of days ahead of the contract end date (15, 30,
											45, 60, 90, and 120). Used to notify the owner in
											advance that the contract is ending.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the user who owns the contract. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description:
ID of the pricebook, if any, associated with this
											contract.

fields.name: PricingSource
fields.description:
Source of the pricing for the contract. Valid values are: 
												LastTransaction

												
PriceBookListPrice—Price Book or
												List Price

											
Available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: RecordTypeId
fields.description: ID of the record type assigned to this object.

fields.name: RenewalTerm2
fields.description:
The default subscription term for renewals. For example,
											if the Renewal Term Unit is months and you want a
											6-month term, set the Renewal Term to 6. Available in
											API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: RenewalTermUnit
fields.description:
The unit of time for a subscription term. Valid values are: 
												
Annual—UI label is
												Years


												Months

												
Quarterly—Available in API
												version 61.0 and later.

												
Semi-Annual—Available in API
												version 61.0 and later.

											
Available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: ShippingAddress
fields.description:
The compound form of the shipping address. Read-only.
											See Address Compound Fields for details on
											compound address fields.

fields.name: ShippingCity
fields.description:
Details of the shipping address. City maximum size is 40
											characters.

fields.name: ShippingCountry
fields.description:
Details of the shipping address. Country maximum size is
											80 characters.

fields.name: ShippingCountryCode
fields.description:
The ISO country code for the contract's shipping
											address.

fields.name: ShippingGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
The accuracy of the geocode for the shipping
											address. Valid values are: 
												Address

												Block

												City

												County

												ExtendedZip

												NearAddress

												Neighborhood

												State

												Street

												Unknown

												Zip

											
Available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: ShippingLatitude
fields.description:
Used with ShippingLongitude to
											specify the precise geolocation of a shipping address.
											Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90
											with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: ShippingLongitude
fields.description:
Used with ShippingLatitude to
											specify the precise geolocation of an address.
											Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and
											180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
fields.description:
Details of the shipping address. The postal code maximum
											size is 20 characters.

fields.name: ShippingState
fields.description:
Details of the shipping address. The maximum size for
											the state is 80 characters.

fields.name: ShippingStateCode
fields.description:
The ISO state code for the contract's shipping
											address.

fields.name: ShippingStreet
fields.description:
The street address of the shipping address. The maximum
											size is 255 characters.

fields.name: SourceQuoteId
fields.description:
ID of the source quote associated with this contract.
											This field is available with Revenue Cloud in API
											version 64.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: SpecialTerms
fields.description: Special terms that apply to the contract.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description:
Start date for this contract. The label is
												Contract Start Date.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The picklist of values that indicate order status. Each
											value is within one of two status categories defined in
												StatusCode. For example, the
											status picklist may contain: Ready to Ship, Shipped,
											Received as values within the Activated
												StatusCode. Valid values are: 
												Activated

												Draft

												In Approval
												Process

											
Available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description:
The status category for the contract. A contract can be
											Draft, InApproval, or Activated. Label is
												Status Category. Valid values are: 
												Activated

												Draft

												InApproval

											
Available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: UnitPriceUplift
fields.description:
Indicates the percentage increase of a line item’s unit
											price. This field is available with Revenue Cloud in API
											version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: ID of the Contact associated with this Contract. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ContractId
fields.description: Required. ID of the Contract. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false).
           Label is Deleted.

fields.name: IsPrimary
fields.description:
Specifies whether this Contact plays the primary role on this Contract (true) or not (false).
           Each contract has one primary contact role. Default is false. Labels is Primary.

fields.name: Role
fields.description:
Name of the role played by the Contact on this Contract, such as Decision Maker,
           Approver, Buyer, and so on. Must be unique—there can't be multiple records in
           which the ContractId, ContactId, and
            Role values are identical. Different contacts can play the same
           role on the same contract. A contact can play different roles on the same contract.

fields.name: AssetId
fields.description:
Required. ID of the Asset associated with the contract
											line item. Must be a valid asset ID.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the contract line item.

fields.name: Discount
fields.description:
The discount for the product as a percentage. When updating, if you specify
												Discount without specifying
												TotalPrice, the
												TotalPrice will be adjusted to
											accommodate the new Discount value,
											and the UnitPrice will be held
											constant. If you specify both Discount and
												Quantity, you must also specify
											either TotalPrice or
												UnitPrice so the system can
											determine which one to automatically
											adjust.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The last day the contract line item is in effect.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this
											record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this
											record or list view. If this value is null, the user
											might have only accessed this record or list view
												(LastReferencedDate) but not
											viewed it.

fields.name: LineItemNumber
fields.description:
Automatically-generated number that identifies the
											contract line item.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description:
Corresponds to the UnitPrice on the
											PricebookEntry that is associated with this line item,
											which can be in the standard pricebook or a custom
											pricebook. A client application can use this information
											to show whether the unit price (or sales price) of the
											line item differs from the pricebook entry list
											price.

fields.name: LocationId
fields.description:
The location associated with the contract line
											item. If you have access to the location entity, it doesn’t
											necessarily mean you can access the location id field.
											To access the location, you must have
												userHasLocation user
											access.

fields.name: ParentContractLineItemId
fields.description: The line item’s parent line item, if it has one.

fields.name: PricebookEntryId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated PricebookEntry. Only exists if Product2 is enabled.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: The product related to the contract line item.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description:
Number of units of the contract line item (product)
											included in the associated service contract.

fields.name: RootContractLineItemId
fields.description:
(Read only) The top-level line item in a contract line
											item hierarchy. Depending on where a line item lies in
											the hierarchy, its root could be the same as its
											parent.

fields.name: ServiceContractId
fields.description:
Required. ID of the ServiceContract associated with the contract line item. Must be a
											valid service contract ID.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The first day the contract line item is in effect.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Status of the contract line item.

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.description:
Contract line item's sales price multiplied by the
												Quantity.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description:
This field is available only for backward compatibility.
											It represents the total price of the
											ContractLineItem If you specify Discount and
												Quantity, this field or
												UnitPrice is required. This field is nillable, but you can't set both
												TotalPrice and
												UnitPrice to null in the same
											update request. To insert the
												TotalPrice for a contract line
											item via the API (given only a unit price and the
											quantity), calculate this field as the unit price
											multiplied by the quantity.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description:
The unit price for the contract line item. In the user
											interface, this field’s value is calculated by
											dividing the total price of the contract line item by
											the quantity listed for that line item. Label is
												Sales Price. This field or TotalPrice is
											required. You can’t specify both. If you specify Discount and
												Quantity, this field or
												TotalPrice is required.

fields.name: CalculationMethod
fields.description:
The
                                 method
                                 used for calculating the contract line outcome’s captured data to
                                 determine the outcome value. Select
                                    Average
                                 or
                                    As
                                    Captured
                                 to calculate the contract line outcome.
                                    Average
                                 calculates the outcome value based on the average of all
                                 data captured to date.
                                    As
                                    Captured
                                 calculates
                                 the outcome value based
                                 on
                                 the asset’s current data at the time of the compliance
                                 check. Possible values are: 
                                    AsCaptured

                                    Average

fields.name: CaptureFrequency
fields.description:
The
                                 frequency at which data capturing and contract compliance check for
                                 the contract line outcome occurs. Possible values are: 
                                    Daily

                                    Monthly

                                    Weekly

fields.name: ComplianceStatus
fields.description:
Indicates if the criteria were met. Compliant–The outcome is
                                 compliant with the contract. Not Compliant–The outcome isn’t
                                 compliant with the contract. Not Available–The outcome’s compliance
                                 information isn’t available yet. Invalid–The outcome isn’t valid
                                 because the option selected for the Criteria Field of the recordset
                                 filter criteria was deleted. To restart the calculation, create a
                                 new contract line outcome. Possible values are: 
                                    Compliant

                                    Invalid

                                    NotAvailable

                                    NotCompliant The default value is NotAvailable.

fields.name: ContractLineItemId
fields.description:
The contract line item associated with the contract line
                                 outcome. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the contract line outcome.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The contract line outcome's data capture end date.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The date and time when the contract line outcome was last
                                 modified. Its UI label is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The date and time when the contract line outcome was last
                                 viewed.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the contract line outcome.

fields.name: NextDataCaptureDate
fields.description:
The
                                 date of the next data capture and compliance check based on the
                                 capture frequency. The date is auto-populated and updated after
                                 each capture

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
The contract line outcome’s owner. By default, the owner is the
                                 user who created the contract line outcome record. Its UI label is
                                 Contract Line Outcome Owner. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: RecordsetFilterCriteriaId
fields.description:
The ID of the recordset filter criteria in which the contract line
                                 outcome’s conditions are defined. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ServiceContractId
fields.description:
The service contract associated with the contract line item and
                                 the contract line outcome. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The contract line outcome's data capture start date.

fields.name: CalculatedValue
fields.description:
The value calculated based on the contract line outcome’s
                                 calculation method and the captured data.

fields.name: CaptureDate
fields.description: The date and time when the data was captured.

fields.name: ContractLineOutcomeId
fields.description:
The contract line outcome associated with the contract line
                                 outcome data record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: KeyPerformanceIndicator
fields.description:
The key performance indicators (fields or asset attributes) that
                                 define the contract line outcome’s compliance status.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The date and time when the contract line outcome data record was
                                 last modified. Its UI label is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The date and time when the contract line outcome data record was
                                 last viewed.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the contract line outcome data record.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The actual value of the key performance indicator.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: Uniquely identifies a picklist value so it can be retrieved without using an id or primary label.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description:
Indicates whether this is the default contract status value (true) or not (false)
           in the picklist.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Label for this contract status value. This display value is the internal label that does not get translated.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description:
Number used to sort this value in the contract status picklist. These numbers are not
           guaranteed to be sequential, as some previous contract status values might have been
           deleted.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description:
Code indicating the status of a contract. One of the following values: 
            Draft

            InApproval

            Activated

           
 Two other values (Terminated and Expired) are defined but are not available for use via the
           API.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.description: ID of the tagged item.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Name of the tag. If this value does not already exist, a new TagDefinition is created
           and becomes the parent of this Tag object. Otherwise, a TagDefinition with the same name
           becomes the parent of this Tag object. Parent relationships are created
           automatically.

fields.name: TagDefinitionId
fields.description: ID of the parent TagDefinition object that owns the tag.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Defines the visibility of a tag. Valid values:
            
Public—The tag can be viewed and
             manipulated by all users in an organization.

            
Personal—The tag can be viewed or
             manipulated only by a user with a matching OwnerId.

fields.name: AnalysisDate
fields.description:
The date when the actual data analysis was done, accounting for
                                 the delay between the refresh start time and the data
                                 analysis.

fields.name: DataModelVersion
fields.description: The data model version generated by Hawking.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: The error message sent by Hawking when a refresh fails.

fields.name: FlowIdentifier
fields.description: Required. The UUID used to track the Hawking flow ID.

fields.name: RefreshDate
fields.description:
Required. The date when the admin started the refresh of their ECI
                                 data for processing.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Required. The status of the refresh or run. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    FAILED

                                    PARTIALLY_FAILED

                                    PROCESSING

                                    SUCCESS

fields.name: TotalCalls
fields.description:
The total number of calls that were analyzed for Sales
                                 Signals.

fields.name: TotalMentions
fields.description: The total number of mentions or keywords that were analyzed.

fields.name: CallPercentage
fields.description:
Required. The percentage of calls that apply to a topic,  out of
                                 the total number of calls that were analyzed.

fields.name: Category
fields.description:
Required. A classification or grouping used to filter topics. This
                                 field is used in conjunction with Keyword.

fields.name: ConvAnalysisSummaryId
fields.description:
Required. The conversation analysis summary associated with the
                                 topic. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: GenerationsIdentifier
fields.description:
Required. The ID used to track the LLM-generated response for
                                 feedback purposes.

fields.name: Keyword
fields.description:
Required. A specific word used in conjunction with
                                    Category to filter topics. For example,
                                    Product:Salesforce, where
                                 the keyword is Salesforce.

fields.name: MentionCount
fields.description:
Required. The number of call insights associated with the
                                 topic.

fields.name: Order
fields.description:
Required. A numerical value used to sort topics in a
                                 sequence.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description: Required. A detailed explanation of the topic.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Required. The title of the topic that describes it.

fields.name: TopicSentiment
fields.description:
The sentiment of the topic, whether it’s negative, neutral, or
                                 positive.

fields.name: TotalCalls
fields.description: The total number of calls analyzed for the topic.

fields.name: TotalCallsForCategoryKeyword
fields.description:
The total number of calls analyzed for category:keyword. Multiple
                                    topics can be under a single category:keyword.

fields.name: TotalMentionsForCategoryKeyword
fields.description: The total number of mentions analyzed for category:keyword.

fields.name: TurnIdentifier
fields.description:
UUID that is generated and used to track a group of LLM-generated
                                 content.

fields.name: BulletGenerationsIdentifier
fields.description:
The generation ID used to track the LLM-generated response for
                                 feedback purposes.

fields.name: CallId
fields.description:
The unique identifier of the voice or video call that corresponds
                                 to the entry. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: ConvAnalysisTopicId
fields.description:
Required. The conversation analysis topic associated with the
                                 entry. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: SnippetStartTime
fields.description:
The timestamp when the call is associated with the current topic
                                 entry.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description:
The LLM-generated call summary that corresponds to the parent
                                 topic.

fields.name: ConversationChannelId
fields.description:
The record ID of the channel used to initialize the conversation.
                                 This can either be a messaging channel for the Messaging product or
                                 a call center for the Service Cloud Voice product. Available in API
                                 version 50.0 and later.Service Cloud Voice is now Salesforce
                                    Voice. You may see references to Service Cloud Voice in
                                    Salesforce applications and documentation.

fields.name: ConversationIdentifier
fields.description: A unique identifier generated for the conversation.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: The date and time that a conversation ends.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The internal name of the conversation. The value can be the
                                 Salesforce record ID of the conversation or an auto-incremented
                                 number string.  If your integration sorts records by Name, use
                                    CreatedDate instead.

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: The date and time that a conversation starts.

fields.name: Action
fields.description:
The specific action performed using the Conversation Service
                                 API. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    Delete

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Autogenerated name of the logs.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description:
Name of the operation that triggered the Conversation Srevice API
                                 log.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Owner ID that triggered the Conversation API log. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: RequestedById
fields.description: The User ID that triggered the Conversation API log. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RequestedDate
fields.description:
The date of the operation that triggered the Conversation API
                                 log.

fields.name: RequestedEntityIdentifier
fields.description: The entity ID being created, updated, or deleted.

fields.name: RequestedEntityType
fields.description:
The type of entity being created, updated, or deleted. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
MessagingEndUser—Messaging End User

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of the Conversation API operation. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    Completed

                                    Enqueued

                                    Failed

                                    
InProgress—In Progress

                                    Requested

fields.name: ConversationContextEntryName
fields.description: The autogenerated number of the entry.

fields.name: CustomDetailContextKey
fields.description:
The key or name of the pre-chat field specified by the admin in the pre-chat
                      implementation, for example, customer_email.

fields.name: CustomDetailContextValue
fields.description:
The value entered in the pre-chat field by a user before starting the
                      chat.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The Conversation ID this entry is associated with.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsCustomChannelParameters
fields.description:
Indicates whether admins can configure custom parameters and
                                 parameter mappings for messaging channels. Custom parameters and
                                 parameter mappings are used to pass additional information at
                                 runtime to Omni-Channel flows. The default value is
                                    false. Available in API version 61.0.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsDoubleOptInConsent
fields.description:
Indicates whether the channel supports (true)
                                 the Double Opt-In consent level. The default value is
                                    false. If set to true, then
                                    capabilitiesSupportsExplicitConsent must
                                 also be set to true. This field is optional and isn’t supported for
                                 Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging. It's only supported for Bring
                                 Your Own Channel for CCaaS.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsExplicitConsent
fields.description:
Indicates whether the channel supports (true)
                                 the Explicit Opt-In consent level. This field is optional.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsImplicitConsent
fields.description:
Indicates whether the channel supports (true)
                                 the Implicit Opt-In consent level. This value is required and must
                                 always be set to true. The default value is false.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsIsoCountryCode
fields.description:
Indicates whether the channel supports (true)
                                 ISO country codes. The default value is false.

fields.name: CapabilitiesSupportsKeywords
fields.description:
Indicates whether the channel supports (true)
                                 keywords. The default value is false.

fields.name: ConnectedAppOauthLink
fields.description:
DO NOT SET OR CHANGE THIS VALUE. This value is automatically
                                 generated. This field represents the OAuth link for the external
                                 client app (ECA) or connected app if the ConnectedAppType is
                                    Partner. This is a string
                                 identifier to the ECA or connected app containing the partner Org
                                 ID and the consumer ID minus the key prefixes.

fields.name: ConnectedAppType
fields.description:
The owner of the external client app (ECA) or connected app used
                                 to manage authentication between Salesforce Interaction Service and
                                 the Messaging or CCaaS partner’s system. Possible values are: 
                                 Partner

                                 Customer The default value is Partner. If set to Partner, the partner creates the ECA
                                 or connected app and includes it in their managed package. If set
                                 to Customer, the admin creates the ECA or
                                 connected app. Available in API version 62.0.

fields.name: ConsentOwner
fields.description:
The system the customer uses to manage consent levels. Possible values are: 
                                    Partner

                                    Salesforce The default value is Salesforce. For example, if set to Salesforce, consent
                                 levels are managed by the Salesforce system. If set to
                                    Partner, consent levels are managed by the
                                 partner’s telephony system. For Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging, this value must be set
                                 to Salesforce.

fields.name: ConversationVendorInfoId
fields.description:
The
                                    ConversationChannelDefinition.ConversationVendorInfoId
                                 value used to link this record to the ConversationVendorInfo
                                 record. For example, 0m8000000000000123. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: customEventChnlAddrIdField
fields.description:
The mapping field that points to the custom field used to point to
                                 the ChannelAddressIdentifier field. This field is deprecated in API version 60.0 and will be removed
                                 in API version 61.0. Use a combination of
                                    customEventTypeField and
                                    customEventPayloadField instead.

fields.name: CustomEventPayloadField
fields.description:
The mapping field that points to the custom field used to point to
                                 the Payload field in the format
                                    <orgNamespace>__<CustomFieldName>__c.
                                 This is the API name of the custom Payload field in the custom
                                 platform event. For example, devorg__Payload__c.

fields.name: customEventRecipientField
fields.description:
The mapping field that points to the custom field used to point to
                                 the Recipient field. This field is deprecated in API version 60.0 and will be removed
                                 in API version 61.0. Use a combination of
                                    customEventTypeField and
                                    customEventPayloadField instead.

fields.name: CustomEventTypeField
fields.description:
The mapping field that points to the custom field used to point to
                                 the Platform event type (EventType) field, in the format
                                    <orgNamespace>__<CustomFieldName>__c.
                                 This is the API name of the custom EventType field in the custom
                                 platform event. For example, devorg__EventType__c.

fields.name: CustomIconId
fields.description:
For Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging and Bring Your Own
                                 Channel for CCaaS, this field represents the name of the status
                                 resource image used to identify the channel integration, such as a
                                 channel logo. For the best results, set the image size to 50px x
                                 50px and save the image in SVG file format. This field is optional.
                                 Available in API version 61.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CustomPlatformEvent
fields.description:
The API name of the custom platform event created for the
                                 Interaction Service API in the format
                                    <orgNamespace>__<CustomPlatformEventName>__e.
                                 For example, devorg__TestEvent__e.

fields.name: CustomerConnectedAppOauthLink
fields.description:
DO NOT SET OR CHANGE THIS VALUE. This value is automatically
                                 generated. This field represents the OAuth link for the external
                                 client app or connected app created by an admin if the
                                 ConnectedAppType is Customer.
                                 Available in API version 62.0.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the custom metadata type object in the API in
                                 the format
                                    <Prefix>_<ConversationChannelDefinition>,
                                 where Prefix matches the prefix you gave to the
                                 name of the Interaction Service external client app or connected
                                 app. For example, Partner1_ChannelDefinition1, where Partner1 is
                                 the prefix and ChannelDefinition1 is the given name.

fields.name: EventCapabilitiesIsInboundAcknwOptionExposed
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner supports read receipts and delivery
                                 receipts for inbound messages (true) or whether the partner doesn’t support these
                                 inbound acknowledgments and the functionality is hidden from the
                                 Salesforce admin in the Messaging settings (false). The default value is
                                    false. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later. Use this
                                 field instead of IsInboundReceiptsEnabled.

fields.name: EventCapabilitiesIsProgressIndicatorOptExposed
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner supports progress indicators for AI
                                 agents (true) or whether the
                                 partner doesn’t support them and the functionality is hidden from
                                 the Salesforce admin in the Messaging settings (false). The default value is
                                 false. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later.

fields.name: EventCapabilitiesIsRoutingWorkResultSupported
fields.description:
Indicates whether the Routing Work Result event is sent as a
                                 Custom Platform event (true)
                                 or not (false). The default
                                 value is false. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later. Use this
                                 field instead of IsRoutingWorkResultEnabled.

fields.name: EventCapabilitiesIsTypingIndicatorOptionHidden
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner doesn’t support typing indicators
                                 for outbound messages and the functionality is hidden from the
                                 Salesforce admin in the Messaging settings (true) or whether outbound typing
                                 indicators are supported by the partner (false). The default value is
                                    false, meaning the outbound
                                 typing indicator feature is supported by default. To disable the
                                 outbound typing indicator feature, set this value to true. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later. Use this
                                 field instead of IsTypingIndicatorDisabled.

fields.name: IsConferenceSupported
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner supports conferencing for Bring Your
                                 Own Channel (true), or not
                                 (false). With conferencing, more than two
                                 participants are allowed in a Messaging session. The default is
                                 false. This field is available in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: IsInboundReceiptsEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner supports read receipts and delivery
                                 receipts for inbound messages (true) or whether the partner doesn’t support these
                                 inbound acknowledgements and the functionality is hidden from the
                                 Salesforce admin in the Messaging settings (false). The default value is
                                    false. Available in API versions 63.0 to 65.0. In API version 66.0 and
                                 later, this field is removed. Use
                                    EventCapabilitiesIsInboundAcknwOptionExposed
                                 instead.

fields.name: IsRoutingWorkResultEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether the Routing Work Result event is sent as a
                                 Custom Platform event or not. The default value is false. Available in API versions 64.0 and 65.0. In API version 66.0 and
                                 later, this field is removed. Use
                                    EventCapabilitiesIsRoutingWorkResultSupported
                                 instead.

fields.name: IsTypingIndicatorDisabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether the partner doesn’t support typing indicators
                                 for outbound messages and the functionality is hidden from the
                                 Salesforce admin in the Messaging settings (true)
                                 or whether outbound typing indicators are supported by the partner
                                 (false). The default value is
                                 false, meaning the outbound typing indicator
                                 feature is supported by default. To disable the outbound typing
                                 indicator feature, set this value to true. Available in API versions 63.0 to 65.0. In API version 66.0 and
                                 later, this field is removed. Use
                                    EventCapabilitiesIsTypingIndicatorOptionHidden
                                 instead.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description:
The UI label name for the custom metadata type object in the API.
                                 This name appears in several places in the UI, so include the
                                 partner channel name for easy identification. For example, Channel
                                 Definition 1.

fields.name: MaxParticipantsForCnfrOverride
fields.description:
Specifies the limit for how many participants can be in a
                                 messaging conference. If set, this field overrides the platform
                                 limit for the number of participants in a conference. If not set or
                                 if set to a value higher than the messaging platform limit, the
                                 limit defaults to the messaging platform limit of how many
                                 participants can be in a messaging conference at one time. This field is available in API version 64.0 and later.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this object. Each
                                 Developer Edition org that creates a managed package has a unique
                                 namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You can refer to a
                                 component in a managed package by using the
                                    namespacePrefix__componentName
                                 notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the following values.
                                    In Developer Edition orgs,
                                          NamespacePrefix is set to the
                                       namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it,
                                       unless an object is in an installed managed package. In that
                                       case, the object has the namespace prefix of the installed
                                       managed package. This field’s value is the namespace prefix
                                       of the Developer Edition org of the package developer.

                                    In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs,
                                          NamespacePrefix is set only for
                                       objects that are part of an installed managed package. All
                                       other objects have no namespace prefix.

                                 
NamespacePrefix is null if the publisher
                                 is Salesforce.

fields.name: RoutingOwner
fields.description:
The system the customer uses to manage routing for Bring Your Own
                                 Channel for Messaging or Bring Your Own Channel for CCaaS. Possible values are: 
                                    Partner

                                    Salesforce The default value is Salesforce. For example, if set to Salesforce, routing is
                                 managed by the Salesforce system. If set to
                                    Partner, routing is managed by the partner’s
                                 system. For Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging, this value must be set
                                 to Salesforce.

fields.name: ActorId
fields.description:
The ID of the author. The possible values can be null or any ID in the following
                                 domain set: 
                                    BotDefinition

                                    LiveChatVisitor

                                    MessagingEndUser

                                    User This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: ActorName
fields.description: The name of the author sending the message or event.

fields.name: ActorType
fields.description:
The author of this entry in the chat history. The valid values include:
                                    Agent

                                    Bot

                                    EndUser

                                    Supervisor

                                    System

fields.name: ClientDuration
fields.description:
The length in milliseconds for the entry. This field is used with
                                 voice messages and other applicable use cases. This value may be 0
                                 if not set by the client. This field is available in API version
                                 51.0 and later.

fields.name: ClientTimestamp
fields.description:
The timestamp sent by the client when it generated the entry. This
                                 field is available in API version 51.0 and later.

fields.name: ConversationId
fields.description: The MessagingSession ID this entry belongs to. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: EntryEndTime
fields.description:
The timestamp that this entry ended in the chat history. This
                                 field is available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: EntryTime
fields.description: The timestamp of this entry in the chat history.

fields.name: EntryTimeMilliSecs
fields.description:
The milliseconds value for the time when an entry was received by
                                 the server. Note that the related EntryTime
                                 field does not provide millisecond accuracy. This field is
                                 available in API version 51.0 and later.

fields.name: EntryType
fields.description:
The type of entry in the chat history. Can be a message (text) or an event. The possible
                                 values include:
                                    Text

                                    AdminOptedIn

                                    AdminOptedOut

                                    BotEscalated

                                    ChatbotClosedIdleSession

                                    
ChatbotEndedChatByAction—Conversation
                                       ended by automated action

                                    
ChatbotEndedTransferNotConfigured—Conversation
                                       ended because transfer fail is not configured

                                    ChatbotEstablished

                                    ChatbotNotEstablished

                                    EndUserOptedIn

                                    EndUserOptedOut

fields.name: HasAttachments
fields.description:
Indicates whether a message has attachments associated with it
                                    (true) or not (false).

fields.name: Message
fields.description:
The message or event sent by the author. In ConversationEntry
                                 records for enhanced Messaging channels or Messaging for In-App and
