fields.description: ID of the user’s Profile. Only populated if the related record is a user. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: The name suffix of the user, contact, or lead.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The title of the user, for example CFO or CEO.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
A list of the types of sObject that can be an owner of this object. You can use this field to filter on a
                      type of owner, for example, return only the leads owned by a user.

fields.name: Username
fields.description:
Contains the name that a user enters to log into the API or the user
                      interface. The value for this field is in the form of an email address, and is
                      only populated if the related record is a user.

fields.name: UserRole
fields.description:
Name of the Role played by the user. Only populated for
                      user rows.

fields.name: UserRoleId
fields.description: The ID of the user role associated with this object. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AuthProviderId
fields.description:
Salesforce ID of the authentication provider, which
												defines the service that provides the login process
												and approves access to the external system.

											Only users with the “Customize Application” and
												“Manage AuthProviders” permissions can view this
												field.

											This field is a relationship field.

											This field is only valid for legacy named credentials.

											This field was first available in API version 39.0, this field is deprecated in API
												version 56.0.

fields.name: AuthTokenEndpointUrl
fields.description:
The URL where SON Web Tokens (JWTs) are exchanged for
											access tokens. This field is only valid for legacy named
												credentials. 

											This field was first available in API version 46.0, this field is deprecated in API
												version 56.0.

fields.name: CalloutOptionsAllowMergeFieldsInBody
fields.description:
For Apex callouts, indicates whether the code can use
											merge fields to populate HTTP request bodies with org
												data.This field is available in API version 35.0
												and later.

fields.name: CalloutOptionsAllowMergeFieldsInHeader
fields.description:
For Apex callouts, indicates whether the code can use
											merge fields to populate HTTP headers with org
												data.This field is available in API version 35.0
												and later.

fields.name: CalloutOptionsGenerateAuthorizationHeader
fields.description:
Indicates whether Salesforce automatically generates a
											standard authorization header for each callout to the
											named credential–defined endpoint.This field
												is available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin
											with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming
											conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a
											subscriber’s organization. Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

fields.name: Endpoint
fields.description:
The root URL of the endpoint.This field is only valid for legacy named credentials.
												
This field is deprecated in API version
												56.0.

fields.name: JwtAudience
fields.description:
External service or other allowed recipients for the JSON Web Token. Written as JSON,
											with a quoted string for a single audience and an array
											of quoted strings for multiple audiences. Single
											audience example: “aud1”. Multiple audiences example:
												[”aud1”, “aud2”,
												“aud3”]. This field is only valid for
												legacy named credentials. 
This field was
												first available in API version 46.0, this field is
												deprecated in API version 56.0.

fields.name: JwtFormulaSubject
fields.description:
Formula string calculating the JSON Web Token’s subject. API names and constant
											strings, in single quotes, can be included. Allows a
											dynamic Subject unique per user requesting the token.
											For example, 'User='+$User.Id. Use this field when
												PrincipalType is set to
												PerUser. Corresponds to
											Per User Subject in the user interface. This field is
												only valid for legacy named credentials. 
This
												field was first available in API version 46.0, this
												field is deprecated in API version 56.0.

fields.name: JwtIssuer
fields.description:
Specify who issued the JSON Web Token using a case-sensitive string. This field is
												only valid for legacy named credentials. 
This
												field was first available in API version 46.0, this
												field is deprecated in API version 56.0.

fields.name: JwtTextSubject
fields.description:
Static text, without quotes, that specifies the JSON Web Token subject. Use this field
											when PrincipalType is set to
												NamedUser. Corresponds
											to Named Principal Subject in the user interface.
												This field is only valid for legacy named
												credentials. 
This field was first available
												in API version 46.0, this field is deprecated in API
												version 56.0.

fields.name: JwtValidityPeriodSeconds
fields.description:
The number of seconds that the JSON Web Token is valid.This field is only valid for
												legacy named credentials. 
This field was
												first available in API version 46.0, this field is
												deprecated in API version 56.0.

fields.name: Language
fields.description:
The language of the
											MasterLabel.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The label for the named credential. This display value is the internal label that doesn’t get translated.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this
											object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a
											managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15
											characters. You can refer to a component in a managed
											package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
											notation.

fields.name: PrincipalType
fields.description:
Tracks users who are accessing the external system. Anonymous implies that a user identity
											isn’t specified for external system access. Named Principal uses
											one user identity for all users to access the external
												system.This field is only valid for legacy named
												credentials. 
This field is deprecated in API
												version 56.0.

fields.name: BotIdentifier
fields.description: The ID of the bot.

fields.name: BotSessionIdentifier
fields.description: The bot session ID.

fields.name: CallerPackageNamespace
fields.description:
If an Apex callout using a Named Credential endpoint is initiated
                                 from a package, then this field contains the package’s namespace.
                                 If the callout isn’t initiated from a package, then this field is
                                 empty.

fields.name: ClientIp
fields.description:
The IP address of the client that is using Salesforce services. A
                                 Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown
                                 as “Salesforce.com IP”.

fields.name: CpuTime
fields.description:
The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This
                                 field indicates the amount of activity taking place in the app
                                 server layer.

fields.name: LoginKey
fields.description:
The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login
                                 session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout
                                 event or the user session expiring.

fields.name: NamedCredentialName
fields.description:
The name of the named credential that’s the endpoint of the Apex
                                 callout.

fields.name: PlannerIdentifier
fields.description: The ID of the agent planner.

fields.name: RequestIdentifier
fields.description:
The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain
                                 one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same
                                 REQUEST_ID.

fields.name: RunTime
fields.description: The amount of time that the request took in milliseconds..

fields.name: SessionKey
fields.description:
The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify
                                 all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in
                                 again, a new session is started.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT.

fields.name: Uri
fields.description: The URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

fields.name: UserIdentifier
fields.description:
The 15-character ID of the user who is using Salesforce services
                                 through the UI or the API.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of this namespace registry entry.

fields.name: NamespaceOrg
fields.description:
The org ID of the Developer Edition org where you've
											registered the namespace you want to link.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that you want to link to the
											scratch org.

fields.name: DeveloperName
properties:
UpdateCreate and Update
												are available in API version 45.0 and
											later.
fields.description:
The unique name of the object in the API. This name can
											contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters,
											and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a
											letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore,
											and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed
											packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on
											package installations. With this field, a developer can
											change the object’s name in a managed package and the
											changes are reflected in a subscriber’s
											organization.

fields.name: Language
properties:
and Update are available in API
												version 45.0 and later.
fields.description:
Language for the navigation menu. Valid values are:
												Chinese (Simplified): zh_CN


												Chinese (Traditional): zh_TW


												Danish: da


												Dutch: nl_NL


												English: en_US


												Finnish: fi


												French: fr


												German: de


												Italian: it


												Japanese: ja


												Korean: ko


												Norwegian: no


												Portuguese (Brazil): pt_BR


												Russian: ru


												Spanish: es


												Spanish (Mexico): es_MX Spanish (Mexico) defaults to
												Spanish for customer-defined translations.

												Swedish: sv


												Thai: th
												The Salesforce user interface is fully translated
												to Thai, but Help is in English.

fields.name: MasterLabel
properties:
UpdateCreate and Update
												are available in API version 45.0 and
											later.
fields.description: Label for the navigation menu.

fields.name: NetworkId
properties:
SortCreate is
												available in API version 45.0 and later. Update is
												available in API versions 45.0 to 47.0.
fields.description: ID of the Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: AccessRestriction
fields.description:
Determines if the menu item is available to guest users who aren’t required to log in
											to the Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: DefaultListViewId
fields.description:
If the value of the Type field is
											SalesforceObject, the value is the ID of the default
											list view for the object.

fields.name: DraftRowID
fields.description:
The ID of the draft navigation menu item. The ID is
											unique within your organization.

fields.name: Label
fields.description:
The text that appears in the navigation menu for this
											item.

fields.name: NavigationLinkSetId
fields.description: The navigation menu that this item is included in.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The parent navigation menu.

fields.name: Position
fields.description:
The location of the menu item in the navigation
											menu.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Represents if the navigation menu item is published or not. The values can only be
											DRAFT, LIVE, or null. In API versions 42 and earlier, if
											the Status field is not set, the field defaults to LIVE.
											When queried and Status is not part of the query filter,
											only the NavigationMenuItem objects with a status of
											LIVE return. In API versions 43 and later, if the Status
											field is not set, the field defaults to DRAFT. When
											queried and Status is not part of the query filter, all
											NavigationMenuItem objects return regardless of
											status.

fields.name: Target
fields.description:
If Type is ExternalLink or
											InternalLink, the target is the URL that the link points
											to. For ExternalLink, your entry looks like this:
												https://salesforce.com.
											For InternalLink, use a relative URL, such as
												/contactsupport.

fields.name: TargetPrefs
fields.description:
If
												Type is ExternalLink,
											determines whether a navigation menu item opens in the
											same tab.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The type of navigation menu item. The available values are:
												SalesforceObject—Available objects
												include accounts, cases, contacts, and custom
												objects.

												ExternalLink—Links to a URL outside of your Experience Cloud site. For
												example,
												https://salesforce.com.

												Event—An event, such as logging in, logging out, or switching accounts. Event
												is internal only and can’t be used in custom
												components.

												GlobalAction—Enables users to create
												object records, but the new record has no
												relationship with other records.

												InternalLink—Links to a relative URL inside your Experience Cloud site. For
												example,
												/contactsupport.

												NavigationalTopic—A dropdown list with links to the navigational topics in
												your Experience Cloud site.

												SystemLink—A system link, such as a link to Experience Builder, Workspaces,
												or Salesforce setup.

fields.name: Language
fields.description:
The language of the translated navigation menu item.
												The picklist contains the following supported
												languages:

											
												Chinese (Simplified): zh_CN


												Chinese (Traditional): zh_TW


												Danish: da


												Dutch: nl_NL


												English: en_US


												Finnish: fi


												French: fr


												German: de


												Italian: it


												Japanese: ja


												Korean: ko


												Norwegian: no


												Portuguese (Brazil): pt_BR


												Russian: ru


												Spanish: es


												Spanish (Mexico): es_MX Spanish (Mexico) defaults to
												Spanish for customer-defined translations.

												Swedish: sv


												Thai: th
												The Salesforce user interface is fully translated
												to Thai, but Help is in English.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this
											object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a
											managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15
											characters. You can refer to a component in a managed
											package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
											notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the
												following values.

												In Developer Edition orgs,
												NamespacePrefix is set to the
												namespace prefix of the org for all objects that
												support it, unless an object is in an installed
												managed package. In that case, the object has the
												namespace prefix of the installed managed package.
												This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the
												Developer Edition org of the package
												developer.

												In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs,
												NamespacePrefix is set only
												for objects that are part of an installed managed
												package. All other objects have no namespace
												prefix.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description:
The ID of the navigation menu item that this translated
											value applies to.

fields.name: Value
fields.description:
The translated text for the navigation menu item. Label
											is Translation Text.

fields.name: AllowedExtensions
fields.description:
Specifies the
												types of files allowed in your site. This list of
												file types lets you control what members upload and
												also prevents spammers from polluting your site with
												inappropriate files. Available in API version
											36.0 and later.Separate file types with a comma (for
												example: jpg,docx,txt). You
												can enter lowercase and uppercase letters. You can
												enter up to 1,000 characters. To allow all file
												types, leave this field empty.

fields.name: CaseCommentEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of
												the email template used when submitting a comment on
												a case. This field is available in API version
											28.0 and later.

fields.name: ChangePasswordEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of
												the email template used when notifying users that
												their password has been reset.

fields.name: ChgEmailVerNewEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the
												email template used when notifying users that their
												email address has been changed. This email is sent
												to the user’s new email address.

fields.name: ChgEmailVerOldEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of
												the email template used when notifying users that
												their email address has been changed. This email is
												sent to the user’s old email address.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the site.

fields.name: DeviceActEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID
												of the email template used when users log in from an
												unrecognized browser, app, or IP address. The email
												contains a one-time password that users enter to
												verify their identity.This field is
												available in API version 53.0 and later.

fields.name: EmailFooterLogoId
fields.description:
ID of the
												Document object that displays as an image in the
												footer of Chatter emails.

fields.name: EmailFooterText
fields.description:
Text that displays
												in the footer of Chatter emails.

fields.name: EmailSenderAddress
fields.description:
Read only. Email
												address from which emails are sent.

Note
To
												change the EmailSenderAddress
												value, you must first specify
												NewSenderAddress, which
												triggers the sending of an address change
												verification email. After you complete the address
												verification process,
												EmailSenderAddress changes to
												the specified
												NewSenderAddress.

fields.name: EmailSenderName
fields.description:
Name from which
												emails are sent.

fields.name: enableImageOptimizationCDN
fields.description:
The setting that optimizes cached images for guest
												users on all devices when a site uses Salesforce’s
												CDN for Digital Experiences.This field is
												available in API version 56.0 and later.

fields.name: FirstActivationDate
fields.description:
The date the
												site was first activated.This field is
												available in API version 34.0 and later. If the site
												was activated or inactive before the release of API
												version 34.0, this field returns the date that the
												site was first created.

fields.name: ForgotPasswordEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of
												the email template used when users forget their
												password.

fields.name: HeadlessForgotPasswordTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the email template to use with the Headless Forgot
											Password Flow.This field is available in API version
												57.0 and later.

fields.name: HeadlessRegistrationTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the email template to use for identity
											verification during the Headless Registration
												Flow.This field is available in API version 59.0
												and later.

fields.name: LockoutEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the
												email template used when users try to reset their
												password after locking themselves out because of too
												many login attempts.
											This field is available in API version 43.0 and
												later.

fields.name: MaxFileSizeKb
fields.description:
Specifies the maximum
												file size (in KBs) that members can upload in your
												site. Available in API version 36.0 and
												later.Enter
												a number between 3072 KB and your org’s maximum file
												size. To use the default limit of 2 GB, leave this
												field empty.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the site.

fields.name: NewSenderAddress
fields.description:
Email address that
												has been entered as the new value for
												EmailSenderAddress but hasn’t
												been verified yet. After a user has requested to
												change the sender email address and has successfully
												responded to the verification email, the
												NewSenderAddress value
												overwrites the value in
												EmailSenderAddress. This
												value becomes the email address from which emails
												are sent.

Note

												
												If verification is pending for a new email
												address and you set
												NewSenderAddress to null, the
												verification request is canceled.

												
NewSenderAddress is
												automatically set to null after
												EmailSenderAddress has been
												set to the new verified address.

												If verification is pending for a new email
												address, and you specify a different new address
												for this field, only the latest value is retained
												and used for verification.

fields.name: OptionsActionOverrideEnabled
fields.description:
Override the action that occurs when users click a
											default button, like New or Edit, with a Lightning
											component. For example, show a custom window instead of
											the one that Salesforce provides. Assign action
											overrides in the Object Manager. In the UI, this setting
											is available in the Administration Workspace, under Administration | Preferences under Experience Management This field
												is available in API version 49.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsAllowInternalUserLogin
fields.description:
Specifies whether
												internal users can log in with their internal
												credentials on the site login page.
											This field is available in API version 37.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsAllowMembersToFlag
fields.description:
Determines whether users
												can flag posts, comments, or files as
												inappropriate.This field is available in API
												version 29.0 and later. The ability to flag files is
												available in version 30.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsApexCDNCachingEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether public data from @wire calls to Apex
											methods is cached only for guest users. This setting
											applies only to sites using Salesforce's CDN for Digital
												Experiences.This field is available in API
												version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsDirectMessagesEnabled
fields.description:
Controls the availability of direct messages in an
											Experience Builder site.This field is available in
												API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsEmbeddedLoginEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether the Embedded Login feature is enabled
											in a site. When true, Embedded Login is turned on.This
												field is available in API version 61.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsEnableTalkingAboutStats
fields.description:
Determines whether site users see how many people are
											discussing a topic. The number of people discussing the
											topic appears as the user types the topic and the system
											gives topic suggestions.This field is available in
												API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsEnableTopicAssignmentRules
fields.description:
When true, displays knowledgeable people in key areas,
											for example, on Topic Detail
											pages.

fields.name: OptionsExpFriendlyUrlsAsDefault
fields.description:
When true, URL slugs are on by default for 
												Product and Category pages of LWR Commerce
												stores (available in API version 58.0 and
												later)

												Custom object pages on enhanced LWR sites
												(available in API version 60.0 and later)

												Account and contact pages on enhanced LWR sites
												(available in API version 61.0 and later)

fields.name: OptionsExperienceBundleBasedSnaOverrideEnabled
fields.description:
When true, the Service Not Available Page is an
											auto-generated Experience Builder-based page. When
											false, the Service Not Available page uses a static
											resource page that is set in Workspaces | Administration | Pages. The default value is true. Available in
											API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsGatherCustomerSentimentData
fields.description:
When true, collects data about user likes, upvotes, and
											downvotes.

fields.name: OptionsGuestChatterEnabled
fields.description:
Specifies whether guest
												users can access public Chatter groups in the site
												without logging in.

fields.name: OptionsGuestFileAccessEnabled
fields.description:
When true, lets guest users view asset files and CMS
											content that’s available to the site. Guest users can
											access shared asset files and published CMS content
											that’s made for external use, even if it isn’t used.
											Shared asset files include images that are associated
											with topics, recognition badges, branding, and account
											branding. This preference is automatically enabled if
											public access is enabled at the page or site level in
											Experience
											Builder.

fields.name: OptionsGuestMemberVisibility
fields.description:
When true, lets guest users see who else is part of the
											site, including non-guest users. In the UI, this setting
											appears in the Administration Workspace under Administration | Preferences .Available in API version 47.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsHeadlessFrgtPswEnabled
fields.description:
When true, Headless
											Forgot Password Flow is enabled.This field is
												available in API version 57.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsImageOptimizationCDNEnabled
fields.description:
When true, cached
											images are optimized to suit any device that guest users
											use to access your site. This feature is available only
											for sites that use Salesforce’s CDN for Digital
											Experiences. In the UI, this setting appears in the
											Administration Workspace under Administration | Preferences.Available in API version 56.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsInvitationsEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether users can invite others to the
											site.

fields.name: OptionsKnowledgeableEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether users can see knowledgeable people
											for topics and endorse people for topics.

fields.name: OptionsLWRExperienceConnectedAppEnabled
fields.description:
When true, enhances the performance and scalability of
											Connect API calls made from Lightning web components in
											an enhanced LWR site. This field is available in API
											version 58.0 and later. Note
This feature is a Beta Service. Customer may opt
												to try such Beta Service in its sole discretion. Any
												use of the Beta Service is subject to the applicable
												Beta Services Terms provided at Agreements and
												Terms.

fields.name: OptionsMemberVisibility
fields.description:
Controls user visibility on a per-site basis. If true,
											the See other members of this site preference is enabled
											for the selected site. This field is available in API
											version 45.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsMobileImageOptimizationEnabled
fields.description:
If true, file asset images are optimized for mobile
											display. This field is available in API version 45.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OptionsNetworkSentimentAnalysis
fields.description:
If true, enables sentiment analysis in a site. In the
											UI, this setting is available in the Administration
											Workspace, under Administration | Preferences. This field is available in API version
											40.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsNicknameDisplayEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether user nicknames display instead of
											their first and last names in most places in the
												site.A few restrictions to keep in mind about
												nickname display:
												Records and user lookups on records show full
												names. Keep in mind, though, that you can control
												record and user visibility with sharing
												rules.

												Mobile notifications in the Salesforce mobile
												app show full names. You can turn off mobile
												notifications in the app to avoid this
												display.

												Searches by first, last, and full names aren’t
												restricted and return matches, but the search
												results display only nicknames. Global search
												auto-complete recommendations show any first,
												last, and full names that the user has searched by
												or accessed via a record or another location. The
												recent items list also shows first, last, and full
												under the same conditions.

fields.name: OptionsPrivateMessagesEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether users can send and receive Chatter
											messages in the site.

fields.name: OptionsProfileBasedLayoutsForKnowledgeSearchEnabled
fields.description:
When true, provides a grid layout for Knowledge search
											results. With grid layout in place, you can edit search
											profile layouts on the Knowledge object to show and hide
											different search result fields for different profiles.
											When you enable the standard grid layout, search-term
											highlighting isn’t available. This field is available in
											API version 51.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsRecognitionBadgingEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether Recognition Badges is enabled for the
											site.

fields.name: OptionsReputationEnabled
fields.description:
Determines if reputation is calculated and displayed for
											members. This field is available in API version 31.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OptionsReputationRecordConversationsDisabled
fields.description:
Disables the feed on reputation
											records.

fields.name: OptionsSecondaryEmailSenderEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether email messages that contain sensitive
											data are sent from a secondary sender email address
												(true), instead
											of via email relay (false). The default value is false. This field is
											available in API version 67.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSelfRegistrationEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether customers and partners can
											self-register to join the site. Customers and partners
											are users with External Identity, Community, Customer
											Portal, or partner portal licenses. If true, displays a
												Not a member? link on the
											login page that points to the default self-registration
											page. This field is available in API version 28.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OptionsSendWelcomeEmail
fields.description:
Determines
												whether a welcome email is sent when a new user is
												added to the site.

fields.name: OptionsShowAllNetworkSettings
fields.description:
Determines whether settings in Experience Management
											that were hidden based on how you set up your site are
											visible or remain hidden.This field is available in
												API version 33.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSiteAsContainerEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether the site
												is an Experience Builder site (true) or a
												Salesforce Tabs + Visualforce site (false).This field is available in
												API version 29.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsThreadedDiscussionsEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether threaded discussions are enabled
												for the site. Available in API version 44.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OptionsTopicFilteringForKnowledgeSearchEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether topic filtering is enabled for
											Knowledge search.This field is available in API
												version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsTopicSuggestionsEnabled
fields.description:
Enables topic suggestions when users write posts.This
												field is available in API version 41.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsUpDownVoteEnabled
fields.description:
Determines whether up and down voting is enabled for the
												site.This field is available in API version 41.0
												and later.

fields.name: PendingSecondaryEmailAddress
fields.description:
The secondary sender email address that’s pending
											verification. Salesforce doesn’t send emails from this
											address until it’s verified. This field is available in
											API version 67.0 and later.

fields.name: PwdlessRegEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the email template for the welcome email that
											users receive when they sign up with passwordless
											registration. This field is available in API version
											61.0 and later.

fields.name: SelfRegMicroBatchSubErrorEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the profile assigned to users who self-register
											using micro-batchng. Only applies if self-registration
											using micro-batching is enabled for the site. This
												field is available in API version 54.0 and
												later.

fields.name: SelfRegProfileId
fields.description:
ID of the profile assigned
												to users who self-register. Only applies if
												self-registration is enabled for the
												site.This field is available in API version
												29.0 and later.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Status of the
												site. Available values are:
												
Live—The site is online and
												members can access it. Label is
												Published.

												
DownForMaintenance—The site was
												previously published, but was taken offline.
												Members with the Create and Set Up Experiences
												permission can still access the setup for offline
												sites regardless of profile or membership. Members
												aren’t able to access offline sites, but they
												still appear in the user interface dropdown menu
												as SiteName (Offline). Label
												is Offline.

												
UnderConstruction—The site hasn’t
												yet been published. When a user’s profile is
												associated with the site, and they’ve Create and
												Set Up Experiences permission, they can access
												sites in this status.After a site is published,
												it can never be in this status again. Label is
												Preview.

fields.name: UrlPathPrefix
fields.description:
The UrlPathPrefix is a unique string at the end of the
											URL for the site. For example, in the site URL
												MyDomainName.my.site.com/customers,
												customers is the
												UrlPathPrefix.

fields.name: VerificationEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of
												the email template used when users must verify their
												identity, for example, when they log in without a
												password.
											This field is available in API version 44.0 and
												later.

fields.name: VerifiedSecondaryEmailAddress
fields.description:
The verified secondary sender email address. This
												email address is used to send sensitive emails when
												OptionsSecondaryEmailSenderEnabled is
												true. This
												field is available in API version 67.0 and later.

fields.name: WelcomeEmailTemplateId
fields.description:
ID of the
												email template used when sending welcome emails to
												new members.

fields.name: Action
fields.description:
The moderation action a member performed on a post, comment, or file in an Experience
           Cloud site.Values are:
             Flagged as Inappropriate—A member flagged a post, comment, or file as
              inappropriate.

             Flagged as Spam - A member flagged a post, comment, or file as spam.

             Unflagged—A  member removed the flag from a post, comment, or file.

             RemovedFlags—A moderator removed all flags from a post, comment, or
              file.

             DeletedFlaggedItem—A moderator deleted a flagged post, comment, message, or
              file.

             DeletedPendingReviewItem—A moderator deleted a post or comment with pending
              status.

             ModerationRuleFlag—A moderation rule flagged member-generated content.

             ModerationRuleBlock—A moderation rule blocked member-generated content.

             ModerationRuleReplace—A moderation rule replaced member-generated
              content.

             ModerationRuleReview—A moderation rule sent member-generated content to be
              reviewed and approved by a moderator.

             ModerationRuleFreeze—A moderation rule froze a member because they created
              content too frequently within a specific time frame.

             ModerationRuleNotify—A moderation rule notified moderators because a member
              created content too frequently within a specific time frame.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Notes entered by the user.If the entity being tracked is a file, records the
            version number of the file when it was flagged.

fields.name: EntityCreatedById
fields.description: ID of the user that created the entity being tracked.

fields.name: EntityId
fields.description:
The ID of the entity that is being tracked. The following entities are tracked:
           ChatterMessage, ContentDocument, ContentVersion, FeedComment, and FeedItem.

fields.name: EntityType
fields.description:
The key prefix of the entity being
           tracked.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The ID of the item being tracked.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description: ID of the Experience Cloud site where the moderation action was performed.

fields.name: ParentEntityId
fields.description: ID of the parent of the entity on which an action was performed.

fields.name: ParentEntityType
fields.description: The key prefix of the parent of the entity being audited.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of the default Experience Cloud site associated with a user
                      profile.

fields.name: ProfileId
fields.description:
ID of the user profile the default Experience
                        Cloud site is assigned to.

fields.name: CustomOtpDeliveryHandlerId
fields.description:
This field is a relationship field. The ID of a custom one-time password (OTP) delivery handler that
                                 implements the Auth.CustomOneTimePasswordDeliveryHandler
                                 interface.

fields.name: DoesForgotPasswordRequireAuth
fields.description:
Determines whether authentication is required to access Headless
                                 Forgot Password API when a password reset is requested. If true, an access token issued to an
                                 internal integration user in your initial POST request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/forgot_password
                                 endpoint is required. The access token must include the forgot_password scope. The default value is false.

fields.name: DoesPasswordLoginRequireAuth
fields.description:
Determines whether reCAPTCHA is required for headless
                                 username-password login that uses the OAuth 2.0 for First-Party
                                 Applications draft protocol.

fields.name: DoesPwdlessLoginRequireAuth
fields.description:
Determines whether authentication is required to access Headless
                                 Passwordless Login API when user information is submitted to
                                 Salesforce. If true, an access
                                 token issued to an internal integration user is required in your
                                 initial POST request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/init/passwordless/login
                                 endpoint. The access token must include the pwdless_login_api scope. The default value is false.
                                 This field is available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: DoesRegistrationRequireAuth
fields.description:
Determines whether authentication is required to access Headless
                                 Registration API when user registration information is submitted to
                                 Salesforce. If true, an access
                                 token issued to an internal integration user in your initial POST
                                 request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/init/registration
                                 endpoint is required. The access token must include the user_registration_api scope. The default value is false.

fields.name: HeadlessDiscoveryExecutionUserId
fields.description:
This field is a relationship field. The ID of an integration user account to run a headless user
                                 discovery Apex handler.

fields.name: HeadlessDiscoveryHandlerId
fields.description:
This field is a relationship field. The ID of an Apex class that implements the Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryHandler
                                 interface.

fields.name: isFirstPartyAppsAllowed
fields.description:
Determines whether the Experience Cloud site can use headless
                                 identity flows that use the OAuth 2.0 for First-Party Applications
                                 draft protocol.

fields.name: IsForgotPwdAllowed
fields.description:
Determines whether the Headless Forgot Password Flow is
                                 enabled. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsHeadlessUserRegistrationAllowed
fields.description: Determines whether the Headless Registration Flow is enabled. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsPwdlessLoginAllowed
fields.description:
Determines whether the Headless Passwordless Login Flow is enabled
                                    (true) or not (false). The flow is disabled by default. This field is available in API
                                 version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: IsRecaptchaRequiredForgotPwd
fields.description:
Determines whether a reCAPTCHA token is required to access
                                 Headless Forgot Password API when a password reset is requested. If
                                    true, a reCAPTCHA token is
                                 required in your initial POST request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/forgot_password
                                 endpoint. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsRecaptchaRequiredPwdlessLogin
fields.description:
Determines whether a reCAPTCHA token is required to access
                                 Headless Passwordless Login API when user information is submitted
                                 to Salesforce. If true, a
                                 reCAPTCHA token is required in your initial POST request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/init/passwordless/login
                                 endpoint. By default, a reCAPTCHA token isn’t required (false). This field is available in
                                 API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: IsRecaptchaRequiredRgstr
fields.description:
Determines whether a reCAPTCHA token is required to access
                                 Headless Registration API when user registration information is
                                 submitted to Salesforce. If true, a reCAPTCHA token is required in your initial
                                 POST request to the
                                    /services/auth/headless/init/registration
                                 endpoint. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsUniversalClientRgstrAllowed
fields.description:
Determines whether self-registration and passwordless login via
                                 Universal Registration API are enabled. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsUserDisambiguationAllowedForgotPwd
fields.description:
Determines whether the Headless Forgot Password Flow uses the
                                 headless user discovery Apex handler that's specified in the
                                    HeadlessDiscoveryHandlerId field. The
                                 handler enables users to reset their password with an identifier
                                 other than their username, such as an email address, phone number,
                                 or order number. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsUserDisambiguationAllowedUsernamePwd
fields.description:
Determines whether headless login flows use the headless user
                                 discovery Apex handler that's specified in the
                                    HeadlessDiscoveryHandlerId field. The
                                 handler enables users to log in with an identifier other than their
                                 username, such as an email address, phone number, or order number.
                                 This field applies to the Authorization Code and Credentials Flow
                                 and the OAuth 2.0 for First-Party Applications login flow. The default value is false.

fields.name: MaxPasswordResetAttempts
fields.description:
The maximum number of password reset attempts you allow for the
                                 Headless Forgot Password Flow before the user must request a new
                                 one-time password (OTP).

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of your Experience Cloud site. This ID is unique within
                                 your org. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RecaptchaScoreThreshold
fields.description:
The lowest reCAPTCHA score that is accepted before rejecting a
                                 request to access Headless Identity APIs. This value must be
                                 between 0.5 and 1. Scores closer to 0.5 are more likely to be bots,
                                 while scores closer to 1 are more likely to be valid users. You must set a score threshold if
                                    DoesForgotPasswordRequireAuth or
                                    DoesRegistrationRequireAuth fields are set
                                 to true. reCAPTCHA settings
                                 apply to both the Headless Registration Flow and the Headless
                                 Forgot Password Flow. Google issues a reCAPTCHA score only for reCAPTCHA v3
                                 implementations. If you implement reCAPTCHA v2, this field doesn’t
                                 apply.

fields.name: RecaptchaSecretKey
fields.description:
The reCAPTCHA secret key from your API key pair. You get the API
                                 key pair from Google when you set up reCAPTCHA. The secret key
                                 helps your app securely communicate with Google. You must enter a secret key if
                                    DoesForgotPasswordRequireAuth or
                                    DoesRegistrationRequireAuth are set to
                                    true. reCAPTCHA settings
                                 apply to both the Headless Registration Flow and the Headless
                                 Forgot Password Flow.

fields.name: RegistrationExecutionUserId
fields.description:
The ID of the user who runs your headless registration Apex
                                 handler. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RegistrationHandlerId
fields.description: The ID of your headless registration Apex handler. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RegistrationUserDefaultProfileId
fields.description:
The ID of the default profile that gets assigned to new users when
                                 they register. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: DataCategoryGroupName
fields.description:
Name of the data category group that contains one or more data
                                 categories.

fields.name: DataCategoryName
fields.description: Name of the data category.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the data category.

fields.name: ImageId
fields.description: Image associated with the data category. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The name of the data category shown in the UI.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description: ID of the associated Experience site. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ApexHandlerId
fields.description:
The ID of the Apex handler created by the Login
												Discovery page type.

fields.name: ExecuteApexHandlerAsId
fields.description: The ID of the user who is executing the handler.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of NetworkId is unique
												within your org.

fields.name: UsernameLabel
fields.description:
Log in prompt on login page when the login page type
												is Login Discovery.

fields.name: EmailTemplateId
fields.description:
The IDs of the allowlisted email templates that can be sent to
                                 users during the headless authorization flows for registration,
                                 passwordless login, and forgot password. You can list multiple
                                 template IDs. When your app sends its initial request to Headless
                                 Registration API or Headless Passwordless Login API, the emailtemplate parameter can include
                                 only an email template ID from the allowlist. For Headless Forgot
                                 Password API, it works the same way, but only if email template
                                 allowlisting is enabled. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of the Experience Cloud site for which the allowlist is
                                 being configured. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: BestCommentDateTime
fields.description:
Represents the date and time a user created an answer that was later marked
                      as best answer.

fields.name: BestCommentId
fields.description: Represents the comment that was marked as the best answer.

fields.name: FeedItemCreatedById
fields.description: Represents the user who created the feed item.

fields.name: FeedItemDateTime
fields.description: Represents the date and time when the feed Item was created.

fields.name: FeedItemId
fields.description: Represents the unique ID of the question post.

fields.name: FirstCommentDateTime
fields.description: Represents the date and time when the first comment was created.

fields.name: FirstCommentId
fields.description: Represent the first comment on a feed Item.

fields.name: MarkedAsBestCommentDateTime
fields.description: Represents the date and time the user marked the answer as best answer.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description: Represents where the feed item was created.

fields.name: ParentRecordId
fields.description:
Represents the parent record. Parent records can include records like user,
                      account, or group.

fields.name: DefaultGroupNotificationFrequency
fields.description:
Required. The default frequency for sending the member’s group email notifications
           when the member joins groups in the Experience Cloud site. The valid values are: 
            
P—Email on every
              post


            
D—Daily digests

            
W—Weekly digests

            
N—Never

           
The default value is W. In sites, the
            Email on every post option is disabled once more than 10,000
           members choose this setting for the group. All members who had this option selected are
           automatically switched to Daily digests. However, this field is not
           currently enabled. These values are reserved for future use.

fields.name: DigestFrequency
fields.description:
Required. The frequency for sending the member’s personal email digest for the
           Experience Cloud site. The valid values are: 
            
D—Daily

            
W—Weekly

            
N—Never

           
The default value is D. However, daily and
           weekly personal digests aren’t currently available in sites. These values are
           reserved for future use.

fields.name: LastChatterActivityDate
fields.description: The last time the member posted or commented in the Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.description: The ID of a person who is a member of an Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site that the member is part of.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableAllFeedsEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member can automatically receive
           email for updates in the Experience Cloud site, based on the types of feed emails and
           digests the member has enabled.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableBestAnswerEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email when someone selects their answer to a post as best. Available in API 46.0 and
           later.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableBookmarkEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on a feed item after the member has bookmarked it.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableChangeCommentEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on a change the member has made, such as an update to
           their profile.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableDirectMessageEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone sends them a direct message in the Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableEndorsementEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone endorses them for a topic.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableFollowersEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone in the Experience Cloud site starts following the member.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableItemFlaggedEmail
fields.description:
When false, the user automatically receives email
           every time a member flags a post or comment. This setting only applies for community
           moderators (with the Moderate Experiences Feeds permission) and group owners or
            managers.This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableLaterCommentEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on a feed item after the member has commented on the
           feed item.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableLikeEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on a feed item after the member has liked the feed
           item.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableMarketingCloudEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           marketing emails sent by Journey Builder. Available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableMentionsPostEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time the member is mentioned in posts.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableMessageEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time the member is sent a Chatter message.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableProfilePostEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone posts to the member’s profile.

fields.name: PreferencesDisableSharePostEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time the member’s post is shared.

fields.name: PreferencesDisCommentAfterLikeEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on a post the member has liked.

fields.name: PreferencesDisMentionsCommentEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time the member is mentioned in comments.

fields.name: PreferencesDisProfPostCommentEmail
fields.description:
When false, the member automatically receives
           email every time someone comments on posts on the member’s profile.

fields.name: ReputationPoints
fields.description:
The number of reputation points the user has accumulated by performing actions in the
           Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: AssignmentStatus
fields.description:
The status of a profile or permission set within an Experience Cloud site. Values are:
            
Add Calculated—The number of users that
             need to be added are calculated and the add operation is in progress.

            
Added—Users with this profile or
             permission set are members.

            
Failed Add—Users with this profile or
             permission set were not successfully made members.

            
Failed Remove—Users with this profile or
             permission set were not successfully removed from membership.

            
Remove Calculated—The number of users
             that need to be removed are calculated and the remove operation is in progress.

            
Waiting for Add—The profile or
             permission set was added to the Experience Cloud site, but the async process
             hasn’t completed yet. After the process is complete, the status is updated to
              Added.

            
Waiting for Remove—Use this status to
             remove all the members belonging to a profile or permission set and remove a profile or
             permission set from an Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of the Experience Cloud site that this group of members is associated
           with.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The ID of the profile or permission set associated with the Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: EntityId
fields.description: ID of the post, comment, or file that was flagged.

fields.name: ModerationType
fields.description:
Determines the type of flag applied to an item. Values are:
            FlagAsInappropriate

            FlagAsSpam

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description: ID of the community in which the item was flagged.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.description:
Determines visibility of a flagged item. Values are:
            SelfAndModerators—The user who flagged the item and any moderators can see
             the flagged item. This is the default value.

            ModeratorsOnly—Only moderators can see the flagged item. If ModeratorsOnly is
             selected, only moderators can set flags using the API.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of the Experience Cloud site where a custom page is used to override a default
											page.

fields.name: OverrideSetting
fields.description:
The type of the page used to override a default page in the Experience Cloud site.
												OverrideSetting can take the
											following values:
												
Standard—The
												standard page that comes by default with the site. 

												
Configurable—The
												page created when the Configurable Self-Reg
												registration page type or the Login Discovery
												login page type is selected.

												
Designer—A custom
												page created using Experience Builder.

												
Visualforce—A custom
												page created using Visualforce.

fields.name: OverrideType
fields.description:
The name of the default page in the Experience Cloud site that you want to override
											with a custom page.OverrideType can
											take the following values:

												
												LoginRequired

												ChangePassword

												ForgotPassword

												SelfReg

												Home

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description:
The ID of the account that self-registering users in
												the Experience Cloud site are associated with.

fields.name: ApexHandlerId
fields.description:
The ID of the Apex handler created by Configurable
												Self-Reg registration page type.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the org. The default value is USD.

fields.name: ExecuteApexHandlerAsId
fields.description:
The ID of the user who is executing the configurable
												self-registration handler.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
The ID of NetworkId is unique
												within your org.

											You can use only one account per Experience Cloud
												site to assign self-registering users.

fields.name: OptionsDisableStandardRgstrComponent
fields.description:
Determines whether you can use standard Aura and
											Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) components for
											self-registration. If this field is true, self-registration
											flows that use these components don’t work.For more
												control over self-registration, set this field to
												true if
												you’re not using the standard self-registration
												component.

fields.name: OptionsIncludePassword
fields.description:
Option on Configurable Self-Reg registration page. If
												true, the Include Password field is selected.

fields.name: OptionsShowEmail
fields.description:
Option on Configurable Self-Reg registration page. If
												true, the Email field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: OptionsShowFirstName
fields.description:
Option on the Configurable Self-Reg registration
												page. If true, the First Name field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: OptionsShowLastName
fields.description:
Option on the Configurable Self-Reg registration
												page. If true, the Last Name field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: OptionsShowMobilePhone
fields.description:
Option on the Configurable Self-Reg registration
												page. If true, the Mobile field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: OptionsShowNickname
fields.description:
Option on the Configurable Self-Reg registration
												page. If true, the Nickname field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: OptionsShowUsername
fields.description:
Option on the Configurable Self-Reg registration
												page. If true, the Username field appears on the
												self-registration form.

fields.name: PermissionSetGroupId
