The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record
                                 related to this record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record.
                                 If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced
                                 (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: MaxDownloadSpeed
fields.description: The maximum download speed available at the address.

fields.name: MaxUploadSpeed
fields.description: The maximum upload speed available at the address.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the customer's site or location.

fields.name: QuoteId
fields.description: The quote associated with the recipient. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RecipientType
fields.description:
Specifies the type of recipient of the service. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    Location

                                    Subscriber The default value is Location.

fields.name: ServiceAddrValidationDate
fields.description: The date and time when the address was validated.

fields.name: Service Account
fields.description:
Reference to the Account Entity where the product is used,
                                 serviced, or installed.

fields.name: ServiceAddrValidationMsg
fields.description: The message sent after the validation of the address.

fields.name: ServiceAddrValidationResult
fields.description:
Specifies the status of the address validation. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    Fail

                                    Partial Success

                                    Success The default value is Success.

fields.name: ServiceAddress
fields.description: The address where the recipient receives the service.

fields.name: ServiceCity
fields.description: The city where the recipient receives the service.

fields.name: ServiceCountry
fields.description: The country where the recipient receives the service.

fields.name: ServiceGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description:
Specifies the accuracy level of the geocoded address
                                 coordinates. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
                                    Address

                                    Block

                                    City

                                    County

                                    
ExtendedZip—Extended Zip

                                    
NearAddress—Near Address

                                    Neighborhood

                                    State

                                    Street

                                    Unknown

                                    Zip

fields.name: ServiceLatitude
fields.description:
The latitude of the location where the recipient receives the
                                 service.

fields.name: ServiceLongitude
fields.description:
The longitude of the location where the recipient receives the
                                 service.

fields.name: ServicePostalCode
fields.description: The postal code of the address.

fields.name: ServiceState
fields.description: The state where the recipient receives the service.

fields.name: ServiceStreet
fields.description: The street where the recipient receives the service.

fields.name: ServiceabilityCheckDate
fields.description: The date and time when the serviceability check was done.

fields.name: ServiceabilityData
fields.description:
The information about serviciability, such as broadband
                                 connection, download, and upload speeds available at the
                                 address.

fields.name: SiteName
fields.description: The name of the customer's site or location.

fields.name: AdjustmentAmountScope
fields.description:
Used with AdjustmentValue to determine the
                                 amount of the adjustment. Possible values are: 
                                    
Total—The
                                       adjustment applies to the line item's total and isn’t
                                       multiplied by the quantity. The adjustment amount is prorated
                                       for the duration of the subscription.

                                    
Unit—The
                                       adjustment is multiplied by the line item’s quantity,
                                       prorated for the duration of the subscription.

                                    
UnproratedTotal—The adjustment applies to
                                       the line item's total and isn’t multiplied by the quantity.
                                       The adjustment amount isn’t prorated for the duration of the
                                       subscription.

fields.name: AdjustmentSource
fields.description:
The source of the adjustment. Possible values are: 
                                    
Discretionary—The adjustment is entered
                                       manually; for example, by a sales rep.

                                    
Promotion—Reserved for future use.

                                    
Rule—The
                                       adjustment results from a system rule, such as a price rule
                                       or product rule.

                                    
System—The
                                       adjustment is determined by the pricing configuration for the
                                       product; for example, as part of a discount schedule.

fields.name: AdjustmentType
fields.description:
The type of adjustment to apply to a quote line. Possible values are: 
                                    
AdjustmentAmount—The adjustment is a
                                       numerical amount, for example, a cash discount of 20.

                                    
AdjustmentPercentage—The adjustment is a
                                       percentage amount, for example, a 10% discount.

                                    
OverrideAmount—The adjustment is a manual
                                       price override. Available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: AdjustmentValue
fields.description:
The value of the adjustment. Used together with
                                    AdjustmentAmountScope to determine the
                                 amount of the adjustment.

fields.name: AppliedPromotionDate
fields.description:
The date and time on which the promotion was applied to the
                                 asset.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: The ID of the coupon code that was applied.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
The system-entered description of the quote line price
                                 adjustment.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The system-entered name of the quote line price adjustment.

fields.name: PriceAdjustmentCauseId
fields.description:
The ID of the record that caused the adjustment. Null if
                                    AdjustmentSource is Discretionary, indicating a manual
                                    adjustment.For example, if the price adjustment is due to a
                                    price adjustment tier, this field contains the ID of the PriceAdjustmentTier record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Reserved for future use.

fields.name: ProratedAmount
fields.description:
The prorated portion of the fee amount based on the quote line item's effective dates. This field is available with Digital Insurance in API version 67.0
                                 and later.

fields.name: QuoteAdjustmentGroupId
fields.description:
The ID of the quote adjustment group, which totals all price
                                 adjustments for the quote. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: QuoteLineItemId
fields.description:
The ID of the quote line item that this price adjustment applies
                                 to. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description:
The total amount of the adjustment that applies to the quote line
                                 item, inclusive of quantity, prorated for the duration of the
                                 subscription.

fields.name: AssociatedQuantScaleMethod
fields.description:
How to scale the quantity of the associated quote line, relative
                                 to the main quote line. If this field has a non-null value, you
                                 can't edit the associated quote line's quantity. Possible values are: 
                                    
Constant— The
                                       associated quote’s line quantity remains the same in relation
                                       to the main quote line’s quantity. For example, the main
                                       quote line has a quantity of one and the associated quote
                                       line has a quantity of one. If you increase the quantity of
                                       the main quote line to two, the associated quote line’s
                                       quantity remains at one.

                                    
Proportional—
                                       The associated order’s item quantity increases or decreases
                                       based on the main quote line’s quantity. For example, the
                                       main quote line has a quantity of one and the associated
                                       quote line has a quantity of two. If you increase the
                                       quantity of the main quote line to two, the associated quote
                                       line’s quantity increases to four. The default value is Proportional.

fields.name: AssociatedQuoteLineId
fields.description:
The unique identifier of the associated quote line item. This field is a relationship field. In a bundle relationship, this
                                 quote line is the bundle component.

fields.name: AssociatedQuoteLinePricing
fields.description:
Indicates how the associated quote line item is priced relative to
                                 the main quote line item. Possible values are: 
                                    
IncludedInBundlePrice— The associated quote
                                       line’s cost is $0 because it’s included in the bundle’s
                                       price.

                                    
NotIncludedInBundlePrice— The associated
                                       quote line has a cost because it’s not included in the
                                       bundle’s price.

fields.name: AssociatedQuoteLineRole
fields.description:
Describes the position of the associated quote line item in the
                                 relationship. Possible values are: 
                                    
BundleComponent—
                                       The associated quote line item is part of a bundle.

                                    
SetComponent—
                                       The associated quote line item is part of a set.

                                    
ClassificationComponent— The associated
                                       quote line item is a product classification component.

fields.name: IsPriceInclusive
fields.description:
Indicates whether child products are included in the root bundle
                                 price. If set to true, the
                                 price of each child product is zero. The default value is false.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record
                                 indirectly, for example, through a list view or related
                                 record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or
                                 list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed
                                 this record or list view (LastReferencedDate),
                                 but not viewed it.

fields.name: MainQuoteLineId
fields.description:
The unique identifier of the main quote line item. This field is a relationship field. In a bundle relationship, this
                                 quote line is the bundle parent.

fields.name: MainQuoteLineRole
fields.description:
Indicates the position of the main quote line item in the
                                 relationship. Possible values are: 
                                    
Bundle—The main
                                       quote line item is the bundle parent.

                                    
Set—The main
                                       quote line item is the set parent.

fields.name: Name

fields.name: ProductRelatedComponentId
fields.description: The ID of the product related component. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ProductRelationshipTypeId

The unique identifier of record that describes the relationship
                                 between the main and associated quote lines. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: QuoteId

The unique identifier of the quote to which the main and
                                 associated quote lines belong. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: RootQuoteLineId
fields.description:
The root quote line for the quote line relationship. In a bundle
                                 relationship, the root quote line is the root bundle. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: The tax amount for the quote line item.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode

Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled.

BHD—Bahraini
                                       Dinar

                                    
EUR—Euro

                                    
JPY—Japanese
                                       Yen

                                    
USD—U.S.
                                       Dollar The default value is 'USD'.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
User-defined description of the tax. For example, state sales tax

fields.name: Rate

If the tax is a percentage tax, then this field contains the

fields.name: Type

                                 provider. Possible values are: 
                                    Actual

                                    Estimated

fields.name: OrderItemId

fields.description: The quote associated with the quote work source. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Status

                                    Active

                                    Inactive The default value is Active.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

fields.name: Name

fields.name: OwnerId

fields.name: QuoteRecipientGroupId

The quote line item recipient group associated with the quote
                                 recipient group. This field is a relationship field.

The ISO code for the currency value.  Must be one of the valid

fields.name: FieldName

The name of the opportunity field that you want the previous value

                                    CloseDate

                                    StageName

                                    ForecastCategory

                                    NextStep

fields.name: ParentId

The ID of the opportunity that you want the change history
                                 for. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PreviousDateOnlyValue
fields.description: The previous value of a date field on an opportunity.

fields.name: PreviousTextValue
fields.description: The previous value of a text field on an opportunity.

fields.name: ValueChangedById
fields.description:
The ID of the user who changed the specified field's value during
                                 the specified time period. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Alias
fields.description: The alias on the record.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: The email address on the record.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description:
The first name on the record. If the recently viewed record is a user, the value
            is the user’s first name.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: The ID of the recently viewed record or list view.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the recently viewed record is an active user (true) or not (false). This field contains a value only if the recently viewed record is a user.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: The last name on the record.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last interacted
            with this record, directly or indirectly.
            Viewing or opening a record.

            Selecting a record in a lookup search or related list search.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this
            record or list view. If this value is null, it’s possible that the user only accessed
            this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed
            it.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name on the recently viewed record or list view. If the recently viewed record is a user, contact, or lead, the value is a concatenation of the firstname and lastname field values.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
ID of the Experience Cloud site that this group is part of. This field is available only if digital experiences is
            enabled in your org.You can add a NetworkId only when
            creating a group. You can’t change or add a NetworkId for an
            existing group. This field is available in API
             version 27.0 and later.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
ID of the Experience Cloud site that this group is part of. This field is available only if digital experiences is
            enabled in your org.You can add a NetworkId only when
            creating a group. You can’t change or add a NetworkId for an
            existing group. This field is available in API
             version 27.0 and later.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: The phone number on the record.

fields.name: ProfileId
fields.description: If the recently viewed record is a user, this value is the user’s profile ID. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Title
fields.description:
If the recently viewed record is a user, this value is the title of the user; for
           example CFO or CEO.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The object type for this recently viewed record or list view. Valid values include any
           standard or custom objects that RecentlyViewed supports.

fields.name: UserRoleId
fields.description: The ID of the user role associated with this object. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AcceptanceLabel
fields.description:
Label that appears as
												the accept option on the surfaced recommendation.
												Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: ActionReference
fields.description:
Flow referenced for
												this recommendation. Label is
												Action.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Text description of the
												recommendation. Maximum size is 255
											characters.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description:
Stores an identifier for the
												recommendation source, such as product, so Einstein
												can group all responses for a given
												recommendation.

fields.name: ImageId
fields.description:
Image referenced by this
												recommendation. Label is
												Image. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: IsActionActive
fields.description:
Indicates whether the
												flow referenced in the Action field is active (true)
												or not (false). Read only.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The date and time
												when the recommendation was last
											referenced.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The date and time when
												the recommendation was last viewed.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The name of the recommendation.
												Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
ID of the Experience Cloud
												site associated with the recommendation (if
												applicable).

fields.name: RecommendationKey
fields.description:
Track responses to a
												recommendation when it doesn’t have an ID. Maximum
												size is 255 characters.

fields.name: RejectionLabel
fields.description:
Label that appears as
												the reject option on the surfaced recommendation.
												Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: ActionReference
fields.description:
The full name of an action flow at the time of the response. The
                                 full name includes the action’s namespace.

fields.name: ContextRecord
fields.description:
The ID of context record that contains the Einstein Next Best
                                 Action component. For example, if the Einstein Next Best Action
                                 component is on a case record the ContextRecord is the
                                 ID
                                 of the case
                                 record.

fields.name: ContextRecordName
fields.description: The name of the context record.

fields.name: ContextRecordType
fields.description:
The
                                 name of the object that’s associated with the value stored in the
                                 ContextRecord field. For example, Account, Case, or
                                 Contact.

fields.name: NetworkId
fields.description:
ID
                                 of the Experience Cloud site associated with the recommendation (if
                                 applicable). This is a relationship field.

fields.name: OnBehalfOf
fields.description:
The user ID or record that is indirectly reacting to the
                                 recommendation.

fields.name: OnBehalfOfName
fields.description:
Name of the value stored for OnBehalfOf at
                                 time of response.

fields.name: OnBehalfOfType
fields.description: The name of the object that’s associated with the value stored in the OnBehalfOf field. For example, Account, Case, or Contact.

fields.name: RecommendationKey
fields.description:
RecommendationId
                                 if available, otherwise a generated string that represents the
                                 recommendation name.

fields.name: RecommendationName
fields.description:
Name of the recommendation returned from the recommendation
                                 strategy.

fields.name: RecommendationType
fields.description:
Object type of the recommendation. It can be Recommendation or any
                                 object type mapped to the Recommendation object.
                                 For
                                 example, if you map Product to Recommendation, the
                                 RecommendationType is Product.

fields.name: Response
fields.description:
The user’s response to the recommendation. Possible values are: 
                                    Accepted

                                    Rejected

fields.name: StrategyReference
fields.description:
The full name of a recommendation strategy flow at the time of the
                                 response. The response is formatted as namespace underscore prefix double underscore flowname, such as namespace_prefix__flowname.

fields.name: StrategyVersion
fields.description:
The recommendation strategy version that’s active at the time of
                                 the response.

fields.name: ActionDefinition
fields.description:
Required in Lightning Flow for Service implementations
											that use version 44.0 or later of the API. The API name
											of the action to associate with the record; for example,
											the API name of a flow. Use this field rather than
											FlowDefinition. To distinguish a quick action from a
											flow with the same API name, we prepend "QuickAction" to
											the API name of every quick action.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description:
Required in Lightning Flow for Service implementations
											that use version 46.0 or later of the API. The type of
											action. Possible values are:
												
Flow
												(default)

												QuickAction

											
For versions of the API prior to version 46.0, this
											field is set to Flow.

fields.name: FlowDefinition
fields.description:
Optional in Lightning Flow for Service implementations
											using version 42.0 or 43.0 of the API. An upgrade to
											Winter '19 or later, which uses API version 44.0 or
											later, copies FlowDefinition to ActionDefinition. For
											versions 42.0 and 43.0, this field is the API name of
											the flow that’s associated with the record.

fields.name: FlowInterviewId
fields.description:
Optional. The flow interview ID of the paused or
											completed flow. This field can’t be set in Process
											Builder. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: IsMandatory
fields.description:
Optional. Specifies whether the action is mandatory. The
											default value is false. 

Note
At runtime, we show a
												reminder when the user closes a mandatory flow
												without completing it. We don't show the reminder
												for quick actions.

fields.name: IsUiRemoveHidden
fields.description:
Optional. Specifies whether the ability to remove the
											action is hidden in the UI. The default value is false.
											If true, the UI hides the ability to remove the action.
											However, actions can still be deleted using the
											API.

fields.name: Order
fields.description:
Required. The order of the action among all actions
											associated with this record.

fields.name: ParticipantRoleId
fields.description:
The participant role that's associated with the record
											action. This field is a polymorphic relationship field and is
											available in API version 58.0 and later.

fields.name: Pinned
fields.description:
Required. Specifies whether the action is pinned to the
											top or bottom of the component. If an action is pinned,
											users see the Remove option in the UI unless
												IsUiRemoveHidden is set to
											true. Possible values are:
												None (default)

												Top

												Bottom

fields.name: RecordId
fields.description:
Required. Record associated with the action. In version
											46.0 and above, we support most object types. To learn
											about supported objects, see the Lightning Flow for Service
												Developer’s Guide. This is a relationship field.
reference_to:
Problem are available in API
											version 53.0 and later. RebateMemberAggregateItem is available in API version 54.0 and later.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Required. The current state of the action. Possible
											values are:
												
New
												(default)

												Paused

												Complete

												Started

												
Unlinked—The action was unlinked
												because the flow was paused and the current record
												for the flow interview changed.

											
Paused and unlinked statuses do not apply to quick
											actions. This field can’t be set in Process Builder.

fields.name: ActionDefinitionApiName
fields.description:
Required. The API name of the action associated with the record.
                                 To distinguish a quick action from a flow with the same API name,
                                 we prepend "QuickAction" to the API name of every quick action.

fields.name: ActionDefinitionLabel
fields.description: Required. The label of the action that took place.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description:
Required. The type of action associated with the record. Possible
                                 values are:
                                    
Flow (default)

                                    QuickAction

fields.name: IsMandatory
fields.description:
Optional. Specifies whether the action is mandatory. The default
                                 value is false.

fields.name: LoggedTime
fields.description: Required. The timestamp when the state change occurred.

fields.name: ParentRecordId
fields.description: Required. The parent record for the associated action. This is a relationship field.
reference_to:
Problem are available in API version 53.0
                                 and later. RebateMemberAggregateItem is available in API version 54.0 and
                                 later.

fields.name: Pinned
fields.description:
Optional. Specifies whether the action is pinned to the top or
                                 bottom, or unpinned. Possible values are:
                                    None

                                    Top

                                    Bottom

fields.name: RecordActionId
fields.description: Required. The ID of the RecordAction.

fields.name: State
fields.description:
Required. The state of the action. A state change triggers the
                                 logging of a history event. Possible values are:
                                    
Started (default)

                                    Paused

                                    Resumed

                                    Completed

                                    
Unlinked—The
                                       action was unlinked because the flow was paused and the
                                       current record for the flow interview changed.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: Required. The user that conducted the action. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the recordset filter criteria.

fields.name: FilteredObject
fields.description:
The object used to define the filter criteria. Available in API version 52.0
                      or later. Possible values are: 
                        Asset

                        ServiceAppointment

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description:
Indicates whether the recordset filter criteria is associated with shifts or
                      maintenance work rules (true) or not
                        (false).

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the recordset filter criteria was last referenced.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the recordset filter criteria was last viewed.

fields.name: LogicalOperator
fields.description:
Defines the logic to evaluate multiple recordset filter criteria rules.
                      Available in API version 53.0 and later. Possible values are: 
                        AND

                        OR

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the recordset filter criteria.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the recordset filter criteria.

fields.name: SourceObject
fields.description:
The source object that the filtered criteria are applied to. Shifts and
                      maintenance work rules are available in API version 52.0 and later.
                      Appointment bundle objects are available in API version 53.0 and later. Possible values are: 
                        
ApptBundleAggrPolicy—Appointment Bundle Aggregation
                          Policy

                        
ApptBundleConfig—Appointment
                          Bundle Config

                        
                        Shift

                        ContractLineOutcome

                        MaintenanceWorkRule

fields.name: CriteriaField
fields.description:
The field the filter rule is applied to. Asset fields are available in API
                      version 52.0 and later. Possible values are derived from the source object’s standard and custom
                      fields. Possible standard source objects are Asset and ServiceAppointment.
                      The format is, for example, Asset.PricingSource or ServiceAppointment.GroupAppointmentAccessType. All standard and
                      custom fields are allowed except those with these field types:
                        encryptedstring

                        multipicklist

                        textarea

                        url

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the recordset filter criteria rule was last referenced.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the recordset filter criteria rule was last viewed.

fields.name: NextOccurence
fields.description:
This field’s value is compared to the Usage Field to determine if the rule
                      is true. Possible values are derived from the source object’s standard and custom
                      fields. Possible standard source objects are Asset and ServiceAppointment.
                      The format is, for example, Asset.PricingSource or ServiceAppointment.GroupAppointmentAccessType. All standard and
                      custom fields are allowed except those with these field types:
                        encryptedstring

                        multipicklist

                        textarea

                        url

fields.name: Operator
fields.description:
The relational operator between CriteriaField and
                        Value. Available in API version 52.0 or later. Possible values are: 
                        
Equals—Default

                        GreaterOrEqual

                        GreaterThan

                        LessOrEqual

                        LessThan

fields.name: RecordsetFilterCriteriaId
fields.description:
The ID of the RecordsetFilterCriteria record to associate this rule
                      with.

fields.name: RecordsetFilterCriteriaRuleNumber
fields.description:
The automatically assigned number of the recordset filter criteria
                      rule.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The type of criteria rule. Possible values are: 
                        
Criteria—Default

                        Usage

                        UsageCounter—
                          Usage(Counter)

                        UsageDuration—
                            Usage(Duration)

fields.name: Value
fields.description:
The expected value of CriteriaField applied to the
                      filter rule.

fields.name: Usage Rate Field
fields.description:
Stores the daily usage rate of the asset. The unit for the usage rate must
                      be per day. Possible values are derived from the source object’s standard and
                      custom fields. Possible standard source objects are Asset and ServiceAppointment. The format is, for example, Asset.PricingSource or ServiceAppointment.GroupAppointmentAccessType.

fields.name: Usage Rate Unit
fields.description:
Defines the rate for Usage Rate Field. Possible values are:
                        DAYS

fields.name: AssetId
fields.description: The ID of the asset to link the RFC to. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
The description of the RFC associated with the recordset filter
                                 criteria monitor.

fields.name: IsWithinThreshold
fields.description:
Indicates whether the value of the asset attribute is within the
                                 threshold of the RFC. The default value is false.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the recordset filter criteria monitor.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date the value was last referenced.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date the value was last viewed.

fields.name: RecordsetFilterCriteriaId
fields.description: The ID of the recordset filter criteria. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: BusinessProcessId
fields.description:
Required for Opportunity and Lead record types in API version 17.0 and later. ID of an
           associated BusinessProcess.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of this record. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
Required. The unique name of the object in the API. This name
            can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your
            org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and
            not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming
            conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s
            name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s
            organization. Label is Record Type Name.


Note
When creating large sets of data, always specify a
            unique DeveloperName for each record. If no
             DeveloperName is specified, performance slows down while
            Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description:
Indicates whether this record is active (true) or
           not (false). Only active record types can be applied
           to records. Label is Active.

fields.name: IsPersonType
fields.description:
Indicates whether this record has been designated as a person account (true) or not (false).
           Visible only if the organization has the person account feature enabled.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Required. Label of the record type in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters. Label
           is Record Type Label.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this object. Each Developer Edition org
           that creates a managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You
           can refer to a component in a managed package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
           notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the following values.

            In Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set to the
             namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it, unless an object is in an
             installed managed package. In that case, the object has the namespace prefix of the
             installed managed package. This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the Developer
             Edition org of the package developer.

            In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is
             set only for objects that are part of an installed managed package. All other objects
             have no namespace prefix.

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: Object to which this record type applies, including custom objects.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language for this translated label.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this object. Each Developer Edition org
           that creates a managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You
           can refer to a component in a managed package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
           notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the following values.

            In Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set to the
             namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it, unless an object is in an
             installed managed package. In that case, the object has the namespace prefix of the
             installed managed package. This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the Developer
             Edition org of the package developer.

            In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is
             set only for objects that are part of an installed managed package. All other objects
             have no namespace prefix.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The ID of the RecordType associated with the label that is being translated.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The actual translated label for the record type. Label is Translation.

fields.name: RecordId
fields.description: The ID of the record.

fields.name: VisibilityAttribute
fields.description:
The visibility attributes that determine the read access of a given record. For
											example, a user ID, parent record ID, or group ID. The output of visibility attributes is in JSON format
											and must be deserialized.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description:
The unique name of the custom help section in the API. This name can contain
                      only underscores and alphanumeric characters and must be unique in your
                      organization. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an
                      underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. The label corresponds
                      to the section title in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters. When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique
                        DeveloperName for each record. If no
                        DeveloperName is specified, performance slows down
                      while Salesforce generates one for each record. Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration
                      permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: Language of the label.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The label of the trusted URL.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with
                        this object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a managed package has a
                        unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You can refer to a component
                        in a managed package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
                        notation. The namespace
                          prefix can have one of the following values.

                        In Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set
                          to the namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it, unless
                          an object is in an installed managed package. In that case, the object has
                          the namespace prefix of the installed managed package. This field’s value
                          is the namespace prefix of the Developer Edition org of the package
                          developer.

                        In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs,
                            NamespacePrefix is set only for objects that are
                          part of an installed managed package. All other objects have no namespace
                          prefix.

fields.name: Url
fields.description:
The trusted URL. These formats are accepted: example.com,
                        *.example.com, and
                        https://example.com. The host section of the URL can include an asterisk (*) as a wildcard. Otherwise, the URL cannot be
                      malformed. Examples of malformed URLs that fail a syntax check are malformed^url.example.com, and https://{subdomain}.example.com. To add a URL to a RedirectWhitelistUrl based on
                      parameters, build the URL before you update the Url
                      field.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description:
The customer account containing the payment that this
											refund targets. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Total amount of this refund.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description:
Remaining balance following refund line applications.
											Equal to the Amount field – the Net Applied
											field.

fields.name: CancellationDate
fields.description:
The date that the refund was canceled. This is a
											required parameter for void services.

fields.name: CancellationEffectiveDate
fields.description:
The date that the cancellation of this refund takes
											effect.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayDate
fields.description:
The date when the cancellation transaction was processed
											in the payment gateway.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayRefNumber
fields.description:
Unique ID for the cancellation transaction. Generated by
											the payment gateway.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayResultCode
fields.description:
Gateway-specific result code for the cancellation
											transaction. Generated by the payment gateway. Must be
											mapped to a Salesforce-specific result code.

fields.name: CancellationSfResultCode
fields.description:
Salesforce-specific result code that can map to one or
											more gateway result codes. We recommend configuring the
											payment gateway adapter layer to map gateway result
											codes to the appropriate Salesforce result code.

fields.name: ClientContext
fields.description:
Contains caller context for payment APIs. Useful for
											re-establishing context during an asynchronous payment
											transaction.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description:
Users can add comments to provide additional details
											about a record. Maximum of 1000 characters.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code associated with the
											payment group record.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: The date and time that this refund was created.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description:
Defines the date and time when the refund application
											becomes effective.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address of the person who initiated the
											refund.

fields.name: GatewayDate
fields.description:
The date that a successful gateway communication caused
											the creation of this refund.

fields.name: GatewayRefNumber
fields.description:
Unique transaction ID created by the payment
											gateway.

fields.name: GatewayResultCode
fields.description:
Gateway-specific result code. Must be mapped to a
											Salesforce-specific result code.

fields.name: GatewayResultCodeDescription
fields.description:
Description of the GatewayResultCode. Useful for
											providing additional context as to why the gateway
											returned a specific result code.

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description:
Shows the refund’s financial impact against the
											customer’s accounts receivable. If the refund amount is
											valid, it equals the Amount field. Equals 0 when the
											refund amount is void. Has a null value when the refund
											is canceled.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description:
The IP address of the person who initiated the
											payment.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a
											record related to this record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this
											record. If this value is null, this record can have been
											referenced (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed.

fields.name: MacAddress
fields.description:
The MAC address of the person who initiated the
											refund.

fields.name: NetApplied
fields.description:
Equals the Total Applied field minus the Total Unapplied
											field.

fields.name: OrderPaymentSummaryId
fields.description:
Order payment summary record that shows the balances of
											each authorization, capture, and refund made against an
											order.

fields.name: PaymentGatewayId
fields.description: The payment gateway used to process this refund. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentGroupId
fields.description: The payment group for the payment being refunded. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentID
fields.description: ID of the payment record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentIntentID
fields.description: ID of the payment intent record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentMethodId
fields.description:
The payment method used to create the payment being
											refunded. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description:
Phone number of the customer who initiated the
											refund.

fields.name: ProcessingMode
fields.description:
Defines whether the payment has been made outside of the
											payment platform. Possible values are: 
												
External:
												Transactions happened outside of the Salesforce
												payments platform.

												
Salesforce:
												Salesforce made and recorded an external call to
												the payment gateway.

fields.name: RefundNumber
fields.description: System-created unique ID for this refund.

fields.name: SfResultCode
fields.description:
Salesforce-specific result code that can map to one or
											more gateway result codes. We recommend configuring the
											payment gateway adapter layer to map gateway result
											codes to the appropriate Salesforce result code. Possible values are: 
												
Decline:
												The gateway call failed but the transaction can be
												attempted again. For example, the customer had
												insufficient funds or briefly lost their
												connection.

												
Indeterminate: The gateway didn’t
												respond to the call. This response usually happens
												when Salesforce times out while waiting for a
												response from the gateway.

												
PermanentFail: The gateway call failed
												and can’t work even if tried again. Gateway calls
												fail permanently for one of two reasons:
												Hard Decline: The customer’s payment account
												has been closed or terminated.

												Fraud: The gateway recognized the payment or
												payment method as known fraud.

												


												
RequiresReview: The customer bank
												requires more information before completing the
												payment.

												
Success:
												The gateway call succeeded.

												
SystemError: Salesforce ended the
												payment request before receiving a response. For
												example, Salesforce lost credentials or access to
												its server. Salesforce ends payment calls if it
												doesn’t receive a response from the gateway within
												two minutes.

												
ValidationError: Customer payment data
												was incorrect, such as a misspelling in the credit
												card address or an incorrect CVV.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
Defines the state of this refund. Possible values are: 
												
Canceled:
												This refund has been voided and can no longer be
												allocated.

												
Draft: The
												refund can be edited before posting it and
												allocating it to a target.

												
Processed:
												This refund has been finalized and can be
												allocated against a target.

											
 Users can manually change the Status field’s
											values as follows:
												Draft to Processed

												Processed to Canceled

												Draft to Canceled

fields.name: TotalApplied
fields.description:
The sum of Amount fields across all of this refund’s
											applied refund lines.

fields.name: TotalUnapplied
fields.description:
The sum of Amount fields across all of this refund’s
											unapplied refund lines.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Defines how this refund is used. Possible values are: 
												
NonReferenced: Standalone refund not
												linked to any payment.

												
Referenced:
												Refund made against a payment.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: The total amount applied to or unapplied from a payment by the refund line.

fields.name: AppliedDate
fields.description: The date that the refund was applied to the linked payment.

fields.name: AssociatedAccountId
fields.description:
The account for the payment that received the
											refund. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: AssociatedRefundLinePaymentId
fields.description:
The refundLine that was unapplied. Populated only when
											RefundLinePayment’s Type has a value of Unapplied. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can add comments to provide additional information on the refund line payment.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: By default, the day the refund line payment record was created. Users can also enter a different date.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description: Defines the date and time when the refund line application or unapplication becomes effective.

fields.name: EffectiveImpactAmount
fields.description:
Shows how this payment refund line impacts a customer’s accounts receivable. This value is positive when RefundLinePayment’s Type field is Applied, and
											negative when RefundLinePayment’s Type is Unapplied. If there’s an unapplied line related to this record, EffectiveImpactAmount has a value of 0. Note
EffectiveImpactAmount evaluates only the applied and unapplied line pair. Therefore, the effective impact amount could be different for different
												lines within the same refund.

fields.name: HasBeenUnapplied
fields.description:
Shows whether this refund line has been unapplied. Possible values are: 
											No

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description:
Shows how this payment refund line impacts a customer’s accounts receivable. This value is positive when RefundLinePayment’s Type field is Applied, and
											negative when RefundLinePayment’s Type is Unapplied.

fields.name: PaymentBalance
fields.description: The payment record’s balance following the application or unapplication of this refund line.

fields.name: PaymentId
fields.description:
The payment record that this refund line targets. Refund
											applications and unapplications are made against this
											payment. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: RefundBalance
fields.description: The refund record’s balance following the application or unapplication of this payment refund line.

fields.name: RefundId
fields.description: The parent refund of this refund line. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: RefundLinePaymentNumber
fields.description: System-created unique ID for this refund line.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Defines whether this line represents a refund that’s been applied or unapplied from a payment. Possible values are: 
											Applied

fields.name: UnappliedDate
fields.description: The date that this refund line was unapplied from a payment.

fields.description:

                                       characters

Indicates whether to forward automatic replies, such as

                                    out-of-office messages. This value is honored only if the value
                                    of IsEmailForwardingEnabled
                                    is true. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsEmailForwardingEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether to forward email replies to the address
                                    specified in the FwdEmailAddress field. The default value is false.

fields.name: IsUnsubscribeManualRequestsEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether subscribers can opt out of your campaigns by
                                    replying to your email with a keyword such as unsubscribe. The default value is false.

                      and later. Possible values are languages supported in Einstein Reply
                      Recommendations.

fields.description: Eight-digit auto-generated number identifying the reply.

fields.name: RawTextMessage
fields.description: The text of the reply.

fields.name: Source
fields.description:
Indicates who last modified the reply. Possible values are: 
                        
EINSTEIN_GENERATED—Reply was
                          generated by Einstein and has not been edited.

                        
USER_EDITED—Reply was
                          generated by Einstein and then edited by a user.

                        
USER_GENERATED—This value is
                          not currently in use.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of the reply. Possible values are: 
                        
NEW—Einstein has generated
                          the reply and it hasn’t yet been published.

                        
PUBLISHED—The reply has been
                          published to quick text. When the reply recommendation model is activated,
                          the reply can be recommended to support agents.

                        
PUBLISH_FAILED— An attempt
                          to publish the reply to quick text failed. Publishing failure can be due
                          to validation errors, access errors, or corrupted files. To hide the reply
                          from the list of generated replies, delete it.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
The description of the report. Limit: 255
											characters.

Required. The unique name of the object in the API. This

											begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an
											underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.
											In managed packages, this field prevents naming
											conflicts on package installations. With this field, a
											developer can change the object’s name in a
											managed package and the changes are reflected in a
											subscriber’s organization. Label is
												Report Unique Name.

Note
When

												generates one for each record.

Name of the folder that contains the report. Available

Summary for reports in that format. In

Matrix for reports in that format. In the
												application, the label is
												Matrix.

												
Multiblock for reports in joined format.
												In the application, the label is
												Joined.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description:
Indicates whether the object has been moved to the
											Recycle Bin (true)
											or not (false).

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this
											record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: LastRunDate

Returns the date the report was last run. Label is

												support it, unless an object is in an installed

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
The ID of the folder that contains the report. There are
											2 special folders: 
												Private, where the ID is the user ID 

												Public, where the ID is the org ID This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: AverageRowSize
fields.description:
The average row size of all rows in the Report event, in bytes. A
                                 large average size, coupled with a high
                                    RowCount, can indicate that a user is
                                 downloading information for fraudulent purposes. For example, a
                                 salesperson who downloads all sales leads before departing for a
                                 competitor. For example: 700.

fields.name: BucketCount
fields.description: The number of buckets that were used in the report.

fields.name: ClientIp
fields.description:
The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A
                                 Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown
                                 as “Salesforce.com IP”. For example: 96.43.144.26.

fields.name: ColumnCount
fields.description: The number of columns in the report.

fields.name: CpuTime
fields.description:
The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This
                                 field indicates the amount of activity taking place in the app
                                 server layer.

fields.name: DatabaseBlocks
fields.description:
Indicates how much activity is occurring in the database. A high
                                 value for this field suggests that adding indexes or filters on
                                 your queries would benefit performance.

fields.name: DatabaseCpuTime
fields.description:
The CPU time in milliseconds to complete the request. Indicates
                                 the amount of activity taking place in the database layer during
                                 the request.

fields.name: DatabaseTotalTime
fields.description:
The time in nanoseconds for a database round trip. Includes time
                                 spent in the JDBC driver, network to the database, and
                                    DatabaseCpuTime. Compare this field to
                                    CpuTime to determine whether performance
                                 issues are occurring in the database layer or in your own
                                 code.

fields.name: DisplayType
fields.description:
The report display type, indicating the run mode of the
                                 report. Possible values are:
                                    
D—Dashboard

                                    
S—Show
                                       Details

                                    
H—Hide
                                       Details

fields.name: ExceptionFilterCount
fields.description: The number of exception filters that are used in the report.

fields.name: LoginKey
fields.description:
The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login
                                 session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout
                                 event or the user session expiring. For example: GeJCsym5eyvtEK2I.

fields.name: ObjectName
fields.description: The name of the object referenced by the report.

The context in which the report executed, such as from a UI

ReportOpenedFromMobileDashboard: Report executed

                                       and drilled down to a report. 

                                    
DashboardComponentUpdated: Report executed when
                                       a user refreshed a dashboard component.

                                    
DashboardComponentPreviewed: Report executed
                                       from a Lightning dashboard component preview.

                                    
ReportRunUsingSynchronousApi: Report executed
                                       from a synchronous API.

                                    
ReportRunUsingAsynchronousApi: Report executed
                                       from an asynchronous API.

                                    
ReportRunUsingApexSynchronousApi: Report
                                       executed from the synchronous Apex API.

                                    
ReportRunUsingApexAsynchronousApi: Report
                                       executed from the asynchronous Apex API.

                                    
ReportExported: Report
                                       executed from a printable view or report export that was not
                                       asynchronous nor an API export.

                                    
ReportRunFromClassic:
                                       Report executed from the Run Report option of Salesforce
                                       Classic.

                                    
ReportRunFromMobile:
                                       Report executed from the Run Report option of the mobile
                                       Salesforce app.

                                    
ReportRunFromLightning:
                                       Report executed from the Run option in Lightning Experience
                                       from a non-mobile browser. 

                                    
ReportRunFromRestApi:
                                       Report executed from REST API.

                                       through the notifications API.

                                       Notation (JSON)

fields.name: ReportIdentifier

                                 one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same
                                    RequestIdentifier. For example: 3nWgxWbDKWWDIk0FKfF5DV.

fields.name: RequestStatus
fields.description:
The status of the request for a page view or user interface
                                 action. For example:
                                    
S—Success. Salesforce
                                       handled the request successfully. If an Apex controller
                                       throws an exception, this status is also returned. 

                                    
F—Failure. Typically
                                       4xx or 5xx HTTP codes, such as no permission to view page,
                                       page took too long to render, page is read-only.

                                    
U—Undefined

                                    
A—Authorization
                                       Error

                                    
R—Redirect. Typically a
                                       3xx HTTP code, possibly initiated by an Apex controller in a
                                       Visualforce page.

                                    
N—Not Found. 404
                                       error.

fields.name: RowCount

The number of rows that were processed in the Report event. High
                                 row counts, coupled with a highAverageRowSize,
                                 can indicate that a user is downloading information for fraudulent
                                 purposes. For example, a salesperson who downloads all sales leads
