FOUNDTIONAL—Foundational

                                    
GENERATIVE—Generative

                                    
KEYWORD—Keyword

                                    
SITUATIONAL—Situational

                                    
TIME_BASED—Time-Based The default value is KEYWORD.

fields.name: InsightOccurrenceCount
fields.description:
The number of times a particular insight occurred in the
                                 transcript.

fields.name: InsightSubject
fields.description:
The specific text, phrase, or subject identified in the video call
                                 transcript that serves as the basis for the insight.

fields.name: InsightText
fields.description:
The text content of the insight derived from the video call
                                 transcript.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The display name of the insight type.

fields.name: Scope
fields.description:
Required. The scope of the insight type. Possible values are: 
                                    Organization

                                    User The default value is Organization.

fields.name: VideoCallId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated parent VideoCall record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallRecordingId
fields.description: ID of the associated parent VideoCallRecording record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallTranscriptId
fields.description: ID of the associated VideoCallTranscript record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActionCategory
fields.description:
The category that classifies the purpose of the action. Possible values are: 
                                    FollowUp

                                    NeedsAttention

fields.name: ActionReferenceId
fields.description:
ID of the reference record associated with the generated
                                 action. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description:
The specific type of action to be performed for the insight. Possible values are: 
                                    CreateCalendarEvent

                                    CreateTaskWithDate

                                    EciCreateCallback

                                    EciScheduleMeetings

                                    EciSendCallResponse

                                    ViewContactProfile The default value is CreateTaskWithDate.

fields.name: CompletionDateTime
fields.description: The timestamp when the action was completed.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. The name of the insight action.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of the insight action. Possible values are: 
                                    Active

                                    Completed The default value is Active.

fields.name: VideoCallInsightId
fields.description:
Required. ID of the VideoCallInsight record associated with a
                                 video call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific
                                 recording or transcript within a call. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. The name of the insight reason.

fields.name: OccurrenceInfo
fields.description: The metadata associated with the insight reason.

fields.name: OccurrenceSnippet
fields.description:
The specific excerpt from the video call transcript that helped
                                 generate the insight. Reserved for future use.

fields.name: SpeakerParticipantId
fields.description: ID of the associated VideoCallParticipant record. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallInsightId
fields.description:
Required. ID of the VideoCallInsight record associated with a
                                 video call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific
                                 recording or transcript within a call. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: The email address of the participant, from the video call provider.

fields.name: IsAllowed
fields.description:
Indicates whether the participant is admitted into the video call (true) or
                      not (false). The default value is false.

fields.name: JoinDateTime
fields.description: The date and time when the participant joins the video call.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record
                      related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If
                      this value is null, the user might have
                      only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LeaveDateTime
fields.description: The date and time when the participant leaves the video call.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The participant's name or phone number. This information is provided by the
                      video call provider.

fields.name: ParticipantType
fields.description:
The role of the participant in the video call. Available in API version 65.0
                      and later. Possible values are: 
                        Attendee

                        Organizer

fields.name: RelatedPersonId
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the user, lead, or contact record for this participant. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallId
fields.description: The ID of the video call record. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: DurationInSeconds
fields.description: The video call duration in seconds, not the recording duration.

fields.name: EndDateTime
fields.description: Time the call ended, in universal time coordinated (UTC).

fields.name: ExpirationDateTime
fields.description:
Reserved for internal use. This field is available in API version 59.0 and
                      later.

fields.name: ExternalRecordingKey
fields.description:
The ID of the video call recording, from the recording provider. For
                      example, the Zoom ID of the recording. This value is unique.

fields.name: ExternalRecordingKeyLong
fields.description:
The ID of the video call recording, from the recording provider, that's more
                      than 255 characters. For example, the MS Team ID of the recording. This value
                      is unique. If ExternalRecordingKey is null, this ID is used by
                      default. Available in API version 61.0 and later.

fields.name: FileSizeInByte
fields.description:
The size of the video call recording, in bytes. A 0-byte value for video
                      calls with the FileType of TRANSCRIPT is expected behavior. This entity is still used with
                      Google Meet and Microsoft Teams integrations to locate and process the
                      vendor's data.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description:
The file type of the video call recording. Possible values are: 
                        
MP4—Video file

                        
M4A—Audio-only file 

                        
TIMELINE—Time stamp file in
                          JSON format. 

                        
TRANSCRIPT—Transcription
                          files in VTT format.

                        
CHAT—Text file containing
                          chat messages from the video call.

                        
CC—File containing closed
                          captions of the video call recording. The file is in VTT format.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record
                      related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If
                      this value is null, the user only
                      accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the video call recording, entered by the sales rep.

fields.name: StartDateTime
fields.description: The start time of the video call recording.

fields.name: VideoCallRecordId
fields.description: ID of the VideoCall record (the parent record). This is a relationship field.

fields.name: ListenRatio
fields.description:
Required. The ratio of the time the speaker spent listening versus
                                 talking on the call.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the video call recording.

fields.name: ParticipantSpeakingOrder
fields.description:
Required. The sequence in which participants first spoke during
                                 the call. Only the initial speaking turn of each participant is
                                 captured.

fields.name: TalkRatio
fields.description:
Required. The ratio of the time that the speaker spent talking
                                 versus listening on the call.

fields.name: TalkSegment
fields.description:
The transcript of specific segments that the participant was
                                 speaking.

fields.name: VideoCallId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated VideoCall. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallParticipantId
fields.description: ID of the associated VideoCallParticipant. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallRecordingId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated VideoCallRecording. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: IsTranscriptTruncated
fields.description:
Required. Indicates whether the transcript is truncated (true) or not (false). The default value is
                                    false.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The unique name for the video call transcript record.

fields.name: TotalDuration
fields.description:
Required. The difference between the end timestamp of the last
                                 entry and the start timestamp of the first entry in the transcript.
                                 This field helps identify the longest transcript for a given call.
                                 The unit of measurement is seconds.

fields.name: TranscribedLanguage
fields.description:
The language in which the transcript is generated. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
ar—Arabic

                                    
bg—Bulgarian

                                    
ca—Catalan

                                    
cs—Czech

                                    
da—Danish

                                    
de—German

                                    
el—Greek

                                    
en—English

                                    
es—Spanish

                                    
fi—Finnish

                                    
fr—French

                                    
he—Hebrew

                                    
hi—Hindi

                                    
hr—Croatian

                                    
hu—Hungarian

                                    
id—Indonesian

                                    
is—Icelandic

                                    
it—Italian

                                    
ja—Japanese

                                    
ko—Korean

                                    
lt—Lithuanian

                                    
lv—Latvian

                                    
nl—Dutch

                                    
no—Norwegian

                                    
pa—Punjabi

                                    
pl—Polish

                                    
pt—Portuguese

                                    
ro—Romanian

                                    
ru—Russian

                                    
sk—Slovak

                                    
sr—Serbian

                                    
sv—Swedish

                                    
th—Thai

                                    
tr—Turkish

                                    
uk—Ukrainian

                                    
vi—Vietnamese

                                    
zh—Chinese

fields.name: TranscriptContent
fields.description:
The full content of the video call transcript in the JSON or CSV
                                 format, including all spoken sentences during the call, with
                                 timestamps and speaker information.

fields.name: TranscriptCreationTimestamp
fields.description:
Required. The date and time when the transcript was created by the
                                 transcription service.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
Required. Specifies how the transcript was generated. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
ai-generated—
                                       Generated using advanced AI transcription tools

                                    
post-call—
                                       Generated after the call using the final recording

                                    
real-time—
                                       Generated during the call, before the recording is
                                       available

fields.name: UsageType
fields.description:
Required. The source from where the video call originated. Possible values are:
                                 
                                    
eci— Einstein
                                       Conversation Insights

fields.name: VideoCallId
fields.description: Required. Reference to the associated parent video call. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallRecordingId
fields.description:
Reference to the associated optional parent video call
                                 recording. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VideoCallStartTimestamp
fields.description:
The  start time of the video call recording to use with the
                                 transcript for calculating relative timestamps.

fields.name: ActivityId
fields.description:
The unique ID of the activity record. Available in API
											version 48.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: AgentSentimentScore
fields.description:
If Sentiment
												Journey in Salesforce Voice is set up, this
											field represents the rep’s overall sentiment score
											post-call in a conversation event. The value must be
											between -5 (lowest negative sentiment score) and 5
											(highest positive sentiment score), with 0 being a
											neutral sentiment score. Available in API version 59.0
											and later.This field isn't available in Salesforce
												Voice (Native Telephony).

fields.name: CallAcceptDateTime
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the date and time (in UTC) when
											an agent accepts the call. Available in API version 48.0
											and later.

fields.name: CallCenterId
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the unique ID of the call center
											(CallCenter Id)
											where the activity took place. Available in API version
											48.0 and later. This is a relationship field.This field isn't available in Salesforce Voice (Native
												Telephony).

fields.name: CallConnectDateTime
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the date and
											time (in UTC) when the call was connected.

fields.name: CallDisposition
fields.description:
The status of the phone call.

											For Sales Dialer, possible values are:

											
												in
												progress

												busy

												failed

											

											For Salesforce Voice, possible values are:

											
												
new—The
												voice call record has been created.

												
in-progress—The call has been accepted
												(or, for outbound messages, initiated) by an
												agent.

												
completed—The call has ended. This
												includes calls that are transferred. (If a call is
												transferred, another voice call record is created
												to track the state of the transferred call.) If
												After Conversation Work (ACW) is enabled, that
												work begins after the call completes.

fields.name: CallDurationInSeconds
fields.description: The total duration (in seconds) of the call.

fields.name: CallEndDateTime
fields.description: The date and time (in UTC) when the call ended.

fields.name: CallerId
fields.description:
For Salesforce Voice, this field represents the unique ID of the participant who
											initiated the call. If “Match Callers to End User
											Records” is enabled in Lightning Experience, the value
											is null and the EndUserId field is
											used instead to determine the end user associated with
											this voice call. Available in API version 48.0 and
											later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CallerIdType
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the number
											displayed for outbound calls. Possible values are:
												
VendorLine—User.

												
CompanyNumber—Company.

												
LocalPresence—Local Presence.

												
CustomCallerId—Custom Caller ID. Available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: CallOrigin
fields.description:
Information about how this call originated. For Salesforce Voice, possible values are:
												
Preview—Preview dialer.

												
Progressive—Progressive dialer.

												
Voicemail—Voicemail call. Available in API version 56.0 and later.

fields.name: CallQueuedDateTime
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the date and time (in UTC) when
											the call was added to a queue to be routed to an agent.
											Available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: CallRecordingId
fields.description:
For Salesforce Voice, this field represents the unique ID of the call recording for
											the voice call. An update to the CallRecordingId value
											is an internal process and doesn't trigger automation
											such as flows. Available in API version 41.0 and
											later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CallResolution
fields.description:
The resolution outcome of the call. The default value is
												Resolved,
											meaning the call has been resolved. Available in API
											version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: CallStartDateTime
fields.description: The date and time (UTC) when the call started.

fields.name: CallStatus
fields.description: For internal use only. Available in API version 63.0 and later.

fields.name: CallSubtype
fields.description:
For Salesforce Voice, this field represents the network or protocol over which the
											phone or Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) call is
											made. Possible values are:
												PSTN

												WebRTC

											
Available in API version 62.0 and later.

fields.name: CallType
fields.description:
The types of call.For Sales Dialer, possible values are:

												Bridge

												Coach

												Inbound

												Internal

												Outbound

											
For Salesforce Voice, possible values are:

												Callback

												Consult

												Inbound

												InternalCall

												Outbound

												Transfer

fields.name: CoachingDurationInSeconds
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the total
											duration (in seconds) of the coaching session. This
											field only appears if call coaching is enabled.
											Available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: ConferenceKey
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the related
											conference key. This field is only available if call
											monitoring is enabled. Available in API version 41.0 and
											later.

fields.name: ConversationId
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the unique ID of the
											conversation. This field is only available if call
											monitoring is enabled. Available in API version 48.0 and
											later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CurrencyCode
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the ISO currency
											code used to bill the call.

fields.name: CustomerHoldDuration
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the total duration (in seconds)
											of all the holds that occurred during the voice call.
											Available in API version 49.0 and later.

fields.name: CustomerSentimentScore
fields.description:
If Sentiment
												Journey in Salesforce Voice is set up, this
											field represents the customer’s overall sentiment score
											post-call in a conversation event. The value must be
											between -5 (lowest negative sentiment score) and 5
											(highest positive sentiment score), with 0 being a
											neutral sentiment score. Available in API version 59.0
											and later.This field isn't available in Salesforce
												Voice (Native Telephony).

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents a text field where the agent can
											enter a summary of the call. Available in API version
											48.0 and later.

fields.name: DisconnectReason
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents
											the reason why the voice call was disconnected. For Salesforce Voice with Telephony Providers, the partner telephony provides the
											reason. For Amazon Connect instances, this value is
											automatically populated through the contact record if
											you have Contact Center version 13.0 or later. See
											DisconnectReason in the Amazon Connect
												contact records data model page for a list of
											possible reasons why a voice call may be disconnected.
											For all other partner telephony models, configure this
											feature through the disconnectReason parameter in the Update a
											Voice Call Record Telephony Integration API. Available
											in API version 59.0 and later.For Salesforce Voice
												(Native Telephony), possible values for inbound
												calls are:

												CUSTOMER_DISCONNECT

												FLOW_DISCONNECT

												REP_DISCONNECT

												AGENT_DISCONNECT

												CUSTOMER_QUEUE_DISCONNECT For Salesforce Voice (Native Telephony), possible
												values for outbound calls are:

											
												CUSTOMER_DISCONNECT

												FLOW_DISCONNECT

												REP_DISCONNECT

												AGENT_DISCONNECT

												RING_NO_ANSWER

												CALL_REJECTED For Agentforce Voice, possible values are:

											
												
												DISCONNECTED_BY_CUSTOMER

												TRANSFERRED

												OTHER

fields.name: EndUserId
fields.description:
For Salesforce Voice, if “Match Callers to End User Records” is enabled in Lightning
											Experience, this field represents the unique ID of the
											messaging end user (MessagingEndUser ID) associated with
											this voice call. Available in API version 53.0 and
											later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: FromPhoneNumber
fields.description: The number of the user who initiated the call.

fields.name: IsDiarizationOptIn
fields.description:
Indicates whether optimal speaker separation
											(diarization) is opted in (true) or not (false) for the call.

fields.name: IsRecorded
fields.description:
Indicates whether a Voice Call Recording record was
											created (true) or
											not (false) for
											this voice call. The default value is false. Available in API
											version 44.0 and later.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The date and time (in UTC) when the current user last
											viewed a record related to this voice call.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The date and time (in UTC) when the current user last
											viewed this voice call. If the record has not been
											viewed before, this value is null. Referencing a record
												(LastReferencedDate) doesn’t count as
											viewing it.

fields.name: LongestHoldDuration
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the longest hold duration (in
											seconds) that occurred during the call. Available in API
											version 49.0 and later.

fields.name: MediaProviderId
fields.description:
The unique ID of the related media provider. Available
											in API version 49.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The name of the voice call record. For example, VC-00000001. Available
											in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: NextCallId
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the unique ID of the next call
											if
											the call was transferred to another agent. If there is
											no other agent, this value is null. Available in API
											version 48.0 and later.This field isn't available in
												Salesforce Voice (Native Telephony). This is a relationship field.

fields.name: NumberOfHolds
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the number of times the customer
											was put on hold. Available in API version 49.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
The unique ID of the user who owns the voice call
											record. Don’t modify this field during active call routing
											through automation, such as record-triggered flows or
											Apex triggers. Modifying this field during active call
											routing by customer automation creates conflicts with
											the Salesforce Voice with Telephony Providers internal
											platform logic. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: PreviousCallId
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the unique ID of the previous
											call if the call was transferred from another agent.
											When there is no previous call, this value is null.
											Available in API version 48.0 and later.This field
												isn't available inr Salesforce Voice (Native
												Telephony). This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Price
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the cost of the
											phone call.

fields.name: QualityScore
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the value of the Mean Opinion
											Score (MOS) that measures voice call quality. This
											algorithm is based on packet loss percentage, average
											latency, and average jitter. Available in API version
											53.0 and later.

fields.name: QueueName
fields.description:
If Salesforce Voice is enabled, this field represents the name of the agent queue.
											Available in API version 49.0 and later.

fields.name: RecipientId
fields.description:
For Salesforce Voice, this field represents the unique ID of the participant who
											received the call. If “Match Callers to End User
											Records” is enabled in Lightning Experience, this value
											is null and the EndUserId field is
											used instead to determine the end user associated with
											this voice call. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: RecordTypeId
fields.description:
The ID of the voice call record type assigned to this
											voice call. If a record type isn't assigned to this
											voice call, the value is null. Available in API version
											59.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: RelatedRecordId
fields.description:
The unique ID of the related record. Associates the VoiceCall record to a standard or
											custom object record. For Salesforce Voice, supported
											related records include the standard objects Account,
											Case, Collection Plan, Contact, Contact Request, Lead,
											Opportunity, and WorkOrder. For Sales Dialer, supported
											related records include custom objects. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: SourceType
fields.description:
The general purpose of the call. The permission sets
											assigned to the voice call owner determine the value. A
											call’s source type controls which insights Einstein
											Conversation Insights applies during
												analysis.Possible values are:

												Sales

												Service

											
Available in API version 52.0 and
											later.

fields.name: ToPhoneNumber
fields.description:
The recipient of the call. For inbound, transfer, and
											callback calls, this value is the agent's number. For
											outbound calls, this value is the customer's
											number.

fields.name: TranscribedLanguage
fields.description:
The language that is transcribed for this voice call. Don’t set or change this value.
											It’s automatically populated by the Conversation
											Intelligence platform.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description:
The unique ID of the Salesforce user who initiates an
											outbound call or accepts an inbound call. If no one
											takes the call, this value defaults to null. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: VendorCallKey
fields.description:
The unique ID of the child leg of the call that’s provided by the Sales Dialer vendor
											or Salesforce Voice.

fields.name: VendorParentCallKey
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the unique ID of
											the parent leg of the call that’s provided by the Dialer
											vendor.

fields.name: VendorType
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the type of Dialer vendor. For Salesforce
											Voice, this field is always set to ContactCenter.
											Available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: VoiceVendorLineId
fields.description:
For Sales Dialer, this field represents the unique ID of
											the associated Dialer vendor line. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: EngagementInsightType
fields.description:
Required. The unique identifier of the platform setup entity that
                                 defines the configuration for this engagement insight type.

fields.name: GenerationDateTime
fields.description: Required. The timestamp when the call insight was generated.

fields.name: InsightConfigName
fields.description:
The name of the insight configuration, or category, used to
                                 classify the insight.

fields.name: InsightLanguage
fields.description:
The language associated with the insight type. Each insight type
                                 is currently limited to a single language. If the same insight type
                                 is mapped to a different language, a new insight type is
                                 created.

fields.name: InsightModel
fields.description:
Required. The category of the insight type. Possible values are: 
                                    
FOUNDTIONAL—Foundational

                                    
GENERATIVE—Generative

                                    
KEYWORD—Keyword

                                    
SITUATIONAL—Situational

                                    
TIME_BASED—Time-Based The default value is KEYWORD.

fields.name: InsightOccurrenceCount
fields.description:
The number of times a particular insight occurred in the
                                 transcript.

fields.name: InsightSubject
fields.description:
The specific text, phrase, or subject identified in the voice call
                                 transcript that serves as the basis for the insight.

fields.name: InsightText
fields.description:
The text content of the insight derived from the voice call
                                 transcript.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the insight type.

fields.name: Scope
fields.description:
Required. The scope of the insight type. Possible values are: 
                                    Organization

                                    User The default value is Organization.

fields.name: VoiceCallId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated parent VoiceCall. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VoiceCallRecordingId
fields.description: ID of the associated parent VoiceCallRecording. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: VoiceCallTranscript
fields.description:
The transcript of the voice call. This field requires the
                                 canUserDoCloudIntegration permission.

fields.name: ActionCategory
fields.description:
The category that classifies the purpose of the action. Possible values are: 
                                    FollowUp

                                    NeedsAttention

fields.name: ActionReferenceId
fields.description: ID of the record associated with the generated action. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description:
The specific type of action to be performed for the insight. Possible values are: 
                                    CreateCalendarEvent

                                    CreateTaskWithDate

                                    EciCreateCallback

                                    EciScheduleMeetings

                                    EciSendCallResponse

                                    ViewContactProfile The default value is CreateTaskWithDate.

fields.name: FailedReason
fields.description:
If the CRM Analytics application fails to complete successfully, this value
                      indicates why the failure occurred. Values can be: 
                        
OrganizationIncompatible: the org didn't pass the
                          template compatibility checks.

                        
AppInstallationSkipped: the org didn't pass the
                          template compatibility checks and was skipped.

                        
RetriesExhausted: the request exhausted the maximum
                          number of retries.

                        
RequestCancelled: the user canceled the
                          request.

                        
AppCreateFailure: the app or folder creation
                          failed. Check the request log and try again.

                        
AppUpdateFailure: the app or folder update failed.
                          Check the request log and try again.

                        
AppConstructionFailure: the app or folder
                          construction failed. Check the request log and try again.

                        
WaveDisabled: the org doesn't have the Wave org
                          permission or preference enabled. Check the licenses for CRM Analytics and
                          try again.

                        
CancelFailed: canceling an in-progress app failed.
                          Check the request log and try again.

                        
DeleteFailed: deleting an app failed. Check the
                          request log and try again.

                        
DependencyFailure: a dependent auto-install request
                          failed. Check App Install History and try again.

                        
DependencyCancelled: the user canceled a dependent
                          auto-install request. Check App Install History and try again.

                        
FailedToEnqueue: the request failed to enqueue.
                          Check the request log and try again.

                        
FailedOther: the request failed for another reason.
                          Check the request log and try again.

fields.description:
Company name associated with a delivery for a guest customer. This
                                 field is available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: GuestEmailAddress
fields.description: The email address of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: GuestFirstName
fields.description: The first name of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: GuestLastName
fields.description: The last name (or surname) of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: GuestPhoneNumber
fields.description: The phone number of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: GuestSecondName
fields.description: The second name of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: InitialOrderReferenceNumber
fields.description:
A unique identifier assigned to the WebCart at the beginning of
                                 the checkout process. Initially populated when the checkout process
                                 is initiated, the InitialOrderReferenceNumber
                                 is then associated with the order created when the checkout is
                                 complete. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

fields.name: InventoryReservationIdentifier
fields.description: Reserved for future use. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

fields.name: IsRepricingNeeded
fields.description:
Whether the cart has changed since the last repricing. The default
                                 value is false.

fields.name: IsSecondary
fields.description: Whether the cart is a secondary cart or a primary cart. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: LastRepricingDate
fields.description: Date when the last repricing was done.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The name of this WebCart record.
                                    Name can be up to 255 characters.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The ID of the owner of this WebCart. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentGroupId
fields.description: The ID of the WebCart payment group. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaymentMethodId
fields.description: The method of payment for this WebCart. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

fields.name: PoNumber
fields.description: The purchase order number. Enter up to 80 characters.

fields.name: QuoteLineItemCount
fields.description: Tracks the count of items added to the webcart from quotes. This field is a calculated field.

fields.name: Status
fields.description:
The status of this WebCart. Possible values are:
                                    
                                       
Active—Cart
                                          is created and available for modifications, like adding or
                                          removing products or promotions.

                                       
Checkout—Cart
                                          is in checkout. If the customer modifies the cart, the
                                          current checkout session is canceled.

                                       
Closed—Checkout is complete and an order
                                          was created. The cart cannot be modified.

                                       
PendingClosed—Cart is marked to be
                                          closed, but the request isn't completed yet. The cart
                                          can’t be modified. This value is available in API version
                                          57.0 and later.

                                       
PendingDelete—Cart is marked for
                                          delete, but the request isn't completed yet. The cart
                                          can’t be modified.

                                       
Processing—Cart is processing. For
                                          example, taxes are being calculated. The cart can’t be
                                          modified.

fields.name: TaxLocaleType
fields.description:
The type of tax locale. Possible values are:
                                    
                                       Net

                                       Gross This field is available in API versions 52.0 to 54.0.

fields.name: TaxType
fields.description:
The type of tax policy. Possible values are:
                                    
                                       Automatic

                                       Net

                                       Gross This field is available in API version 55.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentAmount
fields.description:
A calculated field that reflects the total of all adjustments to
                                 the cart subtotal. Adjustments include item, tier, and cart level
                                 discounts.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items’ TotalPrice, or
                                    TotalProductAmount plus
                                    TotalChargeAmount. If the store tax type is
                                 Gross, the sum includes taxes. Note
Although this field is Nillable, if you want to use Commerce Webstore Cart
                                       Promotions, this field is required and must have a
                                    value greater than or equal to zero (0).

fields.name: TotalAmountAfterAllAdjustments
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items after all price adjustments are applied.
                                 Adjustments include various types of discounts. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalCartLevelAdjAmount
fields.description: Total cart level discount amount for the cart. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalChargeAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items’ TotalPrice for
                                 cart items of the type Charge.

fields.name: TotalChargeTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items’ TotalTaxAmount
                                 for cart items of the type Charge.

fields.name: TotalLineItemsWithErrors
fields.description:
A calculated field that shows the total number of cart line items
                                 of type Product with
                                 errors. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalListAmount
fields.description:
Sum of all the cart items’
                                 TotalListPrice.

fields.name: TotalProductAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items’ TotalPrice for
                                 cart items of the type Product.

fields.name: TotalProductCount
fields.description:
A count of all the products in the
                                 WebCart.

fields.name: TotalProductItemAdjAmount
fields.description: Total item level discount amount for the cart. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalProductLineItemCount
fields.description:
A calculated field that shows the total number of cart line items
                                 of type Product. This field is available in API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalProductListAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items’
                                    TotalListAmount for the
                                    CartItem type Product. This field is available in API version 59.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalProductTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all the cart items’ TotalTaxAmount
                                 for the CartItem type Product.

fields.name: TotalPromoAdjustmentAmount
fields.description:
The total of all item discounts related to product
                                 promotions. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalPromoAdjustmentTaxAmount
fields.description:
The total tax adjustment for all item discounts related to product
                                 promotions. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: TotalTaxAmount
fields.description:
The sum of all cart items’ TotalTaxAmount, or
                                    TotalProductTaxAmount plus
                                    TotalDeliveryTaxAmount.

fields.name: Type
fields.description:
The WebCart type. Default value is Cart. Possible values are:
                                    Cart

                                    PayNowReadOnly

                                    ReadOnly

                                    Template

fields.name: UniqueProductCount
fields.description:
The count of unique product SKUs in the
                                    WebCart.

fields.name: WebStoreId
fields.description: The store ID related to this WebCart. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AdjustmentBasisDetail
fields.description: Coupon code for the coupon associated with the promotion.

fields.name: AdjustmentBasisReferenceId
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the coupon. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The currency ISO code of the cart. Possible values are: 
                                    EUR

                                    USD The default value is USD.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the WebCartAdjustmentBasis record.

fields.name: WebCartId
fields.description: ID of the cart. This field is a relationship field.

fields.name: AdjustmentSource
fields.description:
Price adjustment type. Possible values are: 
            Discretionary

            Promotion

            System

fields.name: AdjustmentTargetType
fields.description:
Target for the price adjustment (the cart itself or individual items). Possible values are: 
            Cart

            Item

fields.name: AdjustmentType
fields.description:
Indicates if the price adjustment is applied as percentage or an absolute amount. Possible values are: 
            AdjustmentAmount

            AdjustmentPercentage

fields.name: AdjustmentValue
fields.description:
Numeric value of the adjustment (for example, 10 if the price adjustment is either 10%
           off or $10 off).

fields.name: CartId
fields.description: ID of the cart to which the price adjustment belongs. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. Default value
           is USD. Possible values are: 
            
EUR—Euro

            
USD—U.S. Dollar

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the adjustment group.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the adjustment group.

fields.name: PriceAdjustmentCauseId
fields.description:
ID of entity that caused this adjustment (for example, a promotion ID). If
           unspecified, then Description populates the display name. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description:
If there are multiple price adjustments, sequence in which the price adjustments are
           applied.

fields.name: TaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the total adjusted price.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description: Total price after adjustments.

fields.name: TotalAmountWithTax
fields.description: Total adjusted price plus tax.

fields.name: DataType
fields.description: Data type of the field that was changed.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: New value of the field that was changed.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: Old value of the field that was changed.

fields.name: WebCartId
fields.description: The unique ID of the WebCart.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the custom link. Limit is 1,000 characters.

fields.name: DisplayType
fields.description: Type of display: button, link, or mass-action button.

fields.name: EncodingKey
fields.description: Required. Encoding of parameters on the URL link.

fields.name: HasMenubar
fields.description: Indicates whether the popup window shows a menu bar (true) or not (false).

fields.name: HasScrollbars
fields.description: Indicates whether the popup window shows scroll bars (true) or not (false).

fields.name: HasToolbar
fields.description:
Indicates whether the popup window shows browser toolbars (true) or not (false). Toolbars normally
           contain navigation buttons like Back, Forward, and Print.

fields.name: Height
fields.description: Height of the popup in pixels.

fields.name: IsProtected
fields.description:
Indicates whether the object is protected (true) or not (false).
            Protected components that have been installed in other organizations can’t be
            linked to or referenced by components created in the subscriber organization. A
            developer can easily delete a protected component contained in a managed package in a
            future release of the package without worrying about failing installations. However,
            once a component is marked as unprotected and is released globally, the developer
            can’t delete it.

fields.name: IsResizable
fields.description: Indicates whether users are allowed to resize the popup window (true) or not (false).

fields.name: LinkType
fields.description: Required. Type of link (S-control or URL).

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description:
Master label for the link. Limit is 240 characters. This display value is the internal
           label that is not translated.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Name to display on page.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description:
The namespace prefix that is associated with this object. Each Developer Edition org
           that creates a managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You
           can refer to a component in a managed package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName
           notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the following values.

            In Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set to the
             namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it, unless an object is in an
             installed managed package. In that case, the object has the namespace prefix of the
             installed managed package. This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the Developer
             Edition org of the package developer.

            In orgs that are not Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is
             set only for objects that are part of an installed managed package. All other objects
             have no namespace prefix. This field can’t be accessed unless the logged-in user has the Customize
            Application permission.

fields.name: OpenType
fields.description:
Required. How the custom link opens when clicked in a browser—NewWindow,
           Sidebar, or NoSidebar.

fields.name: PageOrSobjectType
fields.description:
Required. For standard objects, the name of the page on which to display the custom
           link. For custom objects, the name of the object.

fields.name: Position
fields.description:
Location on the screen where the popup should open—TopLeft, FullScreen, or
           None.

fields.name: RequireRowSelection
fields.description: Indicates whether the custom link requires a row selection (true) or not (false).

fields.name: ScontrolId
fields.description:
ID of the custom s-control object (Scontrol) to link to. Can include fields as tokens
           within the custom s-control object. Label is Custom S-Control
           ID.

fields.name: ShowsLocation
fields.description:
Indicates whether the popup window shows the browser’s address bar containing
           the URL (true) or not (false).

fields.name: ShowsStatus
fields.description: Show the status bar at the bottom of the browser.

fields.name: Url
fields.description:
Required. URL of the page to link to. Can include fields as tokens within the URL.
           Limit: 1,024 KB.

fields.name: Width
fields.description: Width of the popup in pixels.

            object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a managed package has a unique namespace

             have no namespace prefix.

fields.name: Value
fields.description:
The actual translated label of the custom link. Label is
            Translation.

fields.name: WebLinkId
fields.description: The ID of the WebLink that is being translated.

fields.name: CheckoutTimeToLive
fields.description:
Amount of time in minutes that a B2B checkout stays
											active and doesn’t expire. If you use a Null value, your
											checkout never expires. If you use a 0 value, checkout is
											disabled. This field is available in API version 50.0
											and later.

fields.name: CheckoutValidAfterDate
fields.description:
A timestamp in the default server timezone (GMT). All
											B2B checkouts that start before this date are considered
											expired. A Null
											value means that all checkouts are valid. Example
											format: 2020-07-14T14:27:00.000Z. This field is
											available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: Country
fields.description:
Two-digit ISO code of the store's country. Purchases can
											be shipped only to the country assigned to the store.
											This field is available in API version 55.0 and
											later.

fields.name: CurrencyIsoCode
fields.description:
The default value is USD. Possible values are: 

											
												
USD—U.S.
												Dollar

fields.name: DefaultLanguage
fields.description:
The primary supported language for your store.
												Possible values include: 

												
da—
												Danish

												
de—
												German

												
en_US—
												English

												
es—
												Spanish

												
en_MX—
												Spanish (Mexico)

												
fi—
												Finnish

												
fr—
												French

												
it—
												Italian

												
ja—
												Japanese

												
ko—
												Korean

												
nl_NL—
												Dutch

												
no—
												Norwegian

												
pt_BR—
												Portuguese (Brazil)

												
ru—
												Russian

												
sv—
												Swedish

												
th—
												Thai

												
zh_CN—
												Chinese (Simplified)

												
zh_TW—
												Chinese (Traditional)

fields.name: DefaultTaxLocaleType
fields.description:
Tax type of the store. This field is available in API
											version 55.0 and later. Possible values include: 

											
												
Gross—
												Prices include tax

												
Net— Prices
												don't include tax

fields.name: DefaultTaxPolicyId
fields.description:
The default tax policy for the store. This field is a
											relationship field. This field is available in API
											version 56.0 and later.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the store.

fields.name: ExternalReference
fields.description:
Identifies the instance of B2C Commerce. Format is
												<<SiteId>>@<<InstanceId>>.
											This field is available in API version 54.0 and
											later.

fields.name: GuestBuyerProfileId
fields.description:
The ID of the GuestBuyerProfile associated with the
											store. GuestBuyerProfile determines what buyer groups
											are part of the profile. The guest buyer groups then
											determine the entitlements and pricing of products for
											the guest buyer.

fields.name: GuestCartTimeToLive
fields.description:
The time that a guest cart is to remain valid before it
											expires. The default value is 168 hours (7 days), and
											the maximum value is 720 hours (30 days). This field is
											available in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a
											record related to this record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description:
The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this
											record. If this value is null, this record might only
											have been referenced and not viewed directly.

fields.name: LocationId
fields.description: The location associated with the address.

fields.name: MaxValuesPerFacet
fields.description:
The maximum number of values that can be added to a
											facet.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the catalog.

fields.name: OptionsAutoFacetingEnabled
fields.description:
If enabled (True), the most relevant search facets are
											automatically returned, in addition to the configured
											search facets, in the product search results. If
											disabled (False), only the configured search facets are
											returned. The default is False.See Add Product Search Filters (Facets).for more
											information. This field is available in API version 50.0
											or later.

fields.name: OptionsCartAsyncProcessingEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether add-to-cart requests are processed
											asynchronously (True) or not (False). The default value is True. This field is
											available in API version 59.0 or later.

fields.name: OptionsCartCalculateEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether the cart calculate extension is
											enabled (True) or
											not (False). The
											default value is False. This field is available in API version 59.0 or
											later.

fields.name: OptionsCartToOrderAutoCustomFieldMapping
fields.description:
Indicates whether custom field mapping for cart and
											order objects is enabled (True) or not (False). The default value is True. This field is available in API version 57.0 or
											later.

fields.name: OptionsDuplicateCartItemsEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether a cart can include multiple items with
											the same product ID (True) or not (False). The default
											value is False. This field is available in API version 59.0 or
											later.

fields.name: OptionsGuestBrowsingEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether guest browsing is enabled for this
											store. Set the option to True to allow guest buyers access to
											products in the store.

fields.name: OptionsGuestCartEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether guest cart access is enabled for a
											store created with an LWR template. Set the option to
												True to allow
											guest buyers access to products in the store.This
												field is available in API version 58.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsGuestCheckoutEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether guest checkout access is enabled for a
											store created with an LWR template. Set the option to
												True to allow
											guest buyers access to products in the store.This
												field is available in API version 58.0 and
												later.

fields.name: OptionsPreserveGuestCartEnabled
fields.description:
Indicates whether cart contents are preserved when a guest logs in to the store. Set
											the option to True
											to preserve guest carts.This field is available in
												API version 60.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSkipAdditionalEntitlementCheckForSearch
fields.description:
By default, user entitlement checks are run as part of a
											search index rebuild and again when product search
											results are returned. Skips the second check to promote
											faster search performance. Set the option to True to skip additional
											entitlement checks on a search. This field is available
											in API version 52.0 and later.

fields.name: OrderActivationStatus
fields.description:
Status of the order. This field is available in API
											version 55.0 and later. Possible values are: 
												Activated

												Draft

fields.name: OrderLifeCycleType
fields.description:
Indicates whether order summaries are processed with
											Order Management features: 
												
Managed—

												
Unmanaged—

											
This field is available in API version 55.0 and
											later.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description:
Indicates the owner of the store. This field is
											available in API 53.0 or later. This is a relationship field.

fields.name: PaginationSize
fields.description: Dimensions of the page.

fields.name: PricingStrategy
fields.description:
Possible values are: 
												
LowestPrice— Best Price

												
Priority— Priority Price.

											
The default value is LowestPrice.

fields.name: ProductGrouping
fields.description:
Determines whether product variations are listed
											individually in search results or are represented by the
											parent product, which links to its children. Possible

NEW—The initial

IN_PROGRESS—Active development in the
                                       development environment. 

                                    
IN_REVIEW—Changes are committed and a pull
                                       request is created for team review. 

                                    
READY_TO_PROMOTE—The work item is approved
                                       and is ready for promotion to the first pipeline stage.

                                    
PROMOTED—The
                                       work item is promoted to a pipeline stage. 

                                    
MERGE_CONFLICT—Indicates that the work item
                                       has conflicts that must be resolved before promotion. 

                                    
NEVERED—The work
                                       item is inactive and won’t be promoted. 

                                    
COMBINED—The
                                       work item was merged into another work item to resolve
                                       conflicts or dependencies. 

                                    
CLOSED—Work is
                                       complete, fully tested, and promoted through the entire
                                       pipeline. The default value is NEW.

In

On
												Hold—Work is paused.

Cannot
												Complete—Work could not be
												completed.

												
Closed—All work and associated
												activity is complete.
